title: Senior Director, Physical Design
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Altera seeks an experienced Senior Director of Physical Design to lead the physical design strategy and execution of next-generation semiconductor products. This leader will drive innovation in design methodologies, oversee complex chip implementations, and mentor a high-performing team of physical design engineers across multiple product lines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead physical design strategy and execution for advanced-node semiconductor products
  • Manage and mentor a team of physical design managers, principal engineers, and senior engineers
  • Establish and drive physical design methodologies, standards, and best practices
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including logic design, DFT, and power management
  • Drive continuous improvement in design quality, power, performance, and area (PPA)
  • Manage physical design budgets, schedules, and resource allocation
  • Evaluate and implement emerging design automation tools and technologies

Partner with vendor ecosystem to optimize tool flows and capabilities

Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of experience in physical design of complex semiconductor products
  • 10+ years in management and team leadership roles
  • Deep expertise in placement, routing, physical verification, and signoff at 7nm and below nodes
  • Strong knowledge of design automation tools and methodologies
  • Proven track record of delivering high-quality silicon within schedule and power budgets
  • Experience managing large, distributed engineering teams
  • Bachelor's degree in Electronic Engineering or related field

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Electronics Engineering
  • Experience in advanced node physical design at 5nm or below
  • Background in FPGA or programmable logic design
  • Experience with multiple foundry relationships (TSMC, Samsung, Intel)
  • Leadership experience in geographically distributed teams across multiple time zones

title: Patient Service Representative - Denver Heart and Vascular
description:
Job Description:

The Patient Service Representative (PSR) serves as the first connection between Intermountain and patients. This role embodies Intermountain values and focuses on establishing collaborative relationships with patients and fellow caregivers to deliver the highest level of customer/patient satisfaction. The PSR ensures a superior customer experience by identifying and resolving patient needs related to patient intake and care, which may include greeting and checking-in/out patients, as well as verifying information supplied by patients.

Essential Functions.

  • Provides courteous and professional connections with patients over the phone, in person or via secure messaging. Resolves patient needs skills to ensure a superior customer experience by identifying and resolving patient needs related to patient intake and care.
  • Documents all phone calls accurately and completely in the electronic medical record (EMR).
  • Schedules patient appointments for visits, procedures, diagnostic tests, referrals, and/or consultations.
  • Registers patients over the phone or in person by confirming, entering, and/or updating all required demographic data on patient and guarantor on the registration system. Follows procedures when identifying patients.
  • Obtains copies of insurance cards, forms of ID, and signatures on all required forms. May verify information on appropriate accounts to determine insurance coordination of benefits, may include pre-certification/prior authorization .
  • Assists patients in completing necessary forms to meet regulatory and billing needs prior to receiving clinical care. Scans necessary paperwork and educates patient on financial assistance. Proactively requests payments from patients on current and past medical services. Receives and processes those payments following appropriate procedures for handling payments.
  • Stays current on role/responsibilities, updates etc. which may include reviewing monthly email/newsletter, ambulatory epic dashboard, patient access, work ques, attend clinic/service line meetings, review emails each shift, etc. to ensure the highest standard of performance is achieved.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Six months of customer service experience involving interactions with customers.
  • Demonstrated basic computer skills involving word processing and data entry.
  • Professional manner and strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with patients and fellow caregivers to deliver the highest level of customer/patient satisfaction.
  • Ability to protect privacy, confidentiality, and Protected Health Information (PHI) of patients, members, and caregivers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • One year of customer service experience involving interactions with customers in person and by phone.
  • Billing and collections experience.
  • Computer literacy in using electronic medical records (EMR) systems and other relevant software.
  • High school diploma or GED preferred.
  • Multilingual

Physical Requirements

  • Ongoing need for caregivers to see and read information, labels, documents, monitors, identify equipment and supplies, and be able to assess customer needs.
  • Frequent interactions with providers, colleagues, customers, patients/clients and visitors require employee to verbally communicate as well as hear and understand spoken information, needs, and issues quickly and accurately.
  • Manual dexterity of hands and fingers to manipulate complex and delicate supplies and equipment with precision and accuracy. This includes frequent computer use for typing, accessing needed information, etc.
  • Position may require standing for long periods of time, lifting supplies
  • May assist patients into/out of the clinic.

Scientific Engagement & External Medical Exchange

- Execute peer‑to‑peer, non‑promotional scientific exchange with HCPs and MEs aligned to local TA priorities.

Medical Governance & Medical Information

Compliance & Governance

description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for coordinating the community’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals by performing all activities related to leasing to new residents, providing resident satisfaction throughout the term of the lease, and securing resident lease renewals.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Essential Responsibilities:
• Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting community tours and showing apartments, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
• Inspects apartments prior to resident move-in and ensures apartments are in move-in ready condition and schedules any outstanding item to be addressed with the maintenance team.
• Stays informed about current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the community’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy.
• Designs and executes marketing activities to create and drive traffic to the community, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools (Craigslist, Facebook, e-mail, and other websites), and following other community-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.
• Uses the on-site property management software (OneSite, Yardi, etc.) to track apartment availability, record traffic and leasing activities, manage resident and prospect data, and capture critical demographic and other information about existing and future residents.
• Ensures that the community and show units meet the Company’s standards for show quality by daily inspecting the marketing corridor and leasing tour, communicating maintenance and upkeep needs to the community’s maintenance team members, merchandising and ensuring a physically appealing show unit and/or model and amenities, and preparing the leasing office for daily leasing activities.
• Follows-up with prospects and new residents to ensure satisfaction by sending e-mail, thank-you notes, and cards or making telephone calls or other contacts to finalize decisions to lease and/or renew.
• Executes and performs activities in support of the community’s lease renewal program by preparing lease renewal letters and packages for residents, meeting with and contacting renewing residents in advance of move-out dates, and ensuring that lease renewal documents are signed and implemented on time.
• Responds quickly and courteously to resident and client/owner concerns and questions, and takes prompt action to solve problems and/or document and convey resident or other requests to the appropriate individual(s).

Required Licenses or Certifications:
• Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions

• Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to operate a golf cart on property.

Physical Demands:

  • Incumbents need to be able to stand, walk, and/or sit for extended periods of time and bend, stoop, climb ladders, reach, carry objects, and crawl in confined areas.
  • Incumbents must be able to work inside and outside in all weather conditions (rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, sleet).
  • Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty-five (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance.
  • Rare or regular travel may be required to assist other properties as needed, attend training classes, business meetings, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
  • Incumbents must be able to work a flexible work schedule, which includes taking “call” during evenings, weekends and holidays.

The hourly range for this position is $20.00- $21.00

title: Reporter, Risk.net
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Infopro Digital, the B2B group specialising in information and technology, is currently looking for a Reporter on a permanent contract to strengthen the Risk.net team in New York.

About Infopro Digital

The best of both worlds. That is what a position with Infopro Digital offers you.

Infopro Digital is a global B2B company with 4,000 employees and annual revenues of over half a billion dollars, with a presence in 26 countries. Through our market-leading brands, we serve five professional communities – insurance and finance, automotive aftermarket, construction, retail, and industrials – enabling our clients to make informed business decisions and create new opportunities.

About Risk.net

Would you like to write about some of the most high-profile and dynamic developments in the financial markets – from the electronification of trading and the evolution of market structure to the pricing of complex derivatives and the fast-moving world of foreign exchange? Risk.net is seeking an energetic and insightful journalist to join its Markets desk, based in New York with hybrid working.

The ideal candidate will be passionate and knowledgeable about finance and markets, with a talent for bringing complex topics to life, and the ability to combine the best elements of trade and mainstream financial journalism to produce must-read articles that stand out from the crowd. They should be equally adept at breaking news and writing in-depth, long-form features. A proven ability to build and maintain strong source relationships is a must.

Risk.net covers financial institutions and markets for a professional audience, including senior executives at banks, hedge funds and regulators. The Markets desk is central to this effort, with a remit that spans the globe.

The publication

Risk.net is a rare beast: a financial industry publication that thrives on long-form investigative journalism. We give our journalists the time and resources necessary to produce great stories. Standards are high, but so is management support.

Risk.net has a collegiate style – our team of around 30 journalists and editors, spread across three offices, actively collaborate on projects and pool their insights and contacts.

Risk.net is part of Risk Global, Infopro Digital’s financial services unit: a 300-person organisation with offices in London, Hong Kong, New York and Nashville. We earn most of our revenues from subscriptions, providing a stable financial base.

The role

The reporter will help drive coverage for the largest of Risk’s four desks – in terms of both traffic and headcount. The reporting will compose of a mix of regular news stories, deeply reported features, profiles and data-led articles.

The role requires at least two years’ financial reporting experience, preferably within capital markets, but not exclusively. The successful applicant must be a good contact builder and be able to generate their own story ideas.

Traditionally an OTC derivatives publication, Risk’s coverage has evolved along with those markets – encompassing flow trading, as well as structured and exotic products. For flow, stories may focus on market structure, electronic and automated trading, as well as the cash and listed products that are traded alongside standardised OTC derivatives. In the structured and exotic space, coverage tends to focus more heavily on products, pricing, valuation and risk management.

In all cases, Risk’s coverage stands out by virtue of its depth. We may not always be first, but we will always offer more insight and analysis.

Our readers represent the full cross-section of the market, and our reporting reflects that – we speak to banks and non-bank liquidity providers, asset managers, hedge funds, pension funds, insurers, corporate treasurers, regulators and supervisors, exchanges, trading platforms and clearing houses, lawyers, consultants, and software vendors. This is a great strength, enabling us to piece together complex stories that have multiple stakeholders. It also means we have to be sensitive to a story’s nuances: there may not always be a clear winner, or a clear loser.

As derivatives trading has become more transparent, our Markets stories increasingly make use of public datasets – and we expect this kind of reporting to become increasingly important.

In 2020, the Markets desk expanded to incorporate coverage of foreign exchange trading for spot and derivatives. The desk’s reporting on these topics appears in Risk.net as well as a sister title, FX Markets, and the reporter would be expected to lean into this asset class more than others.

Key responsibilities

  • Generate a regular flow of news stories for web and print. This includes a mix of exclusive news pieces, conference stories data-led articles.
  • Research and write 2,000-3,000 word feature articles, which require several interviews with various market participants and observers.
  • Build reliable contacts across a variety of market segments, and use them to generate story ideas or develop existing ones.

Requirements

  • Proven journalism experience, ideally at least two years covering finance, capital markets or law
  • Knowledge of the financial markets and their major players; an interest in foreign exchange and derivatives is a strong advantage
  • Impeccable writing skills and a knack for explaining complex topics in plain English. An ability to write with flair and, when appropriate, a sense of humour would be a bonus!
  • Confidence working with data and public datasets to find and support stories
  • A keen eye for detail and nuance
  • A willingness to learn about a broad range of financial topics

Benefits

We know great people make great companies. Infopro Digital is defined by people and passion and powered by knowledge and innovation. Everything we do is centered on trust, integrity and respect. Our collaborative approach drives creativity across our markets; and our focus on giving teams ownership allows us to build an entrepreneurial culture where our people and brands can thrive and grow.

As well as working with the most interesting, talented and fun people, we operate a culture where success is recognized. You will be supported throughout your career, tailoring your development through management support, internal and external training courses, and on the job training.

In addition to a competitive salary we offer the following benefits:

  • 20 Vacation Days (rising to 25 days)
  • 5 paid sick days
  • 11 Paid company holidays
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance (including life insurance)
  • 401k Plan Plus Match
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Short-term and Long-term Disability
  • Employee Assistance Program

title: Global Vyndaqel Evidence Lead, 7 month Secondment
description:
Join one of Pfizer's top revenue drivers globally at a defining moment and help shape the future for patients living with transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM).


The clinical and real-world evidence base for ATTR-CM treatments is rapidly evolving due to the availability of two new competitor entrants in the last 2 years, and several more on the horizon. Therefore, evidence generation for Vyndaqel continues to be a global cross-functional priority. The Global Vyndaqel Evidence Lead is responsible for translating emerging evidence into a compelling brand narrative as competition in the market intensifies. Through a deep understanding of the Vyndaqel evidence base and excellent cross-functional stakeholder management, this role builds (and evolves) the messaging strategy and pulls it through into the core brand narrative, whilst also identifying evidence gaps across the US and international regions that require cross-functional action.


The scope of this position is Global and requires close partnership with Global Medical Affairs, Global Legal, International Commercial Organization (ICO), US Vyndamax team and country marketeers. This 6-month secondment offers a unique opportunity to shape the brand narrative and evidence generation strategy for one of Pfizer’s largest global revenue drivers, with high visibility to commercial and cross-functional leadership.


ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Turn new data into strategic advantage. Own the commercial view of upcoming publications. Lead cross-functional efforts to translate new data into strategic opportunities, messaging, campaign assets and medical education, and generate launch communications.
  • Represent commercial in evidence generation. Act as global commercial point of contact for Medical, ensuring international and US priorities are addressed. Identify evidence gaps that need cross-functional action, advocate for buy-up initiatives and flag commercial risks to global, US and ICO teams.
  • Lead brand narrative evolution. Lead a cross-functional workstream to evolve the brand narrative and messaging strategy. Translate market research into messaging updates, and own the core messaging repository and implementation guidance for markets.
  • Deliver the core campaign update. Own the campaign refresh end to end, managing agency and approvals to deliver on time. Engage with regions and countries to identify specific needs and optimise the output, and track uptake, feedback and KPIs post roll-out.
  • Equip CFCs to engage with confidence. Develop training on new data and own the objection handling resource. Partner with ICO and training partners to close capability gaps across international CFC teams.
  • Ensure Day 1 competitive readiness. Monitor upcoming competitor data and read-outs, and assess their potential impact on HCP decision-making. Lead cross-functional scenario and action planning so the brand acts ahead of the shift rather than reacting to it.
  • Steward agencies and compliance. Manage agency partners and coordinate the Vyndaqel Global RC approval process, working with Medical and Legal to ensure all materials meet Pfizer review standards, policies and values.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Significant pharmaceutical experience, across commercial, medical or relevant cross-functional positions
  • Experience of integrating emerging clinical data into external HCP communication
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking: able to translate complex competitive, clinical and market data into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority in a highly matrixed organization
  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to make sound decisions in ambiguity and manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment
  • Fluent business English

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


  • Vyndaqel brand experience, deep knowledge of the clinical evidence base and competitive market
  • Global or regional experience
  • Curiosity for innovative and AI-enabled ways of working

Breakthroughs that change patients' lives... At Pfizer we are a patient centric company, guided by our four values: courage, joy, equity and excellence. Our breakthrough culture lends itself to our dedication to transforming millions of lives.

title: WORKFORCE STRATEGY HEAD, ENTERPRISE DATA SCIENCE & ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (DSAI)
description:
Salary Range:

90 500,00 € - 168 100,00 €


Band

Job Description Summary

You will lead the enterprise people and organization agenda for Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (DSAI) across Novartis, translating our DSAI ambition into the workforce, organization, talent and capability choices needed to deliver it. Operating at the decision-making table with senior DSAI leaders and partnering across the enterprise, you will shape how we build, attract and grow critical DSAI talent, strengthen our external value proposition, and enable responsible human-AI collaboration. You will lead the enterprise DSAI OTR, including discussion at ECN level, and create the standards, governance and frameworks needed in areas such as careers, capabilities, talent and rewards, particularly where established approaches do not yet exist.

This enterprise role complements rather than replaces the Workforce Strategy Leads directly supporting DSAI teams within their units. Unit-level accountabilities remain unchanged, while this role connects across them, providing the overarching DSAI people strategy, standards and governance and enabling enterprise-level choices where these are needed.


Job Description

#Hybrid

This role can be based in Cambridge, East Hanover, London or Basel, please only apply to one of the appropriate location.


Key Responsibilities

  • Set the enterprise DSAI people and organization strategy.
    Translate the DSAI ambition into an integrated, future-ready agenda across workforce, organization, leadership, culture, talent and capability. Success is evident when: enterprise priorities and accountabilities are clear, adopted across units, and translated into measurable outcomes.
  • Shape strategic workforce and capability choices. Use scenarios, analytics, external insight and data storytelling to anticipate demand for scarce DSAI capabilities and recommend choices on organization design, skills, capacity, location, sourcing and workforce mix. Success is evident when: critical gaps are addressed before they constrain innovation or execution.
  • Lead the enterprise DSAI OTR. Orchestrate the enterprise talent review, integrate perspectives across units, and present implications, choices and recommendations to ECN. Success is evident when: pivotal talent, succession, capability risks and enterprise actions are visible and actively managed.
  • Establish enterprise talent and career approaches. Create differentiated career development, mobility, succession and talent-allocation mechanisms suited to DSAI roles and communities. Success is evident when: Novartis can attract, develop, deploy and retain pivotal DSAI talent across organizational boundaries.
  • Build the external DSAI talent brand and pipeline. Strengthen Novartis’ visibility as an employer of choice through targeted engagement with universities, specialist talent networks and external forums. Build early-talent pathways that attract dual technical/scientific and DSAI expertise and develop judgement, experience and leadership capability. Success is evident when: Novartis has stronger external visibility and a sustainable pipeline of scarce DSAI talent.
  • Design and create enterprise DSAI standards. Build new governance, rewards approaches, career architecture, capability frameworks, talent programs and operating approaches for a field evolving faster than established internal practices. Success is evident when: scalable standards replace fragmented local approaches and remain relevant as DSAI evolves.
  • Connect enterprise strategy and unit execution. Define decision rights, interfaces and governance so the enterprise mandate is distinct from, and complementary to, unchanged unit-level P&O accountabilities. Success is evident when: there is no duplication or accountability gap between enterprise and unit roles.
  • Influence a complex enterprise stakeholder system. Partner with at least nine ECN-1 leaders across R&D, Commercial, Operations and Global Functions, the Head of GDC, unit P&O Business Partners and Expertise Hubs to resolve enterprise trade-offs without relying on formal authority. Success is evident when: leaders move beyond unit optimization and commit to enterprise decisions.
  • Redesign work for human-AI collaboration. Guide organization, role and workflow choices that enable responsible collaboration among people, automation and AI agents while sustaining accountability and a human-cantered employee experience. Success is evident when: adoption improves productivity, innovation and decision quality.
  • Coach senior leaders, shape culture and lead transformation. Challenge and coach leaders through ambiguity, build commitment to new enterprise approaches, anticipate resistance and track adoption and benefits. Success is evident when: leadership behaviour, culture and ways of working support the DSAI strategy.

What you’ll bring to the role

Essential Criteria

  • Extensive experience of progressive P&O/HR experience, including strategic partnership with executive and ECN-1 leaders in a complex global matrix.
  • Strong organization design, strategic workforce planning and transformation experience, including scenario development and enterprise trade-off recommendations.
  • Demonstrated experience creating global or enterprise-wide people strategies, standards, governance or programs, not only implementing established solutions.
  • Evidence of leading enterprise talent reviews, succession and capability discussions with senior executive forums.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence multiple senior stakeholders across business units, functions, countries and P&O disciplines without formal authority.
  • Fluency in people analytics and confidence with AI-enabled tools, responsible AI principles and emerging work technologies.

Desirable Criteria

  • Experience translating emerging technology, data science or digital strategy into workforce, organization and talent implications; direct DSAI sector experience is highly desirable.
  • Relevant university degree or equivalent experience required; advanced qualification in business, organization, analytics, technology or a related discipline.

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

title: WORKFORCE STRATEGY HEAD, ENTERPRISE DATA SCIENCE & ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (DSAI)
description:
Salary Range:

164 500,00 CHF - 305 500,00 CHF


Band

Level 7


Job Description Summary

You will lead the enterprise people and organization agenda for Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (DSAI) across Novartis, translating our DSAI ambition into the workforce, organization, talent and capability choices needed to deliver it. Operating at the decision-making table with senior DSAI leaders and partnering across the enterprise, you will shape how we build, attract and grow critical DSAI talent, strengthen our external value proposition, and enable responsible human-AI collaboration. You will lead the enterprise DSAI OTR, including discussion at ECN level, and create the standards, governance and frameworks needed in areas such as careers, capabilities, talent and rewards, particularly where established approaches do not yet exist.

This enterprise role complements rather than replaces the Workforce Strategy Leads directly supporting DSAI teams within their units. Unit-level accountabilities remain unchanged, while this role connects across them, providing the overarching DSAI people strategy, standards and governance and enabling enterprise-level choices where these are needed.


Job Description

#Hybrid


This role can be based in Cambridge, East Hanover, London or Basel, please apply only once to the appropriate location.


Key Responsibilities

  • Set the enterprise DSAI people and organization strategy.
    Translate the DSAI ambition into an integrated, future-ready agenda across workforce, organization, leadership, culture, talent and capability. Success is evident when: enterprise priorities and accountabilities are clear, adopted across units, and translated into measurable outcomes.
  • Shape strategic workforce and capability choices. Use scenarios, analytics, external insight and data storytelling to anticipate demand for scarce DSAI capabilities and recommend choices on organization design, skills, capacity, location, sourcing and workforce mix. Success is evident when: critical gaps are addressed before they constrain innovation or execution.
  • Lead the enterprise DSAI OTR. Orchestrate the enterprise talent review, integrate perspectives across units, and present implications, choices and recommendations to ECN. Success is evident when: pivotal talent, succession, capability risks and enterprise actions are visible and actively managed.
  • Establish enterprise talent and career approaches. Create differentiated career development, mobility, succession and talent-allocation mechanisms suited to DSAI roles and communities. Success is evident when: Novartis can attract, develop, deploy and retain pivotal DSAI talent across organizational boundaries.
  • Build the external DSAI talent brand and pipeline. Strengthen Novartis’ visibility as an employer of choice through targeted engagement with universities, specialist talent networks and external forums. Build early-talent pathways that attract dual technical/scientific and DSAI expertise and develop judgement, experience and leadership capability. Success is evident when: Novartis has stronger external visibility and a sustainable pipeline of scarce DSAI talent.
  • Design and create enterprise DSAI standards. Build new governance, rewards approaches, career architecture, capability frameworks, talent programs and operating approaches for a field evolving faster than established internal practices. Success is evident when: scalable standards replace fragmented local approaches and remain relevant as DSAI evolves.
  • Connect enterprise strategy and unit execution. Define decision rights, interfaces and governance so the enterprise mandate is distinct from, and complementary to, unchanged unit-level P&O accountabilities. Success is evident when: there is no duplication or accountability gap between enterprise and unit roles.
  • Influence a complex enterprise stakeholder system. Partner with at least nine ECN-1 leaders across R&D, Commercial, Operations and Global Functions, the Head of GDC, unit P&O Business Partners and Expertise Hubs to resolve enterprise trade-offs without relying on formal authority. Success is evident when: leaders move beyond unit optimization and commit to enterprise decisions.
  • Redesign work for human-AI collaboration. Guide organization, role and workflow choices that enable responsible collaboration among people, automation and AI agents while sustaining accountability and a human-cantered employee experience. Success is evident when: adoption improves productivity, innovation and decision quality.
  • Coach senior leaders, shape culture and lead transformation. Challenge and coach leaders through ambiguity, build commitment to new enterprise approaches, anticipate resistance and track adoption and benefits. Success is evident when: leadership behaviour, culture and ways of working support the DSAI strategy.

What you’ll bring to the role

Essential Criteria

  • Extensive experience of progressive P&O/HR experience, including strategic partnership with executive and ECN-1 leaders in a complex global matrix.

title: Engineering Delivery Manager System
description:
Lieu : Herstal, Belgium

The Technical Project Manager called at Thales as Engineering Delivery Management (EDM) role is focused on technical management of engineering activities. As an EDM, you will be responsible for building the team with the main focus on delivering of engineering. You will be working closely together with the engineering teams, with the aim of creating goal-driven team(s) based on engineering earned value management. Within this scope, you and the Product Design Authority are responsible for organizing the project, processes and deliverables within given time and money; Product Design Authority is technically responsible for the chosen solution, implementation and realization of this. Our Engineering department is currently expanding quickly, and we are looking for someone who can manage technical projects with significant challenges, focusing on our innovative projects within rocket systems. EDM is seen as a key capability for our business and is well positioned to provide opportunity for career growth.

RESPONSIBILITY

· Strong focus on Engineering delivery to achieve project on-time delivery and within budget

· Lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of engineering projects involving hardware, software, and system integration components

· Building a team with the same goals to create an efficient engineering chain conducting all engineering activities R&T/R&D.

· Manage cross-disciplines engineering teams, including systems engineers, embedded developers, and test engineers

· Identify and understand key impact points related to the delivery of all technical aspects of the project

· Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize delivery processes, including Agile or V-model methodologies adapted to defense projects

· Identify, assess, and mitigate technical risks and issues throughout the project lifecycle

· Define and track project schedules, milestones, and deliverables aligned with contractual commitments

· Ensure clear communication and reporting with internal stakeholders and external customers, including progress, challenges, and technical solutions

· Collaborate with program managers, people manager, quality assurance, and supply chain to ensure compliance with defense industry standards (e.g., ISO 9001, AQAP)

· Support regulatory and certification activities related to product safety, reliability, and performance

PROFILE

· Completed Master’s degree in Engineering

· You have a proven track record with minimum 5 years of Technical Project Management or technical leadership experience within an Engineering Company (high tech) in aerospace, defense, automotive, embedded system or other high-reliability industries

· Strong knowledge of systems engineering: Model Based Design Engineering (MBSE), embedded hardware and software in complex applications, system product development, and integration/testing processes

· Experience working with multidisciplinary teams on complex technical projects

· You are results-oriented, cost-conscious and you like to take initiative

· Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a highly regulated environment

· You work with a vision, and deal well with complex situations

· You have a “can-do” and “why-not-this” attitude

· You like to lead with integrity and engage stakeholders

· You have demonstrated excellent Project Management skills: scope, stakeholder, resource and risk management and able to work in multidisciplinary teams;

· Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, PowerBI, Polarion, Capella, Windchill)

· You have a positive and cooperative mind-set, looking for what to improve in his own team instead of looking at defaults in other teams

· You are enthusiastic, dynamic and have excellent communication skills.

· An experience in aeronautical, spatial, defense or automotive industry, as well as a knowledge of the standards DO-178, ARP4754 or ISO26262, is a plus.

· Fluent in French, English; knowledge of German or Dutch is a plus

Orlando, FL (Fully Onsite)

Position Summary

Thales is looking for a Solder Repair Technician II whose role involves repairing and modifying multilayer printed circuit boards using soldering equipment in accordance with FAA regulations and manufacturer requirements.


In this position, you will perform detailed soldering and rework activities, interpret technical documentation, and ensure repairs meet applicable quality and regulatory standards. Your precision, technical skill, and attention to detail will help support reliable product performance and efficient repair operations.

Key Areas of Responsibility


  • Remove and install electronic components on multilayer printed circuit boards using surface-mount and through-hole technologies and modify equipment in accordance with service bulletins and manufacturer documentation.
  • Prepare printed circuit boards for modification by installing wire links, applying adhesives, and modifying integrated circuit locations as required.
  • Perform assigned solder repair and modification activities in collaboration with experienced solder technicians and in accordance with established procedures and schedules.
  • Follow detailed written and verbal instructions for standard and alternative assignments, with completed work reviewed by senior solder technicians, management, or inspectors.
  • Complete required quality and production documentation and maintain accurate maintenance records in accordance with current quality assurance requirements.
  • Complete repairs in accordance with company ISO procedures, standard practices, and applicable quality requirements.


Minimum Qualifications


  • High school diploma or GED, with a minimum of six months of work experience performing soldering using surface-mount and through-hole technologies.
  • Ability to read, understand, and follow technical literature, engineering drawings, wiring diagrams, and verbal instructions.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and address issues encountered during repair and soldering activities.
  • Ability to accurately and thoroughly document maintenance activities performed in accordance with established procedures.
  • Experience using a personal computer and related systems required to support repair documentation and daily work activities.Ability to work flexible shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as required.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or for assuming sponsorship of an employment visa now or in the future.



Special Position Requirements


  • Familiarity with IPC J-STD and military specification soldering standards is preferred.Working knowledge of Federal Aviation Regulations and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Ability to safely work with chemicals and use required personal protective equipment in accordance with established procedures.
  • Ability to work under magnification, including the use of a microscope, for prolonged periods.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and work occasional overtime or adjusted schedules as business needs require.
  • Ability to work assigned shifts, including first shift (7:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m.), second shift (3:00 p.m.–11:30 p.m.), or third shift (11:00 p.m.–7:30 a.m.), Monday through Friday, in an FAA Repair Station and electronics lab environment.

title: Senior Staff Network Engineer
description:
About The Role


We are seeking a hands-on Senior Staff Network Engineer to support and improve the LAN, WAN, wireless, and voice infrastructure across our office, manufacturing, laboratory, and warehouse environments. You will troubleshoot at the packet level, execute production changes and proactively address issues as they arise. You will partner with network architects to implement architecture and design plans.


What You Will Do


  • Analyze packet captures using Wireshark, tcpdump, and SPAN, and correlate them with routing tables, firewall sessions, and logs to find root cause.
  • Support and troubleshoot LAN, WAN, and wireless networks across multiple sites, including routers, switches, firewalls, and ISP circuits.
  • Support voice, video, and data services, including VoIP phones and video conferencing equipment.
  • Prepare production changes for approval with implementation, validation, and rollback steps, then execute them.

title: Technology & Cybersecurity Specialist II
description:
Rea is a growing Top 100 business advisory & accounting firm providing our clients services in tax, accounting, and business consulting. As a regional accounting and business consulting firm in Ohio, companies of all sizes consider us their trusted advisors, relying on us to help them grow beyond their expectations through a variety of accounting services and professional business counsel including Managed IT Services.

Under Rea Information Services, our team provides Trusted IT Services and Solutions to small and medium-sized organizations that want a safe, secure, and stable technology environment. Our mission is to provide exceptional customer service while using technology to help businesses grow stronger both now and in the future.

Here at Rea we have a ‘People First’ culture and we focus on our employees’ well-being and professional development. With over 400 professionals and offices throughout Ohio and Florida, our firm has a culture that respects a work-life balance for our team. We also provide competitive compensation and a robust benefits plan.

The Technology & Cybersecurity Specialist II provides responsive technical support and foundational cybersecurity services to external clients. The role manages Level 1 and Level 2 service requests, project tickets, security events, alerts, and incidents, and assigned remediation activities. This position troubleshoots end-user and infrastructure issues, supports the health of client systems, helps investigate security incidents, and documents all work in Rea Information Services systems. Success requires broad technical curiosity, sound judgment, strong client service, attention to detail, and the ability to research and resolve problems independently while escalating appropriately.

Responsibilities

Client Support & Service Delivery

  • Respond to, manage, monitor, document, and resolve assigned Level 1 and Level 2 service requests, project tickets, and cybersecurity tickets.
  • Identify business impact and urgency, provide support for critical issues, and escalate when needed.
  • Monitor assigned ticket queues, communicate status and next steps, and meet established service delivery expectations.
  • Provide professional on-site and remote support while consistently delivering quality client service.
  • Follow internal service delivery policies, procedures, documentation standards, and security requirements.
  • Create and maintain accurate client documentation and record complete details of work performed in Rea Information Services systems, including accurate time reporting.

Cybersecurity Monitoring & Response

  • Monitor, analyze, and work assigned security events, alerts, and tickets.
  • Identify potential security incidents and collaborate with team members to investigate, contain, remediate, and document incidents.
  • Manage and verify the health and functionality of client identity, endpoint protection, and antivirus solutions.
  • Analyze client environments for cybersecurity concerns and provide practical recommendations that improve security posture and reduce risk.
  • Support risk, cybersecurity, and data protection services by applying security controls and remedies appropriate to the client environment.
  • Stay current on security threats and trends, conduct independent research, and apply findings to troubleshooting and remediation activities.

Systems, Endpoint, & Infrastructure Support

  • Configure, install, deploy, troubleshoot, and support workstations, printers, and other hardware at client locations or remotely.
  • Troubleshoot common issues involving Windows workstations and servers, Microsoft applications, networks, cloud services, user access, and endpoint security tools.
  • Identify alerts in remote monitoring and management systems that require action and resolve or route them to the appropriate team member.
  • Participate in assigned service desk coverage, critical ticket triage, project work, and additional duties as needed.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for assigned systems and help ensure the platform is securely, consistently, and effectively utilized across Rea Information Services’ operations and applicable client environments.

Requirements

Education

  • Post-secondary education in computer science, information systems, networking, information security, or a related discipline, or 2 years’ experience and industry training.

Experience

  • Prior full-time experience in an IT, information systems, technical support, or cybersecurity capacity preferred.
  • Experience working in a Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment preferred.
  • Previous experience supporting cybersecurity technologies, handling security alerts, or assisting with incident response preferred.

License/Certifications

  • CompTIA A+, Security+,Network+, Microsoft Fundamentals, Microsoft 365 Administration, CCNA, or comparable foundational IT or cybersecurity certifications preferred.
  • CISA, CISSP, CEH, or similar advanced security certification is valued but not required.

Travel

  • Ability to travel to clients as needed

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Embraces The Rea Way, demonstrating ethical conduct, resilience, accountability, and a proactive approach.
  • Strong customer service, written communication, verbal communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to explain technical and cybersecurity issues clearly to both business and IT stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, investigative, and research abilities with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, use discretion, protect sensitive and confidential information, meet expected timelines, and manage simultaneous priorities with coaching.
  • Solid foundational knowledge of workstations, servers, switches, routers, networking, routing practices, enterprise backup, endpoint protection, antivirus, and remote monitoring technologies.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Windows workstation and server operating systems, Microsoft 365 applications, and introductory cloud technologies.
  • Understanding of information security risks and controls, zero trust concepts, incident identification and response, security assessment practices, and common cybersecurity threats.
  • Ability to evaluate a client environment, gather relevant information, recognize risk, develop practical remedies, and recommend improvements.
  • Self-motivated and able to collaborate effectively with technical staff, cybersecurity staff, and client contacts.
  • Ability to work required business hours and provide off-hours support for critical security incidents or technology issues when needed.
  • Ability to type at least 40 words per minute.

Benefits

Rea offers a wide variety of benefits to help support our employees' health, wellness and financial goals.

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k with 3% contribution)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Adobe Creative Suite

title: PT/OT Aide -Shepherd Pathways Post Acute Brin Injury
description:
About Shepherd Center

With five decades of experience, Shepherd Center provides world-class clinical care, research, and family support for people experiencing the most complex conditions, including spinal cord and brain injuries, multi-trauma, traumatic amputations, stroke, multiple sclerosis, and pain. An elite center ranked by U.S. News as one of the nation’s top hospitals for rehabilitation, Shepherd Center is also recognized as both Spinal Cord Injury and Traumatic Brain Injury Model Systems. Shepherd is the only rehabilitation facility in the nation with an intensive care unit on-site, allowing us to care for the most complex patients and begin the rehabilitation process sooner. Shepherd Center treats thousands of patients annually with unmatched expertise and unwavering compassion to help them begin again.

Shepherd Center's culture is one of hope, humor, and hard work. You will enjoy career growth, strong relationships with co-workers, strong support from leadership, and fun activities that have kept over 12% of staff members working at Shepherd for more than 20 years.

The PT and OT Aide assists the Physical and Occupational Therapists to prepare the environment and the patient for routine care and assists the patient with routine activities of daily living as determined in treatment plan. All activities are performed under the direct supervision of a licensed OTR, PT, COTA, or PTA. This hands-on role contributes to the improvement of patient experience through rehabilitation services. This collaborative role addresses and resolves issues in order to facilitate patient recovery.

Job Responsibilities:

  • The PT and OT Aide assists in creating a welcoming environment for patient care.

  • Transports patients throughout the center.

  • Assembles equipment and adjusting it to patient needs.

  • Assists patients with transfers on the nursing units, in preparation for a PT session, or as directed.

  • Assists patient with weight shifts and other daily activities (grooming, feeding, dressing, toileting, bathing etc.) or assigned OT therapy activities.

  • Conducts assigned OT groups or assisting PTs or PTAs in a group setting.

  • Maintains the therapy and nursing equipment and environment.

  • Cleans and returns wheelchairs, bathroom equipment, and other equipment as assigned.

  • Completes assigned clerical duties.

  • Instructs new employees and volunteers in departmental maintenance tasks.

  • Attends and actively contributes to department meetings.

  • Performs consistent with Shepherd Center standards, clinical policies, and procedures.

  • Practices proper safety techniques in accordance with Center and departmental policies and procedures. Responsible for the reporting of employee/patient/visitor injuries or accidents, or other safety issues to the supervisor and in the occurrence notification system.

  • Monitors and ensures compliance with all regulatory requirements, organizational standards, and policies and procedures related to area of responsibility. Identifies potential risk areas within area of responsibility and supports problem resolution process.

  • Performs other duties as required/requested/assigned.

Required Minimum Education

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

​

Required Minimum Certification

  • No minimum certification

Required Minimum Experience

  • Previous therapy aide or clinical/healthcare experience preferred.

Required Minimum Skills

  • Basic computer skills.

  • This is a support role that requires an individual to be able to interact directly with patients in a positive and supportive manner.

  • Ability to learn and operate therapy equipment.

  • Must display knowledge of growth, development and the ability to obtain, interpret and disseminate information in terms of age specific patient needs (adolescent, adult and geriatric.

  • Ability to follow instructions and problem solve.

  • Takes responsibility for growing professionally and seek opportunities for improving skills.

  • Communicates effectively using timely verbal, non-verbal and written communication.

  • Willingly adapts to changing work demands and work environment.

  • Demonstrates critical thinking skills and makes sound judgments to monitor and respond to patient needs or changes in condition.

  • Completes orientation and initial assessment of competency successfully by determined due date.

  • Completes mandatory education and annual competency assessment requirements by determined due date.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree in exercise science, health science, biology or related field of study preferred.

  • Previous experience with patients with Spinal Cord Injury, Traumatic Brain Injury Stroke, Concussion and Vestibular Disorders.

Physical Demands

  • Uses body, tools, or special devices to safely, effectively, and efficiently to move, guide, or place patients. Involves some latitude for judgement with regard to precision attained and the selection of what adaptive device(s) to utilize.

description:
Summary

The Senior Domain Architect, Data Management, is a key technical advisor within Workiva’s Data Management Practice. This role supports customers and partners through onboarding, implementation, and adoption of Workiva solutions, applying expertise in data management, integration, and automation to drive long-term value. Acting as a bridge between Sales, Engineering, and Customer & Partner Experience teams, the Architect helps organizations realize the full potential of the Workiva platform while staying aligned with broader technology solutions.


The Senior Domain Architect engages directly with customers and partners, including at executive levels, to design and deliver scalable data management solutions. By fostering strong relationships, sharing best practices, and guiding adoption, the Architect ensures reliable, efficient outcomes that strengthen customer success and long-term value with Workiva.


What You'll Do

  • 6+ years of related career experience in customer-facing roles, preferably Technical Customer Success, Solution Architecture, or Consulting

  • Strong understanding of APIs, including REST and SOAP protocols, JSON/XML formats, and hands-on API execution through scripting.
  • Solid knowledge of data engineering, data warehousing, ETL processes, and SQL query development
  • Strong problem-solving and technical diagnostic skills.
  • Data-driven and detail-oriented with the ability to manage priorities independently
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level presentations
  • Proven ability to build credibility, influence stakeholders, and drive cross-functional alignment
  • Demonstrated commitment to customer success and long-term value creation

✅ Salary range in the US: $129,000.00 - $210,000.00

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. title: Overnight Bell
description:

title: Määräaikaiset työntekijätehtävät kevät 2027
description:
Tarjoamme erilaisia ja eripituisia, enintään neljän kuukauden mittaisia työntekijätehtävien sijaisuuksia Wood & Energy liiketoiminta-alueelle keväälle 2027. Tehtävien sijaintipaikkoja ovat Anjalankoski, Imatra ja Varkaus.


Tämä haku koskee työntekijätehtäviä terminaalitoiminnoissa, esimerkiksi puutavaran käsittelyssä, varastoinnissa ja mittauksessa. Työaikamuoto on vuorotyö. Määräaikaisuustarve voi pohjautua poissaolojen sijaisuuksiin, osa-aikaisuuksiin, tehtäväkiertoihin tai vastaaviin.


Toivomme sinulta


Tehtävät edellyttävät vähintään B-luokan ajo-oikeutta ja kokemusta isoilla työkoneilla ajamisesta. Odotamme valmiutta vuorotyöhön sekä sujuvaa tietokoneenkäyttötaitoa, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja vankkaa paineensietokykyä. Edellytämme lisäksi sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä turvallisuuskeskeistä ajattelua jokapäiväisessä toiminnassa.


Lisätietoja


Voit lähettää meille hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta viimeistään 15.11.2026.


Lisätietoja sijaisuuksista antaa rekrytointiasiantuntija Laura Boll, laura.boll@storaenso.com.


Jos työtehtävän vastaanottaminen edellyttää hyväksyttyä työhöntulotarkastusta, sisältää tarkastus myös huumausainetestin.


Metsä on Stora Enson ytimessä, ja uskomme, että kaikki, mikä tänään valmistetaan fossiilisista materiaaleista, voidaan huomenna tehdä puusta. Olemme johtava uusiutuvien pakkaus-, biomateriaali- ja puurakentamisen tuotteiden valmistaja sekä yksi maailman suurimmista yksityisistä metsänomistajista. Luomme yhteiskunnalle parempia vaihtoehtoja nopeuttamalla siirtymistä biopohjaiseen kiertotalouteen. Pyrimme vaikuttamaan myönteisesti luontoon ja hyödyntämään kuitupohjaista uusiutuvaa materiaalia mahdollisimman tehokkaasti. Suomen puunhankinnan liiketoiminta luo arvoa vastuullisella metsänhoidolla, kilpailukykyisellä puunhankinnalla ja innovaatioilla.

title: EMS Revenue Specialist
description:
Overview

EMS Revenue Specialist

The EMS Revenue Specialist is responsible for working directly with the Health Insurance Companies to resolve open balances. This could include but not limited: utilizing payer portals to check claim status, updating patients’ insurance policy, reviewing / updating the ICD-10 code listed, sending corrected claims and/or appeals.

All representatives will conduct insurance verification as needed and are required to complete prebilling training to qualify for the role.


Responsibilities

Responsibilities of the EMS Revenue Specialist

  • Places and receives calls regarding billing insurance questions and other patient service activities.
  • Process accounts according to the action required to resolve account balances.
  • Resolving insurance carrier denials, appealing claims, contacting carriers on open accounts, and responding to insurance carrier correspondence and/or inquiries.
  • Comfortable communicating with any caller including customers, agencies, facilities, and hospitals.
  • Employ one-step resolution practices for clients and patients through open lines of communication.
  • Research patient accounts to verify all health insurance coverages. Audit patient accounts to verify proper billing process was followed.
  • Compute adjustments based on EOB's remittance and insurance contracts.
  • Ensure accuracy in data entry and consistent attention to detail.
  • Collect outstanding balances as well as identify, address, and resolve account discrepancies while following company policy and procedures.
  • Demonstrates knowledge and compliance of insurance, local, state, and federal billing.
  • Ability to complete tasks efficiently both individually and in a group environment.
  • Handle assigned correspondence fulfilling any other duties as assigned by managerial staff.

Key Skills of the EMS Revenue Specialist

  • Well-versed with medical billing practices that include an understanding of insurance billing codes, regulations, and procedures.
  • Ability to investigate and resolve software issues, billing errors and disputes.
  • Effective communication skills with clients, insurance companies, patients, staff members and management.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Must have great attention to detail with high accuracy.

Qualifications

Qualifications of the EMS Revenue Specialist

  • College preferred but not required.
  • Minimum two years’ experience in customer care, account management or similar role.
  • Ability to read and understand the Explanation of Benefits or Electronic Remittance Advice.
  • Understands the difference between rejections and denials as well as working accounts.
  • Healthcare knowledge is preferred.
  • Must be a quick learner and motivated individual with excellent verbal communications skills.
  • Ability to “multi-task” and manage spurs of high call volume / stress.
  • Positive, can-do attitude and with good judgement demonstrating ability to escalate account when needed.
  • Ability to receive and implement feedback.

Computer and Office Qualifications of the EMS Revenue Specialist

  • Computer literacy is a must; Typing skillset of at least 45 WPM is highly desired
  • Experience working in an active office environment.
  • Must be able to work with 2 monitors and split screens to operate multiple sites simultaneously.
  • Must be able to sit / stand for 8 hours minimum in an office environment
  • Must be able to use Word, Excel Spreadsheet, Email, Chat Applications, and other software applications.
  • Must be able to read, comprehend, and apply job-related rules, policies, and procedures.

Benefits

  • Opportunities for career advancement
  • Competitive wages
  • Ability to receive on demand pay before pay day
  • 401(k) with company contribution
  • Medical, Dental, Vision & Life Insurance
  • Voluntary Insurance (short-term disability, critical illness, accidental & legal)
  • Company Paid Life Insurance and Long-Term Disability
  • Paid vacation & sick time
  • Holiday pay
  • Referral bonus available


Salary Range

USD $21.00 - USD $26.00 /Hr. rates offered based on years of experience

title: Manager, MRO Inventory and Soft Services
description:
Use Your Power for Purpose

The Manager, MRO and Soft Services, role provides site oversight and subject matter expertise for Maintenance, Repair, and Operations (MRO) inventory programs and Soft Services supporting Andover manufacturing, laboratory, utility, and infrastructure operations. The role owns assigned site execution, supplier performance, inventory process health, financial stewardship, quality system support, and continuous improvement to enable safe, compliant, reliable, and cost-effective site operations.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Accountable for site execution and performance oversight of MRO Inventory and Soft Services programs delivered through third-party service providers, ensuring compliance with Pfizer requirements, regulatory expectations, and contractual performance standards.
  • Serve as the site subject matter expert for MRO inventory management, spare parts governance, stockroom operations, material management processes, and associated EAMS/CMMS inventory functionality.
  • Partner across Maintenance, Asset Management, Reliability Engineering, Operations, Quality, Procurement, Finance, Engineering, EHS, and supplier organizations to improve material readiness, inventory accuracy, service delivery, and maintenance execution support.
  • Manage assigned budgets, forecasts, accruals, spend management activities, inventory valuation, supplier spend trends, cost improvement opportunities, and related financial reporting routines.
  • Serve as Local Process Owner (LPO), as assigned, for MRO Inventory Management and Pest Control programs, including procedure governance, quality record support, audit readiness, and quality system activities such as Change Controls, CAPAs, Deviations, and risk assessments.
  • Use EAMS, SAP, business intelligence tools, operational metrics, and structured problem solving to identify risks, monitor performance, improve data quality, and drive sustainable operational excellence.
  • Represent the site in applicable network and above-site forums, supporting deployment of standardized processes, best practices, digital enablement, and Global Engineering initiatives.

Financial Accountability

  • Responsible for assigned IFM Soft Services ($6M) and MRO Inventory program budgets ($6M), forecasts, accruals, spend management activities, inventory valuation routines, supplier spend visibility, and cost improvement opportunities.
  • Supports financial governance through SAP, EAMS/CMMS, inventory management systems, supplier performance metrics, and business intelligence reporting.

Supervision

  • Role is expected to lead through cross-functional influence, supplier governance, matrixed program leadership, and partnership with internal stakeholders.



BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Applicant must have a bachelor's degree with at least 4 years ofexperience; OR a master's degree with at least 2 years of experience; ORa PhD with 0+ years of experience; OR as associate's degree with 8 yearsof experience; OR a high school diploma (or equivalent) and 10 years ofrelevant experience
  • Relevant experience in manufacturing, maintenance, reliability engineering, facilities management, inventory management, supply chain, operations, finance, or a related technical field.
  • Experience working in quality systems and regulated environments, including participation in audits, inspections, deviations, CAPAs, change controls, risk assessments, or procedural governance.
  • Experience managing budgets, forecasts, accruals, cost control activities, financial reporting, supplier spend, or inventory valuation processes.
  • Working knowledge of EAMS/CMMS inventory functionality, material master data, catalog governance, spare parts governance, stockroom operations, and MRO inventory control processes.
  • Working knowledge of SAP or similar enterprise financial, purchasing, inventory valuation, procurement, or reporting systems.
  • Ability to translate operational, supplier, inventory, and financial data into actionable insights using dashboards, analytics, and business intelligence tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence stakeholders, manage competing priorities, assess risk, and escalate issues appropriately in a regulated manufacturing environment.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or other regulated manufacturing environments preferred.
  • Experience with outsourced IFM service delivery models, supplier governance, MRO inventory optimization, spare parts strategy, materials governance, or stockroom process improvement preferred.
  • Knowledge of reliability, asset care, maintenance planning, maintenance execution, inventory optimization, lifecycle cost management, cGMP, EHS expectations, and documentation practices preferred.
  • Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA), Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), or similar structured problem-solving methods preferred



PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to perform complex data analysis and interpret operational, supplier, inventory, and financial data to support business decisions.
  • Ability to periodically access manufacturing, utility, laboratory, warehouse, stockroom, and facility areas as required to support assigned programs and supplier oversight.
  • May require occasional walking, standing, bending, or use of required personal protective equipment when entering operational areas.

NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

  • Primarily standard business hours; occasional off-hours support may be required for business continuity, shutdown/turnaround activities, supplier escalations, audits, inspections, or urgent site needs.
  • Occasional travel may be required for supplier, network, or above-site program activities.
  • Must comply with applicable site safety, cGMP, gowning, and controlled-area requirements when entering operational areas.

title: Safety and Emergency Management Specialist
description:
Job Description:

The Emergency Management, Business Continuity & Safety Specialist supports care sites by advancing preparedness, response, and resilience capabilities while promoting a safe environment for caregivers and patients. This role operates across geographically dispersed sites not tied to a single campus and partners closely with leaders to ensure readiness for emergencies and continuity of operations.
This position provides broad support across emergency management, business continuity, life safety, occupational safety, industrial hygiene, and security functions. The Specialist plays a key role in relationship management, rounding, training, and incident support, including supporting Administrator on Call (AOC) command structures and training.

Essential Functions


Emergency Management & Incident Command

  • Supports implementation of emergency management programs across sites within the market or area.
  • Assists with activation and operational support of incident command, including support of Administrator on Call (AOC) structures.
  • Provides coordination and support during incidents to ensure effective communication, situational awareness, and adherence to response protocols.
  • Plans, facilitates, and evaluates exercises (e.g., drills, tabletops) tailored to outpatient settings.
  • Contributes to risk assessments and mitigation planning at the clinic level.

Business Continuity

  • Supports development, maintenance, and validation of business continuity plans across ambulatory sites.
  • Partners with leaders to identify critical functions, dependencies, and recovery strategies.
  • Assists with downtime preparedness and response (e.g., IT disruptions, facility impacts).
  • Helps identify gaps and supports implementation of continuity improvements.

Market Engagement & Relationship Management

  • Builds and maintains effective working relationships with market, clinic, and/or operational leaders.
  • Conducts routine rounding to assess preparedness, reinforce standards, and identify risks.
  • Serves as a market-facing resource for emergency management, continuity, and safety guidance.
  • Promotes alignment between system standards and clinic-level practices.

Regulatory and Life Safety Support

  • Supports compliance with life safety, emergency preparedness, and regulatory requirements (e.g., CMS, Joint Commission, OSHA, and EPA).
  • Assists with evacuation planning, fire safety, and safety drills and conducts safety rounding, safety inspections, and supports mitigation of hazards.
  • Supports workplace violence prevention efforts, including training coordination and awareness initiatives.

Occupational Safety, Industrial Hygiene & Security Support

  • Provides basic support for occupational safety programs, including hazard identification and follow-up.
  • Assists with industrial hygiene concerns in partnership with subject matter experts.
  • Assists with implementation of safety and health programs such as hazard communication
  • Supports incident investigation and assists with root cause analysis
  • Supports clinic-level security awareness and response coordination.
  • Escalates complex issues to appropriate specialized teams.

Training & Preparedness

  • Delivers, tracks, and/or coordinates training for leaders and caregivers on safety, emergency response, and business continuity.
  • Supports Administrator on Call (AOC) training and readiness activities.
  • Reinforces preparedness through ongoing education, engagement, and just-in-time training.

Additional Posting Details:

  • This role will participate in an on-call rotation following appropriate training and preparation for on-call responsibilities.
  • This is a hybrid role supporting multiple facilities across the Canyon South and Southern Utah market areas.

Skills

  • Program Coordination
  • Risk Assessment and Analysis
  • Emergency Management Procedures
  • Incident Investigations
  • Incident Command System (ICS) Knowledge
  • Presenting information / training
  • Interpersonal and Leadership Skills
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Critical Thinking / Problem Solving
  • Relationship Building
  • Technical Writing / Documentation

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience in emergency management, business continuity, safety, or related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships across multiple sites and teams.
  • Knowledge of regulatory and accreditation standards (e.g., CMS, Joint Commission, OSHA).
  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook); ability to prepare reports.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to effectively communicate emergency management and safety information to diverse audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Attention to detail and strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Emergency Management, Public Health, Safety, Healthcare Administration, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience supporting ambulatory care or distributed healthcare environments.
  • Familiarity with incident command systems and healthcare emergency response frameworks.
  • Familiarity with industrial hygiene, occupational health, hazardous materials, and environmental compliance
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CEM, CBCP, ASP).
  • OSHA 30-hour certificate
  • Experience facilitating exercises, drills, or training programs.

Physical Requirements

  • Ongoing need for employee to see and read information, labels, monitors, identify equipment and supplies, and be able to assess customer needs.
  • Frequent interactions with customers that require employee to communicate as well as understand spoken information, alarms, needs, and issues quickly and accurately.
  • Manual dexterity of hands and fingers to manipulate complex and delicate equipment with precision and accuracy. This includes frequent computer, phone, and cable set-up and use.
  • Expected to lift and utilize full range of movement to transport, pull, and push equipment. Will also work on hands and knees and bend to set-up, troubleshoot, lift, and carry supplies and equipment. Typically includes items of varying weights, up to and including heavy items.
  • For roles requiring driving: Expected to drive a vehicle which requires sitting, seeing and reading signs, traffic signals, and other vehicles.
