En rolle med stor faglig påvirkning

Som Principal Engineer i Detalj & Trumf får du en sentral rolle i å utvikle teknologien som binder sammen handel, lojalitet, data og partnere.

Du kobler langsiktige ambisjoner med konkrete valg i løsningene vi bygger, og hjelper teamene med å ta gode beslutninger.


Du leder gjennom faglig tyngde, samarbeid og tillit. Rollen har ikke personalansvar, men gir stor mulighet til å påvirke arkitektur, tekniske prinsipper og utviklingspraksis på tvers av team.


En viktig del av oppgaven blir å sikre at tjenestene våre kan brukes og kombineres på nye måter. Det innebærer også å legge til rette for agentbasert handel, der KI-assistenter hjelper kundene med å planlegge og gjennomføre innkjøp.


Dette får du jobbe med

  • Sette og videreutvikle teknisk retning sammen med teamene, og omsette den til løsninger som gir verdi for kundene og forretningen.
  • Utforme arkitektur som gjør tjenester enklere å videreutvikle, gjenbruke og koble sammen på tvers av produkter og kanaler.
  • Veilede tech leads og seniorutviklere i tekniske valg og arkitekturspørsmål.
  • Drive frem felles prinsipper og god utviklingspraksis som styrker kvaliteten og hjelper teamene fremover.
  • Håndtere tekniske avveininger mellom nye behov, teknisk gjeld, sikkerhet, stabilitet og utviklingstempo.
  • Utforske nye muligheter innen KI og agentbasert handel, med utgangspunkt i reelle kundebehov.
  • Styrke fagmiljøet gjennom kunnskapsdeling, sparring og kontinuerlig forbedring.


Du jobber tett med produkteiere, andre Principal Engineers, tech leads, utviklere, produktdesignere, QA og plattformteam.

Vi tror de beste løsningene oppstår når vi løser problemer sammen, i tett samarbeid med butikkansatte, kjøpmenn og kunder.


Hvem er du?

Du har solid erfaring som seniorutvikler, tech lead eller lead engineer i komplekse systemlandskap. Du ser sammenhengen mellom teknologi, forretning og organisasjon, og vet at god arkitektur må fungere i praksis.


Vi tror du vil lykkes i rollen hvis du:

  • Har erfaring med å sette teknisk retning og skape oppslutning på tvers av flere team.
  • Er en trygg sparringspartner som utfordrer konstruktivt og gjør andre gode.
  • Klarer å gjøre komplekse problemstillinger forståelige og omsette dem til konkrete valg.
  • Tar beslutninger når det trengs, og justerer kursen når ny kunnskap tilsier det.
  • Kombinerer et langsiktig perspektiv med interesse for det teamene bygger her og nå.
  • Er nysgjerrig på hvordan KI og nye handlemønstre kan skape bedre kundeopplevelser.
  • Kommuniserer godt på norsk og engelsk.


Du motiveres av å løse viktige problemer sammen med andre og av å se at gode tekniske valg gjør en forskjell i kundenes hverdag.


Her møter du blant annet:

  • En datadrevet verdikjede som omfatter over 2 000 butikker.
  • Lojalitets- og dataplattformer som brukes av millioner av mennesker.
  • Store datamengder og høye krav til sikkerhet og tilgjengelighet.
  • Satsinger på elektriske lastebiler, robotikk og automatisering.


Det gir oss spennende problemer å løse og muligheten til å skape forbedringer som merkes i stor skala.


Et sterkt fagmiljø og en god arbeidshverdag

Du får kolleger som deler kunnskap, diskuterer løsninger og hjelper hverandre videre. Vi har lav terskel for ideer og initiativ, og ønsker deg som vil bidra til både faglig utvikling og et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø.


Vil du være med på å gjøre fremtidens handel enklere, smartere og mer relevant for kundene?

Do you want to work with technology that impacts the everyday lives of millions of people?

Join NorgesGruppen Data, an exciting workplace with strong professional communities and significant influence. We are more than 300 skilled employees working closely across the entire NorgesGruppen value chain, from farm to table.

With us, IT is an integral part of the business, and we invest heavily in the solutions of the future. As part of our cross-functional environment, you will help develop and deliver technology solutions that truly make a difference in people’s daily lives.

We are located in modern offices at Kalbakken and Skøyen in Oslo.

title: Global Program Manager, Customer Experience Center
description:
Job Description Summary

The Global Program Manager is the Senior Director’s second-in-command and the operational backbone of the CEC. You will turn the CEC operating model into reality: the visit process, the systems that run it, the vendors that support it and the budget that funds it. Before opening, you will drive launch readiness across design, equipment, content, installation and technology. After opening, you will run a program built to deliver white-glove experiences at scale, from roughly 170 visits a year toward 300.
This is a build role. You will design the standard work, runbooks and governance, stand up the Nexus briefing platform and its Salesforce integration, and give the CEC the data it needs to prove its commercial value.

Job Description

Position Summary


GE HealthCare is creating a 30,000-square-foot Customer Experience Center (CEC) flagship at its Waukesha campus, targeted to open in September 2027. The CEC will bring the full enterprise portfolio to life through care pathways, clinical workflows, multimodality solutions, digital and AI capabilities, software, services and lifecycle value. It is a strategic account platform, not a product showroom: a place where health system leaders experience what GE HealthCare can do for their patients, clinicians and business.


The Global Program Manager is the Senior Director’s second-in-command and the operational backbone of the CEC. You will turn the CEC operating model into reality: the visit process, the systems that run it, the vendors that support it and the budget that funds it. Before opening, you will drive launch readiness across design, equipment, content, installation and technology. After opening, you will run a program built to deliver white-glove experiences at scale, from roughly 170 visits a year toward 300.


This is a build role. You will design the standard work, runbooks and governance, stand up the Nexus briefing platform and its Salesforce integration, and give the CEC the data it needs to prove its commercial value.


Why This Role Matters

  • Enterprise narrative made real. The CEC is the physical proof point for GE HealthCare’s shift from product-led communications to outcomes-based, care-pathway storytelling across Advanced Imaging Solutions, Patient Care Solutions (PCS), Pharmaceuticals Diagnosis Product (PDx), Services and Software Solutions.
  • Direct commercial impact. Executive briefing environments are among the highest-converting assets in B2B healthcare selling. The CEC will be measured on influenced pipeline, deal velocity, win rate and customer satisfaction.
  • Built from day one. You join the founding team alongside the Senior Director, shaping how the center works before its doors open, not inheriting someone else’s playbook.
  • One enterprise, one room. The CEC is one of the few places where every business unit shows up together, as one enterprise offering, in front of the customer.

Scope and Working Relationships

  • Team: Founding member of a CEC team of ~7 at opening, growing to 14 roles at full scale. Works closely with the Briefing Manager, Operations Manager and Content Strategy & Governance Manager.
  • Budget: Manages day-to-day budget execution, purchase orders, invoices, forecasts and cost tracking for the CEC program.
  • Key partners: Sales and Strategic Accounts, Segment and Product Marketing, Global Real Estate & Facilities, IT/AV, Digital and MarTech (Salesforce), Finance, Procurement, Legal/Compliance, and agency and vendor partners.

Phase 1 — Pre-Opening: January through September 2027

The mandate is to get the CEC ready to run on day one: process, tools, vendors and readiness gates in place and tested.


Program Management and Launch Readiness

  • Own the integrated master schedule across design, equipment, content, installation and go-live readiness; maintain the risk register, decision log and escalation paths.
  • Run launch readiness checkpoints, go/no-go reviews, soft launch and dry-run visits; track and close punch-list items.
  • Manage change requests and scope control, and assess impact to schedule and cost.

Operating Process and Standard Work

  • Turn the CEC briefing lifecycle (pre-brief, briefing day, post-briefing) into documented standard work, checklists, service levels and runbooks for every visit type and service tier.
  • Standardize processes for customer visits, internal meetings and events: travel, registration, AV, catering, billing and visitor logistics.
  • Define the compliance workflow for visits, including Transfer of Value documentation, NDAs, photography and audit requirements, with Legal and Compliance.

Systems and Measurement

  • Implement, enforce and standardize the Nexus briefing management platform; scope and deliver enhancements for intake, agendas, speaker and SME coordination, and calendars.
  • Lead the Nexus–Salesforce integration so every visit, attendee and outcome is captured against the opportunity.
  • Build reporting dashboards for visit volume, CSAT, influenced pipeline and revenue, win rate, utilization and cost per visit.

Vendors and Budget

  • Lead vendor selection, contracting and negotiation for AV, catering, event services and operations; set and monitor SLAs, including AV maintenance.
  • Manage budgets, PO issuance, invoice approvals and forecasts; reduce spend through procurement best practice and by minimizing change orders.

Phase 2 — Post-Opening: September 2027 Forward

The mandate shifts from building the program to running it reliably and proving its value.

  • Run day-to-day program operations, calendar and capacity planning, vendor performance and budget.
  • Report CEC performance and commercial contribution monthly and quarterly; use the data to improve the process and direct investment.
  • Continuously improve the visit process and tools as volume grows; prepare the model to scale to additional centers and regions.
  • Host and plan customer engagements as needed, coach sales leads on visit strategy, and write copy for event communications and printed materials.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Readiness: CEC opens on schedule with standard work, Nexus, Salesforce integration and vendor contracts live.
  • Operational excellence: visits delivered on time and to standard; on-time readiness gates; few day-of escalations.
  • Data and insight: every visit captured in Nexus and Salesforce; performance dashboards in use by CEC and commercial leadership.
  • Financial discipline: delivery against budget, controlled change orders and improving cost per visit.

Qualifications


Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Project Management, Events, Healthcare Management or a related field.
  • 7+ years of program or operations management experience; experience with large-scale events, visitor programs or briefing centers preferred.
  • Proven experience managing vendors, budgets, POs and invoices at scale.
  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional programs, establish effective processes, runbooks and governance, and align diverse or competing stakeholder priorities around a shared vision.
  • Familiarity with compliance workflows in regulated industries (medical device or healthcare preferred).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Experience building and managing data and dashboards that measure program and project health, performance and outcomes.
  • Proven ability to partner effectively with Sales to advance commercial priorities and positively influence revenue.
  • Willingness to be based in the Milwaukee / Waukesha area with regular on-site presence.

Preferred

  • Healthcare industry experience (medical devices, imaging, diagnostics).
  • Hands-on experience with briefing management platforms and Salesforce, including reporting and integrations.
  • Experience opening a new facility or launching a new customer-facing program.
  • Experience working with creative agencies and digital/CMS production teams; global events and multinational vendor oversight.
  • PMP or change management certification.

What We Value

  • Builds structure where none exists, and keeps it simple.
  • Calm under pressure on visit day; sweats the details so Sales can focus on the customer.
  • Uses data to make decisions and tell the CEC’s story.

Quality and Compliance

  • Comply with GE HealthCare’s Quality Manual, Quality Management System and all applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Complete all required training within defined timelines.
  • Proactively identify, document and report any quality or compliance concerns.

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $100,000.00-$150,000.00 Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

Additional Information

GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

While GE HealthCare does not currently require U.S. employees to be vaccinated against COVID-19, some GE HealthCare customers have vaccination mandates that may apply to certain GE HealthCare employees.

title: Off Premise Specialist
description:
Job Description

Company Summary

We’re the producers, creators and marketers of beer, wine and spirits brands that people love. At Constellation Brands, we’re driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver products and experiences that resonate now, tomorrow and well into the future. Because of this approach, we’re the fastest-growing large CPG company in the U.S. at retail, with operations in the U.S., Mexico, New Zealand and Italy. Our premium portfolio of iconic brands like Corona Extra, Modelo Especial, Kim Crawford, Robert Mondavi, The Prisoner, High West Whiskey, and more drive industry-leading growth for us today. But we’re just getting started. Our ability to stay on the forefront of consumer trends has fueled our success since our founding in 1945 and will guide us in creating the next generation of products and experiences Worth Reaching For.

Position Summary

This position supports the off-premise sales component of the distributor's market plan for their geographic area of responsibility. The assigned area of responsibility will be aligned with one or more of Constellation Brands Beer Division’s (CBBD) top off-premise accounts in a priority DMA. This position is responsible for driving off-premise sales through effective business planning, retail execution, customer relationship management, and budget management. This individual will function as a high-level advisor to select Key Account Managers, National Sales Managers, and Market Development Managers on all items related to off-premise sales.

Responsibilities

Account management
  • Sell new and expanded distribution to off-premise accounts.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with the owners & managers of the top Off-Premise accounts within area of responsibility.
  • Support training and development initiatives for wholesaler off-premise team and with key off-premise accounts.
  • Prioritize existing accounts and deploy Off-Premise resources (materials, budgets) to achieve set CBBD market goals.
  • Identify market specific business development opportunities.

Execution inspection
  • Visit and review accounts for compliance with CBBD's retail execution standards.
  • Identify and communicate execution issues to Market Development Managers and/or Key and National Sales Managers; ensure follow-up is made and issue is resolved.
Sales Planning
  • Serve as a high-level advisor to the area Key Account Manager and/or Market Development Manager in all Off-Premise sales related planning.
  • Assist Market Development Managers to develop the Off-Premise component of his/her annual business plan including, sales, distribution and promotional efforts for that specific market.
  • Determine programming and promotional plans/spends needed to drive sales and to achieve Plan.
  • Evaluate results vs. plan on a regular basis, identify sales deficiency areas, and develop corrective programming in order to improve performance.
  • Conduct surveys in conjunction with key CBBD promotional windows.

Pricing
  • Review, evaluate, and suggest pricing programs in order to ensure CBBD's competitiveness in the market place.

Marketing & Promotions
  • Organize and coordinate promotional activity in area of responsibility
  • Utilize available marketing resources in order to maximize sales and achieve plan.

New Products/Packaging
  • Develop and execute new product/packaging rollout plans for his/her area of Off-Premise responsibility.
  • Work with sales team to build plans that identify target package/brand opportunities, target account list, and resource allocation needed to achieve set goals.
  • Proactively identify challenges that new product introductions face in area of responsibility.

Performs additional duties and responsibilities as required.

title: Engineer - Java, AWS
description:
Job Title

Engineer - Java, AWS

Job Description

So, who are we?
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn’t pivot to innovation; it’s how we’ve always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that’s rare in established businesses.


The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we’ll give you the platform to define what comes next.


Join us at IG – the future gets built here.


Your Team:
Join IG’s Prime Core team, which is responsible for building the open-spec trading APIs and solutions that support institutional and retail clients, delivering secure, high-performance, low-latency solutions.


Your role in the Team’s Success:
Our team sits within the IG Prime division, serving institutional and retail businesses. The Prime Core team owns the APIs that connect IG to institutional clients, brokers and partners across global markets — onboarding client accounts, funding, and the trading and market-data platform that our largest clients depend on every trading day.

That means real-time price distribution, order and execution flow, and reference data, running continuously through the trading day. When these systems degrade, clients notice immediately — so resilience, correctness and latency aren’t aspirations here; they’re the job. You’ll join at a genuinely interesting point: we’re building a new suite of cloud-native trading APIs.


What you’ll do:

  • Write production Java that other people have to maintain: tested, readable, and honest about its edge cases.
  • Work in a spec-driven, AI-assisted development workflow — specifying intent clearly, using AI tooling to move fast, and reviewing what comes back with a critical eye.
  • Contribute to design discussions and technical decisions. You won’t be handed a spec and left alone; you’ll be in the room while we work out what to build.
  • Deploy and run what you build in AWS, and learn how the cloud behaves when things go wrong.
  • Investigate production issues alongside more experienced engineers — working from logs, metrics, traces and JVM diagnostics to get from symptom to root cause under time pressure.
  • Grow into deeper ownership of services as you build confidence in the systems.

What you’ll need:

  • Experience: 3–5 years of professional Java development experience, including hands-on AWS.
  • Java: solid commercial experience writing Java in a production environment — this is the core of the role, and the thing we’ll dig into most.
  • JVM: a real understanding of how the JVM behaves at runtime — memory management and garbage collection, the Java memory model, and how threads actually interact rather than how we hope they do.
  • Concurrency and multi-threading: working knowledge, including the ways concurrent code fails: visibility problems, contention, and bugs that only appear under load.
  • JVM diagnostics: practical skills reading thread and heap dumps, reasoning about GC behaviour, profiling, and narrowing down a memory leak or a contention problem rather than restarting and hoping.
  • Spring: experience with the Spring Framework, ideally Spring Boot.
  • AWS: hands-on experience — you’ve deployed and debugged something real in the cloud, and you understand the services you’ve used rather than just the commands you ran.
  • AI coding tools: practical experience using them as part of your normal workflow, and the judgement to know when their output is wrong. We care much more about how critically you evaluate AI-generated code than how much of it you produce.
  • Linux: comfort on Linux, including basic shell scripting.
  • Curiosity: when something doesn’t add up, and the persistence to keep digging rather than working around it.
  • Willingness to ask questions early and often. In a domain this specific, the engineers who learn fastest are the ones who ask.

The perks:
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won’t pretend otherwise. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off... the list goes on.

  • Matched giving for your fundraising activity
  • Hybrid working model – three days a week in the office
  • Performance-related bonuses
  • Insurance and medical plans
  • Free access to the LinkedIn Learning platform
  • Contribution to gym memberships and more
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Free lunch/snacks
  • A day off on your birthday
  • Two days’ volunteering leave per year

title: Senior Salesforce AI Developer
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Salesforce AI Developer to join our team and help build a secure, scalable, and intelligent Salesforce platform. You’ll design and develop autonomous agents, reusable AI skills, and multi-agent orchestration frameworks - while enforcing the security architecture, trust layers, and observability practices that keep every agent interaction safe, auditable, and grounded in real business data.

Do you get excited about orchestrating multiple agents across business domains? If so, we’d love to hear from you! This role combines technical leadership with hands-on development — designing custom MCP servers, driving AI-client integration initiatives, and collaborating closely with AI Architects to build on Salesforce.com, Agentforce Studio, SIForce, Data 360, Headless 360, Slack Integration, and related technologies.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Design, build, and deploy Agentforce Agents that leverage live CRM data - account planning, opportunity pipeline health, and quoting information - to assist our sales and operations teams in real time.
  • Architect multi-agent orchestration patterns using Agent Fabric, deploy specialized agents across business domains while leading handoffs, context passing, and fallback logic.
  • Design and develop custom MCP Servers, including OAuth 2.0 setup using Data 360 and Headless 360 to expose actions and agents to external AI clients.
  • Implement MCP observability practices including trace logging, scoped access controls, security testing and protocols such as Agentforce Testing Center, guardrails/prompt-injection testing, Einstein Trust Layer, Salesforce Code Analyzer (PMD) and CRUD/FLS.
  • Design and maintain integrations between Salesforce and external systems - APIs, Platform Events/CDC, custom connectors, web services.
  • Identify business requirements and convert business/functional specifications into detailed technical specifications for agent-driven solutions.
  • Provide platform and user support including onboarding and addressing issues related to AI client users. Partner closely with AI Architects and functional teams (Sales, Partner Programs, Enterprise Support, IT).

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or relevant field, verifiable by transcripts, or equivalent experience.
  • 12+ years of experience architecting and developing full-stack solutions on Salesforce’s ecosystem.
  • Practical knowledge of multi-agent orchestration - agent chaining, context windowing, delegation, and conflict resolution across Agent Fabric.
  • Hands-on experience with general MCP or equivalent experience and API integrations (tailored MCP server environments, REST APIs, OAuth/PKCE), Python or JavaScript for scripting services or MCP servers.
  • Strong working knowledge of Headless 360 and Data 360 - exposing Salesforce actions, data, and agents as headless services consumable by non-Salesforce AI clients.
  • Demonstrable understanding of Salesforce Objects, Data Model, and security architecture.
  • Salesforce.com certifications (Agentforce Specialist, Data 360 Consultant highly valued)

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience building autonomous AI quoting agents that interact with Salesforce data to automate product configuration, pricing, and quote generation.
  • Familiarity with external MCP client frameworks (e.g., Claude Desktop, Cursor, or custom MCP clients) and integration with Salesforce Hosted MCP endpoints.
  • Background in prompt engineering, RAG patterns, or LLM-based application development.

title: Asphalt Operator II
description:
At GAF, we cover more than just buildings. We cover each other. Under this roof, you will have the tools and resources you need to grow and develop in your career. You will experience our incredible culture and will be empowered to support your teammates, your customers, and especially your community. Under this roof, we define the future while leading the present through our deep well of experience and our responsibility to the future to drive improvements and innovation in our products. We are GAF. And under this roof, we protect what matters most.

About GAF - Newton, Kansas

Newton is a vibrant Kansas community founded in 1871 on a spirit of work, from its earliest days as a railroad, agriculture and cattle drive hub. With a population of about 20,000, Newton and neighboring North Newton features an active arts community, three National Historic Districts, a variety of museums, trails, restaurants, shops and attractions, Bethel College, award winning school districts, a championship golf course, first-class convention center and many other amenities. This collaborative region is close to dynamic Wichita and may be the next best place for you to call home, in GAF’s newest “Field of Dreams!”

New Plant, New Opportunities

If you haven’t been part of a greenfield startup, now is your chance. GAF is the North American leader in residential roofing materials. We are honored to be constructing our newest shingle manufacturing facility in Newton KS and hiring is underway as we build our initial plant leadership team. Due to our investment in training and the development of employees, you will have the opportunity to travel to our other locations, engage with peers, support the hiring of plant staff and participate in the design and construction of the facility. Expect your first years to be rewarding and challenging with an amazing team fully supporting you. You will wear many hats during the construction and commissioning phases of the project, and ease into your steady role over time.


Job Summary
The Asphalt Operator II is an advanced technical role responsible for the end-to-end oversight of asphalt processing. Reporting to the Asphalt Operations Supervisor, this individual manages the blow stills, boilers, and thermal support systems to ensure a continuous, high-quality supply of asphalt products to the roofing mill. The Level II operator functions with high autonomy, making critical quality decisions and providing general oversight of yard activities

Essential Duties
  • Champion a safe and clean work environment, embedding safety as the highest priority within our culture.
  • Participate in safety, continuous improvement, and 5S initiatives.
  • Serve as an active member of the Emergency Response Team (ERT) and lead the development of safety pre-plans and JSA revisions.
  • Maintain compliance with safety policies and procedures, conduct inspections of plant areas and/or equipment, and ensure deficiencies found are resolved or appropriately communicated.
  • Monitor and adjust blow stills, industrial boilers, hot oil heaters, and water conditioning equipment via Wonderware or similar HMI systems to maintain production specifications.
  • Provide general oversight and support to all Yard activities, including directing the flow of asphalt via complex pump and valve operations.
  • Understand and be able to adjust asphalt processing needs based on plant consumption
  • Perform advanced raw material testing and exercise independent judgment to accept or reject products based on a high degree of quality knowledge
  • Identify faulty operations or defective equipment and initiate technical repairs and maintenance through the Maximo work order system
  • Support the receiving of all asphalt and filler deliveries, ensuring truck drivers strictly adhere to plant safety policies
  • Monitor and maintain fire systems and critical equipment during non-production hours to ensure a seamless plant start-up
  • Maintain detailed and accurate records of temperatures, pressures, and chemical specifications for long-term production tracking
  • Participate in Outage and downday work as assigned
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications Required
  • H.S. Diploma or General Education Degree (GED) required
  • 3+ years in a safety sensitive position within a high volume manufacturing environment

General Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • A demonstrated commitment to safety
  • Excellent interpersonal skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work as a team player
  • Situational awareness in plants with moving machinery, overhead hazards and pedestrian walkways
  • Strong communication skills required when working with employees at all levels of the organization
  • Ability to pivot quickly to operational disruptions
  • Ability to lead safety activities and mentor Level I operators on technical troubleshooting and process flow
  • Able to work under limited supervision make independent judgement and decisions as necessary.
  • Ability to solve complex problems involving multiple concrete variables and resolve conflicts within a high-pressure environment.
  • Ability to identify and react to upset conditions such as leaks, pressure spikes, or equipment malfunctions and report them immediately
  • Ability to perform manual labor, including lifting up to 50 lbs with assistance, climbing industrial ladders, working on elevated catwalks, and unloading rail cars
  • Ability to maintain productivity during an 8 to 12 hour shift that may involve bending, lifting, and mounting/dismounting equipment.
  • Excellent organization skills.

Technical Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Intermediate proficiency in Google suite and/or Microsoft Office
  • Intermediate knowledge of OSHA and FRA regulations, Lock, Tag Verify, Fall protection and PPE required for hot liquid handling
  • Intermediate knowledge of secondary containment, spill prevention, and reporting procedures for oil and asphalt
  • Intermediate of piping layouts, valve types (plug, gate, check), and the mechanics of asphalt/flux flow from railcars and trucks to storage.
  • Intermediate Knowledge of safe steam connection procedures used to heat high-viscosity materials to flowing temperatures
  • Intermediate understanding of heat transfer fluid (HTF) degradation, boiler water conductivity, and the impact of ambient temperature on oxidation rates within the blow stills.
  • Knowledge of how the Fume Collection, Steam Suppression, and HTF systems interact; understanding how a failure in one auxiliary system affects the primary production line.
  • Knowledge of the wear patterns of high-temperature pumps and valves, and the ability to identify "early warning" acoustic or vibrational changes in rotating equipment.
  • Ability to perform "Autonomous Maintenance," including the lubrication of plug valves, changing of pump strainers, and basic pipe fitting
  • Understanding of Title V air permit requirements and EPA regulations regarding opacity and fume scrubbing to ensure the plant remains in constant compliance.
  • Skill in using infrared thermometers or vibration pens to identify "hot spots" or bearing failures before they lead to unplanned downtime.
  • Ability to navigate complex Wonderware or Rockwell interfaces to adjust PID loops, set alarms, and trend historical data to find the root cause of process deviations.
  • Skill in using advanced lab equipment (e.g., Automated Ring and Ball testers or Penetrometers) to certify that "finished" asphalt meets exact mill specifications.
  • Skill in using "5-Why" or "Fishbone" methodologies to investigate equipment failures or quality "off-spec" events
  • The ability to lead a full system restart following a power outage or emergency trip, including the sequential firing of boilers and re-establishment of thermal loops.
  • The ability to look at a WinSPC control chart and make decisions to adjust process settings to meet or maintain product specifications.
  • The ability to manage multiple concurrent processes (e.g., unloading a railcar, monitoring a blow still, and receiving a granule truck) without compromising safety or quality.
  • Unloading trucks, rail cars or asphalt transfer from refinery
  • The ability to safely manually override automated systems during a sensor failure to bring the equipment to a "safe state
  • Intermediate knowledge in using computer systems to log daily transactions, inventory levels, and safety audits accurately
  • Ability to safely operate pumps, blowers, and air compressors under the guidance of a Level II operator or supervisor
  • Skill in directing or assisting in the precise positioning of transport vehicles for unloading operations.
  • Ability to perform root cause analysis for safety and loading incidents

Qualifications Preferred
  • 2+ years of working knowledge with P&ID’s (Piping and Instrumentation diagrams), valve operations, and use of hand tools for routine maintenance

Physical Demands
  • Stationary Position - Frequently
  • Move/Traverse - Frequently
  • Stationary Position/Seated - Frequently
  • Transport/Lifting - Frequently
  • Transport/Carrying - Frequently
  • Exerting Force/Pushing - Frequently

  • Ascend/Descend - Frequently
  • Balancing - Frequently
  • Position Self/Stooping - Frequently
  • Position Self/Kneeling - Frequently

  • Position Self/Crawling - Frequently
  • Reaching - Constantly
  • Handling - Constantly
  • Grasping - Frequently
  • Feeling - Occasionally
  • Communicate/Talking - Frequently
  • Communicate/Hearing - Frequently
  • Repetitive Motions - Frequently
  • Coordination -

Working Conditions
  • Extreme cold - Frequently
  • Extreme heat - Frequently
  • Humid - Frequently
  • Wet - Frequently
  • Noise - Frequently
  • Hazards - Frequently
  • Temperature Change - Frequently
  • Vibration - Frequently

Travel Requirements: May require occasional travel in connection to job duties as it relates to conferences, site visits, professional development or learning opportunities, etc. in which advance notice of travel expectations/events will be provided.

title: Postdoctoral Fellowship – AI and Machine Learning for Infectious Disease Modeling
description:
Discover Your Career at Emory University

Emory University is a leading research university that fosters excellence and attracts world-class talent to innovate today and prepare leaders for the future. We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community.


Description

The Lau Lab in the Department of Biostatistics and Bioinformatics at Emory University is seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral fellow to conduct research at the intersection of statistical modeling, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and infectious disease epidemiology.

The fellow will develop and apply novel statistical, mathematical, computational, and machine learning methods, with particular emphasis on deep learning and modern AI approaches, to improve our understanding, inference, and prediction of infectious disease dynamics. Potential research areas include epidemic forecasting,deep learning–based simulation-based inference, generative and foundation models for epidemiology, phylodynamics, and integration of heterogeneous surveillance
data.

Projects are strongly grounded in real-world public health applications, including pandemic preparedness, outbreak forecasting, infectious disease surveillance, and data-driven public health decision-making. The fellow will have substantial opportunities to develop independent research directions and lead high-impact methodological and applied publications.

Position Details
• Start date: Spring-Summer 2027 preferred; timing is flexible for an exceptional candidate
• Initial term: 1 year, with the expectation of renewal based on performance, mutual fit, and funding
• Location: Emory University, Atlanta, Georgia

JOB DESCRIPTION: Helps design and conduct research within a specified field while receiving advanced training from a designated Principal Investigator to enhance professional skills and research independence needed for pursuit of a career. The specific area of research in which the trainee is mentored is determined by the department and laboratory of the Postdoc. Designs and evaluates experiments. Develops new ideas that promote current research. Prepares and publishes scientific manuscripts under the direction of the Principal Investigator. May be responsible for operation of specific equipment. May teach techniques to others, train, and supervise research staff. Positions are temporary appointments as a research trainee. The initial appointment is for one year, renewal expected if progress is satisfactory and funds are available. Appointments cannot exceed five years.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: A doctoral degree or equivalent (Ph.D., M.D., ScD., D.V.M., DDS etc) in an appropriate field. Excellent scientific writing ability and strong oral communication skills. The ability to work effectively and collegially with colleagues. Additional qualifications as specified by the Principal Investigator.

Preferred Qualifications

• PhD in statistics, biostatistics, computer science, applied mathematics, physics, artificial intelligence, or another closely related quantitative field
• Strong interest in applying quantitative and computational methods to infectious disease epidemiology
• Strong background in statistical/mathematical modeling, machine learning, or computational methods
• Experience with deep learning, probabilistic modeling, scientific machine learning, or related modern AI methods is particularly desirable
• Strong interest in interdisciplinary research
• Proficiency in Python and R; experience with additional scientific computing frameworks is desirable
• Strong research record and evidence of growing independence.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills

Candidates are not expected to have prior experience in every area listed above. Applicants with particularly strong methodological or computational backgrounds who are genuinely interested in applying their expertise to infectious disease problems are encouraged to apply.

Research Environment
The Lau Lab provides a highly collaborative and interdisciplinary research environment spanning biostatistics, epidemiology, computer science, and infectious disease dynamics. The fellow will work closely with Dr. Max Lau and will have opportunities to collaborate with leading researchers at Emory from Computer Science, Epidemiology and Biology. Postdoctoral fellows will receive strong support for professional development, including conference travel, interdisciplinary collaborations, development of independent research programs, and publication in leading methodological and scientific journals.

Application Instructions
Interested applicants should apply through the Emory portal.

Please include:
• Curriculum vitae (CV)
• Statement of research interests
• Contact information for two references. Reference letters will be requested from candidates selected for interview.

Questions may be directed to Dr. Max Lau at msy.lau@emory.edu.
Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled.


Additional Details

Emory is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by state or federal law. Emory University does not discriminate in admissions, educational programs, or employment, including recruitment, hiring, promotions, transfers, discipline, terminations, wage and salary administration, benefits, and training. Students, faculty, and staff are assured of participation in university programs and in the use of facilities without such discrimination. Telephone: 404-727-9867 (V) | 404-712-2049 (TDD).

title: Pharmacy Operations - Access Specialist
description:
Job Overview

The Pharmacy Operations – Access Specialist will have strong knowledge of insurance, revenue cycle, pharmacy services and health system operations to work as a liaison between acute care, ambulatory sites, Fairview Home Infusion, and Fairview Specialty Pharmacy to coordinate patient care seamlessly across the organization. This role will work as a part of an interdisciplinary team of revenue cycle, service line, clinicians, physicians, and other health care providers in a rewarding, fast-paced work environment in an academic/clinic setting. This position allows a high preforming, experienced pharmacy individuals expand their knowledge base.

  • Perform verification of insurance benefits, analysis, payer policies, identify any potential access issues, and removing barriers to care across Fairview Pharmacy Services.
  • Assist in resolving access issues with payers and provide information and expertise to other departments.
  • Assess patients’ payor source and clinical information to identify appropriate site to provide care for patient (home infusion, outpatient infusion therapy, or specialty pharmacy) and coordinate with staff as appropriate.
  • Screen patients for financial assistance eligibility by gathering financial information including income, assets, and estimates of charges for service, as appropriate.
  • Support pharmacy services with requests from revenue cycle (coding, billing, etc.) regarding infusions and clinic administered medications.
  • Maintain current knowledge of payer requirements and general admitting practices including use of on-line verification applications and initial and ongoing training.
  • Coordination and authorization of payer mandated white bagging when required by MN State Law (not currently in effect).
  • Understand all third party and Medicare/Medicaid regulations and billing guidelines as they pertain to pharmacy and medical benefits. Including Coordination of Benefits and copay assistance.
  • Coordinate with outside facilities on prior authorization and access as needed for MHFV providers.
  • Research to find other programs for payment and/or negotiate with providers and third-party payers to provide coverage or exceptions.
  • Partner with potential international and self-pay patients on any financial or service needs related to their pharmacy care.
  • Provide financial counselling and support for patients as needed during their treatment communicating options for financial assistance as appropriate; answer related questions to ensure patients’ understanding of their benefits.
  • Explain patient charges and/or insurance benefits (medical & pharmacy) and communicate expectations of financial responsibilities as it relates to access issues.
  • Advising patients on route to access if unable to be serviced within FPS (limited distribution, payor carve out, benefit design, etc.)
  • Expedite patient access to high-cost medications by identifying and resolving barriers on behalf of clinic care teams, including submitting and following prior authorizations/appeals, alternate funding for claim appeals, and assisting patients with financial assistance program on out-of-pocket costs.
  • Understand the patient journey, support resources available, and strategies to shape ongoing patient relationships
  • Communicate expectations, timing, and process capability to pharmacy, patients, caregivers, and clinics.
  • Drug care coordination working with clinics and various Fairview Pharmacy Services teams to allow seamless transition and access to high-cost medications to allow for best patient experience.
  • Meet with clinic staff regularly to foster relationship-building and represent Fairview Pharmacy Services.
  • Assist care teams with Letters of Medical Necessity and maintain template library
  • Coordinate with Care Teams on high level appeals across FPS (Court of Appeals).
  • Act as an advocate for ambulatory pharmacy services, including, but not limited to specialty pharmacy, home infusion pharmacy, compounding pharmacy, acute care and explaining our offered services (all FPS locations).
  • Use various reports and data across FPS to identify, support and implement changes to current processes to facilitate communication and service between patient, provider, and pharmacy teams to ensure accurate and timely delivery of care.
  • Support Pharmacy Services and organization to on-board high-cost new drug therapies to ensure appropriate access for patients and education to appropriate FPS teams
  • Work as Pharmacy Services Access expert to teach and train direct pharmacy staff on broad access issues (Subject Matter/Situational Expert and Educational resource for Pharmacy Services).
  • Serve as a resource to the affiliations, staff, and physicians regarding Fairview Pharmacy Services. Assist with the coordination of services by communicating effectively and in a timely manner with others.
  • Establish relationships with industry representatives and reimbursement managers to maintain current knowledge on available financial assistance programs
  • Identify and escalate issues if deemed beyond scope.


Required Qualifications

  • B.S./B.A. in business or healthcare related field
  • The ideal candidate will have experience in pharmacy, working with specialty infusion, home infusion, pharmacy medications, prior authorizations, and/or coordinating work with multiple stakeholders.
  • Communication skills, interpersonal skills, adaptability are critical.
  • Willingness to work in a fast-paced environment, work independently, to grow and develop, and to be an integral part of the team is necessary.
  • 5 years of revenue cycle, financial counseling, pharmacy access services, or contracting experience in a healthcare or insurance organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5 years of revenue cycle, financial counseling, pharmacy access services, or contracting experience in a healthcare or insurance organization.
  • Pharmacy Technician MN Registered as Pharmacy Technician with the MN State Board of Pharmacy.
  • If Minnesota Board of Pharmacy registration on or after 1/1/2013, must have a certificate of completion from a MNBOP approved employer based or vocational/technical training program

description:

location: District Attorney-50 North Duke Street, Lancaster, PA
description:

Job Description:

JOB SUMMARY

  • A Sentencing Guideline Coordinator is responsible for preparing all sentencing guidelines forms which will be relied upon by prosecutors when constructing plea offers, defense attorneys to convey possible penalties to their clients and judges when constructing and imposing sentence.

  • The guideline coordinator must be able to use independent judgement in all responsibilities including: extracting and interpreting the relevant data from a criminal history form to determine the nature and extent of each defendant's prior criminal history; determining the appropriate sentencing guidelines ranges, enhancements, and mandatory provisions to be considered when imposing sentence; and preparing the sentencing guidelines by entering data into the PA Commission on Sentencing Guidelines Software (SGS Web).

  • This individual must have excellent analytical skills, must demonstrate keen attention to detail.

  • The individual must maintain a reputation for objectivity, integrity, and accuracy in the performance of their duties so as to instill confidence and trust in the minds of the prosecutors, defense attorneys and judges who will rely on the documentation prepared.

REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS

  • This position reports to the Accelerated Disposition Supervisor with oversight from the First Assistant District Attorney.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Ensure that a J-NET or NCIC/CLEAN terminal inquiry is conducted for each case.

  • Research any in-county docketing information with no disposition received to obtain final dispositions of all charges.

  • Contact out-of-county and out-of-state agencies to verify the specific nature and disposition of prior offenses, translate into equivalent PA statutes prior convictions from other states and obtain certified documentation from other jurisdictions.

  • Prepare and record sentencing guidelines forms for all cases.

  • Remain knowledgeable as to the current law regarding sentencing guidelines and alternatives, to include mandatory sentences and sentencing enhancements and departures.

  • Respond to inquiries from other judicial, law enforcement, correctional or custody agencies and institutions regarding criminal histories originating in Lancaster County.

  • Assist with training and evaluation of newly assigned Sentencing Guideline Coordinators

  • Assist with discovery redaction for the Accelerated Disposition Court files and other case files

  • Maintain confidentiality standards of the District Attorney's Office at all times.

OTHER SPECIFIC TASKS OR DUTIES

  • Maintain good communications between the other county agencies and outside agencies to meet established policies and procedures, objectives, program assessment and standards in order to aid the District Attorney's Office in attaining program goals.

  • Perform other duties and assignments as required and directed.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's Degree preferably in criminal justice, sociology or the administration of justice from an accredited institution or other relevant qualifying experience.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, be proficient in research, interpreting, and analyzing data and possess the ability to work collaboratively and independently to achieve stated goals.

  • Possess strong organization skills and attention to details skills; and the ability to maintain flexibility to multitask as needed.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with co-workers, support staff, attorneys and others within County Government.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Ability to learn about the Criminal Justice System

  • Professionally interact and communicate with others by telephone, written communication or in person meetings

  • Knowledge of General Office Procedures and Practices.

REQUIRED LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS/CLEARANCES

  • Must be JNET and NCIC/CLEAN certified which requires a one-time training and recertification every two years.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS/WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Operate standard office equipment

  • Sitting long periods of time in an office environment

title: Bell Captain
description:

Welcome to Hammock Beach Golf Resort & Spa, a premier destination within the Pyramid Global Hospitality portfolio.   • An outgoing and engaging personality

As the Sr Program Manager - Software Solutions & Business Process, you will lead global, cross-functional Supply Chain and manufacturing transformation for software, digital, and hybrid healthcare offerings. You will connect product strategy and New Product Introduction (NPI) to planning, manufacturing readiness, order management, fulfillment, installation, billing, service, and lifecycle execution.

Priorities include Support Digital Core, Big Rock Software Subscription, Hybrid Countries Orders, and Digital iNVENTORY. GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end value-stream and operating-model design from NPI and design transfer through demand and supply planning, manufacturing readiness, order management, fulfillment, installation, billing, service, and lifecycle support.

• Lead Digital Inventory capabilities and process transformation, improving visibility, governance, accuracy, and lifecycle management of digital inventory, entitlements, assets, and related operational data.

• Establish current-state, interim-state, and future-state processes, decision rights, roles and responsibilities, controls, handoffs, training, and adoption plans across global value streams.

• Establish program governance, integrated roadmaps, and performance measures such as forecast and plan accuracy, lead time, on-time delivery, backlog, inventory and entitlement accuracy, cycle time, quality, rework, and revenue or cash readiness.

• Identify root causes and process gaps; lead Lean and continuous-improvement initiatives that improve customer experience, execution consistency, quality, scalability, and operating cost.

• Partner with Commercial, Product, Engineering, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Quality, Regulatory, Service, Finance, IT, and regional teams to translate business needs into executable processes and sustainable capabilities.

• Influence senior stakeholders across a global matrix, resolve cross-functional barriers, drive timely decisions, and communicate risks, issues, dependencies, and outcomes to executive leadership.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Business, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in program management, Supply Chain, manufacturing, operations, or business process transformation.

  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs from process definition through implementation and stabilization in a global or matrixed organization.

  • Demonstrated experience improving end-to-end operational processes, such as NPI or design transfer, planning, manufacturing readiness, order management, fulfillment, installation, billing, service, or lifecycle support.

  • Ability to establish program governance, manage roadmaps, risks and dependencies, drive decisions, and measure outcomes using operational performance indicators.

  • Experience translating business needs into clear process requirements and partnering with technology teams to enable solutions.

  • Strong stakeholder influence, communication, and problem-solving skills, including communicating with senior leaders and resolving cross-functional barriers.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with software, digital, subscription, SaaS/XaaS, or hybrid offerings that combine physical products with digital fulfillment.

  • Experience in healthcare, medical technology, or another regulated industry.

  • Familiarity with ERP or subscription-management processes and systems, such as Oracle Fusion or SAP.

  • Lean, Six Sigma, project management, or change management training or certification.


This should help attract experienced Supply Chain and operations leaders who can lead the Support Digital Core, Big Rock Software Subscription, Hybrid Countries Orders, and Digital Inventory programs, while still welcoming candidates with relevant digital experience.

Please use the template below to create a Job Posting for your Requisition. Review the Career Track / Level Criteria at the bottom of this template and ensure the job posting matches accordingly.

Your Team
Do you aspire to be a part of a global organization that recognizes security as a critical component in its trust relationship with clients, staff, business partners and shareholders? Do you want to collaborate and learn from like-minded security professionals under the guidance of a former Deputy Director of the FBI in developing an intelligence-driven approach to security? Do you want to work in a highly collaborative and consultative environment that values everyone’s ideas on how to best protect, detect and respond to the latest physical and cyber threats impacting the financial industry? If this sounds like a team you want to be a part of, read on to learn more about the opportunity to join us.

Your Role
The Cyber Defense - Senior Analyst is a senior individual contributor responsible for strengthening the organization's ability to detect and validate cyber threats through SIEM detection engineering, proactive threat hunting, purple teaming, and adversary emulation. The role owns the end-to-end lifecycle of detection content - from requirements and design through testing, deployment, tuning, measurement, and retirement - and uses the MITRE ATT&CK framework to align detections, hunts, and validation activities with relevant adversary behaviors. The Senior Analyst works closely with Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, and other technology and security teams to identify visibility and detection gaps, validate control effectiveness using CALDERA, VECTR, and other breach-and-attack simulation tools, and translate findings into measurable improvements. The role also provides technical guidance and mentoring while remaining primarily hands-on.

You Will Be Responsible For:
· Conduct hypothesis-driven and intelligence-led threat hunts across large and diverse data sets; document methodologies, evidence, findings, and recommended follow-up actions.

· Map detections, hunts, observed behaviors, and validation results to MITRE ATT&CK tactics, techniques, and sub-techniques to assess and communicate coverage and gaps.

· Plan and execute purple-team exercises and collaborative adversary-emulation activities with defensive teams and authorized testing stakeholders.

· Use MITRE CALDERA, VECTR, and other breach-and-attack simulation tools to safely emulate relevant adversary behaviors, track test scenarios, record defensive outcomes, and validate detection and response controls.

· Expertise in design, development, testing, deployment, tuning, and lifecycle management of high-fidelity SIEM detections across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, application, and other relevant telemetry sources.

The Experience You Bring: •
· 9-11 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, security operations, detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response, security analytics, or related disciplines; experience in a financial-services or similarly regulated environment is preferred.
· Practical experience using MITRE CALDERA, VECTR, and other breach-and-attack simulation or adversary-emulation tools for test execution, collaboration, evidence capture, and remediation tracking.

· Strong understanding of attacker tradecraft, common intrusion patterns, malware behaviors, identity-based attacks, lateral movement, persistence, command and control, and data-access techniques.
· Demonstrated hands-on expertise in SIEM detection engineering, including analytics design, query development, testing, tuning, content deployment, versioning, documentation, and lifecycle governance.

title: Manager - Project Controls Scheduling
description:
At PGE, our work involves dreaming about, planning for, and realizing a smarter, cleaner, more enduring Oregon neighborhood. Its core to our DNA and we haven’t stopped since we started in 1888. We energize lives, strengthen communities and drive advancements in energy that promote social, economic and environmental progress. We’re always on the lookout for people passionate about leading and being a part of teams that are advancing innovative clean energy solutions that are also affordable and accessible to all.



Position Summary

This role will be responsible for leading and directing the Scheduling team within PGE's Project Controls organization; working closely with Project and Program Managers to ensure project schedules are accurately developed and effectively managed and communicated. Key goals include achieving successful project scheduling performance, adopting new project scheduling methodologies, and driving scheduling process improvements across the company's capital spending on generation, transmission/distribution, and facility assets.


An ideal candidate should have proven experience managing teams, strong process orientation, and solid construction project scheduling knowledge. Expertise in facilitating open communication and bridging gaps between cross-functional teams with differing objectives will be instrumental in driving project scheduling success, while promoting organizational synergies.


This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in PGE's decarbonization and high growth plans, and grid resiliency initiatives, while further shaping and growing an important capability within the construction project controls Project Management Office.


Key Job Information

Job Title: Manager, Project Controls Scheduling

Job Code: 6846

Grade: 9

  • Manages professional associates and/or supervisors
  • Is accountable for the performance and results of a team
  • Adapts departmental plans and priorities to address resource and operational challenges
  • Decisions are guided by policies, resources and business plan; receives moderate guidance from manager
  • Provides subject matter guidance to associates, colleagues and/or customers

Key Responsibilities

Staff Management

Manages a team of project controls staff responsible for determining and implementing best in class project scheduling controls that will to help ensure stakeholder and regulatory compliance and meet construction project scheduling goals for PGE Generation, Transmission and Distribution projects and programs; provides technical management and direction for the Scheduling team, ensuring team objectives are met and all relevant standards/procedures are followed; ensures that operational problems are identified and resolved; ensures that operational procedures and working practices are current and fit for purpose.


Program Management

Oversees development, implementation and monitoring of enterprise-wide project scheduling controls, including scheduling baseline requirements, metrics and monitoring mechanisms; provides leadership in development and improvement of project scheduling control, standards, processes and systems; develops overall methodology for PGE-wide project scheduling controls and collaborates with other PGE departments to promote consistency in scheduling controls and metrics; stays abreast of and implements industry best practices in project scheduling controls; oversees root cause analysis for deviations from project plans; oversees establishment and reviews of project scheduling metrics; evaluates trends and oversees scheduling recovery activities and methods as necessary.


Project Oversight

Ensures projects are delivered to the minimum scheduling controls requirements; oversees the calibration and/or development of scheduling tools and procedures to support project and construction management requirements, including work breakdown structure alignment and schedule performance reporting requirements; ensures timely communication and engagement with stakeholders; identifies or oversees identification and mitigation of risks to project schedules and timelines.


Compliance

Ensures projects meet regulatory requirements; monitors documentation and ensures compliance with all relevant laws, regulations and policies; oversees the development and maintenance of written standards and procedures related to project scheduling controls.


Resourcing

Oversees Project Controls Scheduler resourcing decisions and planning for Scheduling team; partners with HR in the definition of jobs, recruitment, evaluation and selection processes.


Professional Development

Reviews organizational development needs and training strategies to determine required learning and development outcomes for the Scheduling team; provides guidance in the creation of individual and career development plans; monitors ongoing progress against plans and provides coaching and mentoring, along with performance feedback; completes annual performance management reviews.

title: Senior Product Manager - Telecom
description:
At NVIDIA, we are at the forefront of innovation in AI, accelerated computing, and networking. Our work is redefining industries from healthcare and automotive to telecommunications. NVIDIA Aerial RAN Computer (ARC) is a key platform for the telco market: a high-performance, energy efficient, 6G-ready accelerated computing platform, designed for telecom networks, enabling commercial AI-RAN deployments and on-ramping to AI-native 5G and 6G. It unifies AI and radio access workloads on a software-defined, accelerated infrastructure to boost performance, efficiency, and monetization. We are looking for a highly motivated Product Manager to orchestrate the development of the NVIDIA ARC product portfolio and its ecosystem. The successful candidate will be responsible to drive the roadmap and deliver features that will move the needle for our customers.


What you will be doing:

  • Work with Aerial team driving the next wave of AI-RAN Telco products

  • Distill insights from strategic customers and partners to define, prioritize and complete product roadmaps

What we need to see:

  • BS/MS or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, or related field
  • 12+ years of product management (or similar) experience, with a focus on different compute building blocks and overall solution

  • Strong wireless communications technical background and understanding of RAN (CU, DU and RU) and networking architectures
  • Strong desire to learn, motivated to tackle complex problems and the ability to make sophisticated trade-offs

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Detailed insights into how RAN building (CU, DU and RU) blocks interact across different splits (7.2x / CAT-A / CAT-B, ULPI and fronthaul (eCPRI/CPRI)).

  • Direct development experience with NVIDIA software (Aerial), hardware (GPU, CPU, NIC, DPU) and SDKs
  • Successful product launches at telcos, for 4G or 5G technology, covering both Baseband (CU, DU) and Radio (RU)

title: SAP Basis Technical Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a SAP Technical Specialist to join us at Telia!


We are Corporate Technologies and Services department of Telia Group IT! And we are looking for strengthening our SAP Platforms technical team and bringing in SAP Technical Specialists to help us out with all the exciting work we do! If you have experience with Basis, ILM or ALM or SAP Solution Manager maintenance and development – we need you.

This role will be responsible for supporting day-to-day SAP technical operations and lifecycle management activities across the SAP landscape, with a primary focus on SAP Basis administration, Application Lifecycle Management (ALM), and Information Lifecycle Management (ILM) – your competences and development wishes will define the scope of work.

SAP Technical specialist role will have to ensure stable system operations, compliant data retention, and efficient change and transport processes, while providing timely support to business and IT stakeholders (functional SAP teams) across the Nordic countries (Sweden, Finland, Norway and Denmark).


What you’ll do:

  • Provide day-to-day SAP Basis (or ILM, or ALM or Solman) operational support, including incident handling, troubleshooting, system monitoring, and routine technical activities.
  • Ensure stable SAP system operations by monitoring background jobs, interfaces, transports, and overall system health.
  • Take ownership of incident and service request resolution (minor, major, and critical) in line with agreed OLAs; perform root cause analysis and document outcomes.
  • Support SAP change, release, and transport management processes in alignment with ALM / Solman best practices
  • Collaborate with functional and technical teams to coordinate testing, deployments, and production releases.
  • Support and configure SAP Information Lifecycle Management (ILM) activities, including data archiving, retention execution, and compliance-related tasks.
  • Maintain and execute technical housekeeping and data lifecycle procedures to ensure system performance and regulatory compliance.
  • Support project and enhancement activities as needed, including configuration support, testing (UT, SIT, UAT), documentation, and go-live stabilization.
  • Work according to ITIL practices, SAP change management standards, and agile delivery frameworks (e.g., SAFe), using tools such as ServiceNow and JIRA.

What will help you thrive in this role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Basis or other listed above SAP technical operations
  • Working knowledge of SAP ALM processes and SAP Solman, including transport and change management
  • Experience or exposure to SAP ILM, data archiving, and data retention concepts.
  • Experience working in SAP operations, including incident management, troubleshooting, and end-user support
  • Understanding of SAP system landscapes and collaboration with functional and technical teams (ABAP, Integration, Security).
  • Experience with DB administration, SAP Hana, Oracle, SAP IQ
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive, service-oriented mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills to interact with technical teams, business users, and stakeholders.
  • Flexibility to take on-call duty (24/7 requirement for the service) after working hours, during weekends and public holidays, and support business-critical incidents outside regular working hours when necessary.

Join us to shape smarter living for people, businesses, and the planet

Monthly salary range for this position - 4300-6400 Eur (gross) + annual performance bonuses. Although it may vary depending on your skills and experience.


Ready to make better happen?

If you’re selected for the next stage, you’ll be contacted by our Hiring Manager. Background and reference checks will be part of the process.

title: IT Operations & Procurement Coordinator - 6 Months Fixed Term
description:
Join CoolIT, an Ecolab Company, a global leader in Direct Liquid Cooling technology for data centers, supercomputers, and high-performance computing environments.


CoolIT is seeking an IT Operations & Procurement Coordinator for a six-month full-time contract supporting day-to-day IT operations, technology procurement, equipment coordination, and IT project activities.

You will manage purchasing and equipment workflows from requirements and vendor quotations through requisitions, purchase orders, receiving, inventory tracking, and deployment. You will partner with IT, Finance, business stakeholders, and external vendors.

This early-career opportunity is well suited to someone with hands-on enterprise resource planning (ERP) experience and 1–2 years of relevant experience in IT operations, technology procurement, technical coordination, or a related environment.


What’s in it For You

  • Build practical experience across IT operations, procurement, inventory, and project coordination.
  • Work across the full IT purchasing lifecycle and collaborate with IT, Finance, business stakeholders, and external vendors.
  • Develop transferable ERP, purchasing, vendor management, and technology asset coordination skills.
  • Contribute to infrastructure, site, office, and technology deployment projects during a focused six-month assignment.
  • Gain Global Business Experience: Strengthen your IT operations and procurement experience while working within a global organization.

What You Will Do

  • Support the purchase of laptops, workstations, monitors, peripherals, networking equipment, software, and other IT products and services.
  • Obtain and compare vendor quotations, pricing, availability, and lead times.
  • Coordinate order confirmations, shipping, backorders, substitutions, and order status.
  • Create and maintain purchase requisitions and supporting records in the ERP system.
  • Assist with purchase orders, receipts, invoices, and related purchasing documentation.
  • Track orders from request through delivery and identify delays, shortages, or discrepancies.
  • Work with IT, Procurement, Finance, and vendors to resolve purchasing and receiving issues.
  • Coordinate the receipt of IT hardware and project equipment.
  • Validate deliveries against purchase orders and packing slips and record serial numbers and asset details.
  • Maintain inventory, purchasing, equipment, and project trackers that connect purchases to projects, departments, cost centres, and assets.
  • Coordinate equipment staging, storage, deployment, assignment, transfers, returns, and disposal activities.
  • Support IT infrastructure, site, office, and technology deployment projects by coordinating requirements, delivery dates, dependencies, vendor schedules, installations, action items, and status updates.
  • Maintain accurate documentation that supports auditability, purchasing controls, and timely follow-up with internal stakeholders and external vendors.

Position Details

  • Employment type: Six-month full-time contract
  • Location: 5630 61st Avenue SE, Unit 145
  • Work arrangement: hybrid, 4 days in office

Minimum Qualifications


  • 1–2 years of experience in IT operations, IT procurement, technical coordination, or a similar environment.
  • Hands-on experience using an ERP system for purchasing, procurement, inventory, receiving, or related business transactions.
  • Experience working with purchase requisitions, purchase orders, vendor quotations, or purchasing workflows.
  • Working knowledge of common IT hardware, including laptops, desktops, monitors, docks, peripherals, and basic networking equipment.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365, including maintaining accurate operational or inventory trackers.
  • Experience organizing multiple orders, requests, and project activities while maintaining accurate records.
  • Experience communicating with vendors and internal business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Post-secondary education in an information technology or technology program, or in a business or supply chain program with significant information technology exposure.
  • Experience using NetSuite for requisitions, purchase orders, receiving, vendor records, inventory, or financial workflows.
  • Experience supporting an internal IT department.
  • Experience with IT asset or inventory management.
  • Experience supporting technology-related projects.
  • Experience working with IT hardware vendors, distributors, or resellers.
  • Familiarity with IT asset management or Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) concepts.
  • Experience with project tracking tools.

We thank every candidate in advance; however, we will contact only those selected for an interview. Please note: immigration sponsorship is not available for this role.

Successful candidates for this position will be required to undergo background checks, including criminal record checks and education verification.


ABOUT COOLIT, AN ECOLAB COMPANY

Founded in Calgary, Alberta in 2001, CoolIT Systems is the leading Direct Liquid Cooling technology provider for data centers, supercomputers, and desktop computers. We design and manufacture solutions used by the largest tech companies globally.


Recognized as one of “The Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies 2023” by Financial Times and honored with the Deloitte Fast 50 Clean Technology award in 2022, as well as the Deloitte Fast 500 distinction in both 2021 and 2022, CoolIT’s rapid growth is capturing global attention.


As demand for generative AI, high-performance computing and cloud solutions rapidly expands, there has never been a more exciting time to join our team.


#LI-Hybrid
