Successful candidates will be required to undergo pre-hire background checks as a condition of employment.

title: Product Manager
description:
MILE is the new members-only shopping destination redefining luxury commerce. We offer access to a curated, seasonless catalogue of the most sought-after products from globally renowned fashion houses, all at unmatched prices. Built at the intersection of technology and fashion, MILE delivers a seamless, elevated experience for both consumers and brands. Our mission is to become the leading digital destination for luxury, where exclusivity, value, and exceptional design converge.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Product Manager to own the experience our members have every time they open the MILE app, land on our homepage or join for the first time. This is a consumer-facing, user-centric role with a strong technical lean. You'll own the roadmap for our iOS and Android apps, homepage and onboarding, taking every initiative from the member problem through to release and measurement.

You'll work hand in hand with design, engineering, marketing and our CRM team to decide what we build and why, and you'll be as comfortable talking through APIs, data and integrations with engineers as you are walking through a flow with design. You'll be the person who knows exactly how a feature should behave before a line of code is written, and who has the confidence to say so when something isn't right. If you love thinking through every state, edge case and knock-on effect in a product that has to feel as polished as the brands it sells, this is the role for you.

Location: Based at our Doncaster office. In the office three days per week as standard. During launches and busier periods you may be required in the office up to five days per week, at your manager's discretion.

Requirements

What You'll Do

  • Own the product roadmap for the MILE app (iOS and Android), homepage and onboarding, from problem definition through to release and measurement
  • Own the membership journey from first visit to paying member, making joining MILE feel simple, premium and worth it
  • Shape personalisation and discovery across the app, helping members find the products they want faster
  • Work closely with engineering on technical scoping, weighing up build versus buy, third-party services and the trade-offs behind each approach
  • Write end-to-end specs for every initiative before build, covering the happy path, failure states, edge cases, data and API requirements, and the impact on the wider member journey
  • Define success metrics and the event tracking each feature needs, then use the data yourself to measure impact
  • Write tickets engineering can build from with confidence, and stay close to the work through build, QA and app store release
  • Spot opportunities in member behaviour, research and feedback, and bring them forward as well-scoped initiatives of your own
  • Partner with our CRM team on product strategy, so that onboarding, lifecycle and retention decisions are made together
  • Be the voice of the consumer roadmap in stand-up, sharing what's coming, what's shipped and what's moved, and keeping members and internal teams informed
  • Prioritise with discipline, handing work over when it no longer needs product ownership so your focus stays on what matters most to members



Who You Are

  • 5+ years of product management experience on consumer-facing apps and web, with a strong technical leaning
  • A track record of shipping consumer features end to end, with measurable results you can talk us through
  • Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces or subscription and membership products
  • Technically fluent, with a solid understanding of how APIs, data models and third-party integrations fit together, and confident in scoping and architecture conversations with engineers
  • An understanding of how mobile apps are built and released, ideally with exposure to React Native
  • A systems thinker who works through every state, edge case and dependency before build, and whose specs engineering trusts
  • Hands-on with data, confident writing SQL and using product analytics tools such as PostHog, BigQuery or Metabase
  • Experience with the tools behind a modern consumer product, such as Algolia for search and recommendations, and Klaviyo or OneSignal for messaging
  • Genuinely user-centric, using research, data and member feedback to decide what to build, and caring about how an experience feels as much as whether it works
  • Direct and confident, comfortable challenging ideas when the product thinking isn't right, and clear when something is late or not yet good enough
  • A self-starter who spots opportunities and starts initiatives without waiting to be asked
  • A clear communicator who can present the roadmap, update stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs to commercial and technical teams alike
  • Experienced working closely with designers and engineers in an agile team, comfortable in Figma and writing clear tickets and acceptance criteria



Bonus Points

  • An engineering background or hands-on coding experience
  • Experience with Shopify, Stripe or similar commerce platforms
  • Experience launching products across international markets
  • Experience mentoring designers or junior team members
  • A passion for fashion, luxury, streetwear or sneaker culture

Benefits

Why Join MILE

  • Opportunity to play a key role in shaping the future of the company
  • Ownership of the experience members see and use every day
  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing organisation

title: Emergency Room Tech PRN 1
description:
Job Description:

Job Profile Summary
Under close/general supervision by licensed personnel the Emergency Department Technician will perform a variety of functions in support and care of patients requiring urgent or emergency care in an urgent care or emergency medical setting. The Emergency Department Technician will work directly with and provide close observation of patients assigned to their care. Care assignment is delegated through registered nurses and/or providers. The Emergency Department Technician will maintain an orderly work environment at nursing station/exam areas; responds to patient care needs; transports patients; delivers specimens to lab; data entry for orders; answers phone, performs EKGs and directs calls to RN's on duty as required. The Emergency Department Technician is also responsible for direct patient interaction with patients experiencing behavioral, mental, substance abuse (high risk patients), and other conditions that effects or impairs a patient’s ability to behave in a sound and rational manner. Must possess knowledge of the principles, procedures, techniques, and trends in mental health crisis intervention and have considerable knowledge in human behavior. The Emergency Department Technician will provide therapeutic interaction, understand escalating behavior, and intervene to de-escalate behavior. The Emergency Department Technician will also provide 1:1 observation, ensuring patient and associate safety, of high risk patients, both in the ER and all other area of the hospital. The Emergency Department Technician reports directly to the Director Emergency Department.


Essential Functions:


  • Will be required to assist with lab drawings as needed.
  • Interact routinely with patients, observe behaviors and communicate significant observations to nursing staff. Receives, greets and directs patients, visitors and hospital personnel. Provides accurate responses in a friendly, timely and courteous manner.
  • Ability to access, manage and update patient medical records through Hospital Electronic Medical Record Information System. Maintains HIPAA rules, regulations and follows "Patients’ Rights Policy" at all times.
  • Appropriately directs phone calls to RN's, relays messages, maintains confidentiality in department at all times. Utilizes proper phone etiquette at all times.
  • Monitor behavior, recognize behavioral escalation, provide therapeutic de-escalation Coordinate and assist with care as directed.
  • Attend to physical needs of patients and family in collaboration with RN's and Physicians. Including assistance with personal hygiene tasks, such as bathing, toileting and caring for incontinence if necessary along with feeding and mobility.
  • Acquires and accurately documents vital signs. Completes assigned duties of data entry for orders and procedures.
  • Provides therapeutic patient interaction
  • Utilize Crisis Prevention Intervention when exposed to volatile patients to maintain personal safety while ensuring safety for the patient and other individuals on the unit.
  • Fosters good public relations for the hospital.
  • Demonstrates behaviors consistent with organizational mission and goals.
  • Follows all applicable hospital policies and procedures.
  • Follows policies and procedures for infection control and facility safety in accordance with regulatory guidelines.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of information management as appropriate.
  • Always Work cooperatively and productively with physicians, Social workers, crisis response workers, nurses, other providers and staff, patients and families. title: Senior Engineer - Java, AWS
description:
Job Title

Senior Engineer - Java, AWS

Job Description

So, who are we?
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn’t pivot to innovation; it’s how we’ve always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that’s rare in established businesses.

The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we’ll give you the platform to define what comes next.

Join us at IG – the future gets built here.


Your Team:
Join IG’s Prime Core team, which is responsible for building the open-spec trading APIs and solutions that support institutional and retail clients, delivering secure, high-performance, low-latency solutions.


Your role in the Team’s Success:
Our team sits within the IG Prime division, serving institutional and retail businesses. The Prime Core team owns the APIs that connect IG to institutional clients, brokers and partners across global markets — onboarding client accounts, funding, and the trading and market-data platform that our largest clients depend on every trading day.

That means real-time price distribution, order and execution flow, and reference data, running continuously through the trading day. When these systems degrade, clients notice immediately — so resilience, correctness and latency aren’t aspirations here; they’re the job. You’ll join at a genuinely interesting point: we’re building a new suite of cloud-native trading APIs.


What you’ll do:

  • Write production Java that other people have to maintain: tested, readable, and honest about its edge cases.
  • Work in a spec-driven, AI-assisted development workflow — specifying intent clearly, using AI tooling to move fast, and reviewing what comes back with a critical eye.
  • Contribute to design discussions and technical decisions. You won’t be handed a spec and left alone; you’ll be in the room while we work out what to build.
  • Deploy and run what you build in AWS, and learn how the cloud behaves when things go wrong.
  • Work with the wider team to investigate production issues — using logs, metrics, traces and JVM diagnostics to get from symptom to root cause under time pressure.
  • Take ownership of services, and help the engineers around you grow through mentoring and code review.

What you’ll need:

  • Experience: 7–12 years of professional Java development experience, including hands-on AWS.
  • Java: solid commercial experience writing Java in a production environment — this is the core of the role, and the thing we’ll dig into most.
  • JVM: a real understanding of how the JVM behaves at runtime — memory management and garbage collection, the Java memory model, and how threads actually interact rather than how we hope they do.
  • Concurrency and multi-threading: working knowledge, including the ways concurrent code fails: visibility problems, contention, and bugs that only appear under load.
  • JVM diagnostics: practical skills reading thread and heap dumps, reasoning about GC behaviour, profiling, and narrowing down a memory leak or a contention problem rather than restarting and hoping.
  • Spring: experience with the Spring Framework, ideally Spring Boot.
  • AWS: hands-on experience — you’ve deployed and debugged something real in the cloud, and you understand the services you’ve used rather than just the commands you ran.
  • AI coding tools: practical experience using them as part of your normal workflow, and the judgement to know when their output is wrong. We care much more about how critically you evaluate AI-generated code than how much of it you produce.
  • Linux: comfort on Linux, including basic shell scripting.
  • Curiosity: when something doesn’t add up, and the persistence to keep digging rather than working around it.
  • Willingness to ask questions early and often. In a domain this specific, the engineers who learn fastest are the ones who ask.

The perks:
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won’t pretend otherwise. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off... the list goes on.

  • Matched giving for your fundraising activity
  • Hybrid working model – three days a week in the office
  • Performance-related bonuses
  • Insurance and medical plans
  • Free access to the LinkedIn Learning platform
  • Contribution to gym memberships and more
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Free lunch/snacks
  • A day off on your birthday
  • Two days’ volunteering leave per year

title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Risk Management
description:
Venture outside the ordinary - TMX Careers

The TMX group of companies includes leading global exchanges such as the Toronto Stock Exchange, Montreal Exchange, and numerous innovative organizations enhancing capital markets. United as a global team, we’re connecting cross-functionally, traversing industries and geographies, moving opportunity into action, advancing global economic growth, and propelling progress. Through a rich exchange of ideas, meaningful collaboration, and a nimble operating model, we're powering some of the nation's most critical systems, fueling capital formation and innovation, bringing increased opportunity to business visionaries, product ingenuity to consumers, and career exploration to our team.

Ready to be part of the action?


Role Overview


We are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Leader to provide strategic second-line oversight and shape our risk governance posture. In this critical role, you will act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, independently challenging first-line business operations while integrating risk considerations into new products, initiatives, and third-party partnerships. Combining traditional ERM rigor with modern analytical agility, you will champion a proactive risk-aware culture across our complex, regulated environment.


Job Location: Hybrid (2–3 days in office) - based in Toronto, ON.


Key Accountabilities

  • Second-Line Oversight & Strategic Advisory: Provide robust, independent oversight and effective challenge to first-line business units across operational, strategic, financial, and regulatory risk dimensions; advise leaders on proactively embedding risk management into new initiatives and product launches.
  • ERM Policy & Risk Appetite Governance: Lead the periodic review and continuous enhancement of enterprise risk appetite statements, frameworks, and ERM policies to align with evolving organizational strategy and regulatory standards.
  • Risk Assessments & Scenario Analysis: Design, facilitate, and execute comprehensive periodic and ad-hoc risk assessments across business units and corporate functions; actively contribute to enterprise-wide scenario analysis and stress testing to evaluate inherent risks, control effectiveness, and operational resilience.
  • Vendor & Emerging Threat Surveillance: Oversee critical third-party vendor risks and conduct proactive horizon scanning for macroeconomic, industry, and geopolitical developments to provide forward-looking strategic impact analyses.
  • KRI Monitoring & Incident Management: Establish, track, and analyze Key Risk Indicators (KRIs); oversee the incident management lifecycle by conducting thorough root-cause analyses on risk events and near-misses to drive sustainable remediation.
  • Executive & Board Reporting: Translate complex risk metrics, trends, and assessment outcomes into clear, executive-ready dashboards and presentations for senior leadership and Board committees.
  • Risk Culture & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with specialized risk functions and business leaders to foster a cohesive, risk-conscious culture through targeted training and transparent stakeholder engagement.
  • Audit & Regulatory Liaison: Act as the primary ERM liaison for Internal Audit and regulatory bodies; manage review processes, track remediation commitments, ensure complete closure of findings, and monitor ongoing regulatory changes.

Must Have(s)

  • Professional Experience: 10+ years of progressive risk management experience within capital markets, financial services, or similarly complex, regulated corporate environments.
  • Risk Governance Acumen: Broad-based expertise across enterprise risk domains (including Operational, Financial, and Strategic risk) and deep familiarity with standard risk governance frameworks.
  • Executive Communication & Influence: Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills, with demonstrated success articulating nuanced risk concepts, challenging senior stakeholders constructively, and cultivating cross-functional partnerships.
  • Technical Agility: Solid critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, coupled with an active interest in leveraging modern data analytics and Generative AI (GenAI) tools to streamline workflows and modernize risk processes.
  • GRC Systems Experience: Practical experience implementing, administering, or utilizing enterprise GRC platforms (e.g., MetricStream, Archer, ServiceNow, Workiva, or equivalent).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.

Nice to Have(s)

  • Professional risk or finance designations (e.g., FRM, PRM, CFA, CPA).
  • Successful completion of the Canadian Securities Course (CSC).
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace productivity and collaboration tools.

Compensation


Salary Range: 130,000/year - 145,000/year CAD. Please note that the salary range included is a guideline only. The salary offered may vary based on factors, including, but not limited to, the successful candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, and experience.


The recruiting efforts for this role are intended to fill a vacant position.

In the market for…

Excitement - Explore emerging technology and innovation, as well as ventures and digital finance that shape the future of global markets! Experience the movement of the market while grounded in the stability of close to 200 years of success.

Connection - With site hubs in some of the world’s most multicultural cities, we leverage our size and structure to create rich connections and belonging while experiencing powerful global impact through our work.

Impact - More than a platform, we use our talents to power mission-critical systems that drive global economic advancement, innovation, and growth. As well, our employee-led Team Impact spreads social good via our giving strategy.

Wellness - From empathetic leadership to a culture of flexibility and balance, we believe wellness at work creates the maximum yield and a stronger “we”. Plus, with a cloud-first and hybrid workstyle, as well as generous time-off and leaves, we support a life well lived!

Growth - From a growth mindset in our work, to expansion in our business, TMX is home to action-takers energized by the achievement of ambitious growth.

Ready to enrich your career with impactful work, leaders who truly care, and the flexibility and programs to help you thrive as part of #TeamTMX ? Apply now.

TMX is committed to creating and sustaining a collegial work environment in which all individuals are treated with dignity and respect and one which reflects the diversity of the community in which we operate. We provide accommodations for applicants and employees who require it.

description:
Join Our Team at Tallahassee State College

Career Development Specialist - Okeechobee Correctional Institution


Tallahassee State College (TSC), recently recognized as one of the Most Promising Places to Work in Community Colleges (2025), one of the Nation’s Best and Brightest Companies to Work For® (2025), and a Great Colleges to Work For® (2025), is excited to announce a full-time, grant-funded opening for the position of Career Development Specialist – P10025 with DOC – Okeechobee Correctional Institution, Okeechobee, FL. We are looking for someone who shares our commitment to fostering a vibrant workplace community.


The link to the Department of Corrections Region 4 map is included to assist you in identifying the location of each facility. Please ensure that the location you select is within the vicinity or the location you desire.


What You’ll Do
As a Career Development Specialist, you’ll play a key role in providing services related to Compass 100 Hybrid and supplemental in-cell assignments through cell-front instruction for eligible participants who are in restrictive housing as directed by the Lead Educator.


Day-to-day, you’ll be responsible for:

Who We’re Looking For
We’re seeking a candidate who brings not only technical expertise but also a passion for education and student success. Our ideal candidate will have:

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and data entry.

Bonus points if you have:

What We Offer
We offer more than just a competitive salary of $41,200.00 annually. When you join the team at TSC, you’ll also enjoy:

  • Comprehensive State of Florida benefits, including retirement through the Florida Retirement System.
  • Opportunities for professional development.
  • Federally paid holidays recognized by the State of Florida
  • Tuition waiver for continuous learning.
  • Free access to TSC athletics, fine arts, and performing arts events.

Please visit the College's Benefits site to see the full list of benefits and opportunities.


A Little About Us

Established in 1966, Tallahassee State College is dedicated to providing high-quality educational opportunities for students from Leon, Gadsden, and Wakulla counties, as well as from throughout the state, nation, and abroad. TSC offers a wide range of academic and workforce training programs, including associate degrees, bachelor’s degrees, and in-demand certifications. Consistently ranked as one of the top colleges in the nation, our vision is to be recognized as your College of Choice.

title: Excavator Operator - Underground Utilities
description:
Ready to build a long-term career while traveling throughout South Dakota and surrounding states?

We’re hiring skilled excavator operators to support our growing telecom construction operations. Ideal candidates will bring hands-on experience in civil construction, utility work, or roadbuilding, with a focus on excavation for fiber optic conduit installation. Applicants should be comfortable operating equipment in both rural and urban environments, working around existing utilities.

Projects are located throughout Arizona, South Dakota and surrounding states, with crews typically rotating to a new project location approximately every four weeks.

Essential Responsibilities


  • Safely and efficiently operate mini excavator and skid steers for civil construction and earthwork activities
  • Safely excavate around existing underground utilities, including electrical and telecommunications infrastructure, following required locate and safe-dig procedures
  • Place soil and aggregate in appropriate lifts to allow for effective compaction
  • Recognize how different soil types respond to moisture and compaction
  • Support crews with conduit placement and cable installation to keep production moving
  • Complete daily inspections and basic maintenance checks to keep equipment running reliably
  • Helping with hand digging and conduit installation
  • Communicate clearly with crew members and supervisors to maintain safe, efficient production and meet daily project goals

Qualifications


  • Minimum 5 years of experience operating mini excavators and skid steers in underground utilities, roadbuilding, or a related industry.
  • Experience with fiber optic or underground utility installation is an asset
  • Ability to read construction drawings, interpret utility locates, identify potential conflicts, and assess trench routes before digging
  • Knowledge of proper backfilling, soil conditions, lift thickness, moisture levels, and compaction requirements
  • Ability to recognize unsuitable soil, unexpected utilities, and unsafe site conditions
  • Strong understanding of safe digging practices and job site safety standards
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Ability to safely lift up to 50 lbs.

Work Conditions


  • Competitive hourly wage
  • Must have reliable transportation
  • Monday to Friday schedule
  • Living Out Allowance (LOA) provided
  • Travel required
  • Full health, dental, vision
  • 401(k) matching

title: Executive Director (Trade Association)
description:
Our client, a well-established national trade association, is seeking an Executive Director to lead the organization into its next stage of growth. The association serves a diverse B2B membership of manufacturers, distributors, suppliers, and operators through industry events, education, networking, and advocacy.

The organization is stable and has an engaged, supportive Board. It is now ready to modernize, expand its membership into adjacent markets, and build a stronger member-centric culture. This is a role for a builder. The right leader will enjoy putting systems and processes in place, growing a lean team, and turning strategy into measurable results.

What You Will Lead

  • Growth and Revenue: Own financial performance for an operating budget in the low seven figures. Drive membership recruitment and retention and grow net revenue. Diversify revenue through sponsorships, programs, events, and new member offerings.
  • Transformation: Lead the organization through a period of modernization, including launching a brand refresh and building scalable processes, systems, and member data capabilities.
  • Team Building: Lead and develop a small staff, recruit key new hires, and build a collaborative, high-performing culture.
  • Events and Programs: Serve as executive lead for major annual industry trade shows produced with partner organizations and a contracted show management firm. Also oversee year-round education, awards, and an annual member meeting.
  • Board Partnership: Work with the Board and its committees to implement strategic, generative governance. Report clearly on progress, finances, risks, and opportunities.
  • External Relations and Advocacy: Serve as a visible ambassador for the association and its industry with members, partners, allied associations, media, and government officials. Coordinate legislative and regulatory efforts with counsel and lobbyists.
  • Operations: Oversee finance, compliance, HR, technology, and administration. This includes budget development with the Finance Committee, internal controls, and the annual audit.

Requirements

Required:

  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. A CAE or other association-related certification is a plus.
  • 10+ years of senior leadership experience in a trade association or nonprofit. Small-staff associations ($5M+) with a diverse mix of member types are ideal.
  • A proven track record of growing membership and net revenue.
  • Experience leading an organization through major structural or strategic change.
  • A history of revenue diversification and of building member-centric programs.
  • A strong working understanding of the partnership between a chief staff executive and a volunteer Board.
  • Knowledge of nonprofit finance, budgeting, and legal practices, and comfort negotiating contracts.
  • A data-informed approach to member intelligence, including experience with association management or CRM platforms.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including public speaking and media relations.
  • A relationship-centric, hands-on leadership style with demonstrated strength in team building and change management.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 15 to 20% of the time, including multi-day industry events.

Preferred:

  • Direct experience producing or managing a trade show or large industry event, including exhibitor sales, sponsorships, and contractor management.
  • Experience managing events or programs in partnership with other organizations.
  • Legislative or regulatory advocacy experience at the state or federal level.
  • Background in the entertainment, hospitality, leisure, or consumer products sectors.

Benefits

  • An annual performance bonus program.

title: Vil du bygge plattformen som gjør det enklere for utviklere og analytikere å skape verdi med data og kunstig intelligens?
description:
Vi bygger en analyseplattform med Azure, Snowflake, dbt og Prefect, der målet er å gjøre det enklere å utvikle og levere gode dataløsninger. Plattformen brukes av rundt 40 utviklere og flere tusen brukere i NorgesGruppen.

Nå ser vi etter en Platform Engineer som vil være med og utvikle plattformen videre.

Du blir en del av et lite, sentralt plattformteam i et stort og tverrgående analysemiljø. Vi gjør det enklere for andre team å utvikle, drifte og ta i bruk dataløsninger gjennom automatisering, standardisering og gode felles tjenester.

Vi er inne i en spennende fase der vi utforsker hvordan plattformen best kan legge til rette for bruk av kunstig intelligens.

Hos oss får du stor påvirkningskraft og muligheten til å forme en plattform som er viktig for hele NorgesGruppen.

Hvordan ser hverdagen ut?

Hos oss vil dagene variere. Noen dager dykker du ned i Terraform, Python og CI/CD-pipelines for å automatisere infrastruktur og forbedre plattformtjenestene våre. Andre dager utforsker du ny funksjonalitet, løser tekniske utfordringer eller diskuterer arkitektur og løsninger med kolleger.

Vi jobber i et område der teknologi og behov utvikler seg raskt, så for å trives hos oss må du like å ta initiativ, bygge relasjoner og drive frem forbedring.

Hva du vil jobbe med:

  • Automatisering og infrastruktur: Bygge og videreutvikle plattformen med Infrastructure as Code, primært Terraform, og utvikle CI/CD-pipelines i Azure DevOps.
  • Plattformtjenester: Utvikle felles tjenester og selvbetjeningsløsninger som gjør det enklere for utviklere og analytikere å ta plattformen i bruk.
  • Sikkerhet og tilgangsstyring: Automatisere og forbedre prosesser for sikkerhet, autentisering og tilgangsstyring.
  • Drift og optimalisering: Sikre stabil drift gjennom o fokus på skalerbarhet og kostnadskontroll.
  • Teknologiutvikling: Evaluere nye verktøy og tjenester, blant annet for å legge til rette for bruk av kunstig intelligens på plattformen.

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter deg som har et godt teknisk fundament, liker å løse komplekse problemstillinger og motiveres av å bygge løsninger som gjør arbeidshverdagen enklere for andre.

Vi tror du har:

  • Erfaring med skyplattformer, gjerne Microsoft Azure, og Infrastructure as Code, for eksempel Terraform.
  • God forståelse for CI/CD, automatisering og moderne utviklings- og leveranseprosesser.
  • Erfaring med skripting eller programmering, gjerne Python.
  • Kjennskap til sikkerhet, autentisering og tilgangsstyring i skybaserte miljøer.

Vi tror du har relevant høyere utdanning, men relevant erfaring kan veie tyngre enn formell bakgrunn.


Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med Snowflake, dbt, Prefect eller andre teknologier innen moderne data- og analyseplattformer, men du trenger ikke kunne alle teknologiene fra før. Det viktigste er at du er nysgjerrig, tar eierskap og har lyst til å utvikle deg sammen med oss.


Hva får du hos oss?

  • Stor påvirkningskraft og faglig spillerom i et lite team med ansvar for en viktig plattform.
  • Mulighet til å jobbe med moderne teknologi og utforske nye løsninger innen data og kunstig intelligens.
  • Et stort og tverrfaglig analysemiljø med dyktige kolleger å lære av og samarbeide med.
  • Gode muligheter for faglig utvikling og til å sette ditt preg på hvordan vi jobber.

Klar for å bygge plattformen som gjør en forskjell?

Send oss søknaden din eller ta kontakt hvis du vil vite mer – vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

Do you want to work with technology that impacts the everyday lives of millions of people?

Join NorgesGruppen Data, an exciting workplace with strong professional communities and significant influence. We are more than 300 skilled employees working closely across the entire NorgesGruppen value chain, from farm to table.

With us, IT is an integral part of the business, and we invest heavily in the solutions of the future. As part of our cross-functional environment, you will help develop and deliver technology solutions that truly make a difference in people’s daily lives.

We are located in modern offices at Kalbakken and Skøyen in Oslo.

title: User Experience (UX) Designer
description:
UX Designer

Vi leter ette en UX designer som ønsker å bli med på laget hos oss i Telia.

Jeg heter Mattias Kirchhoff og er leder av teamet for kundeinnsikt og digitale opplevelser (Digital Data & Experience) i Telia. Akkurat nå ser jeg etter en UX-designer til å styrke teamet mitt og kanskje det er deg jeg leter etter. Vårt team jobber for Telia Bedrift og er ansvarlig for utvikling av våre selvbetjeningsløsninger, kundereiser, data enablement, med mer.

Hva vil du gjøre:

Som UX-designer i Telia vil du designe nye løsninger som øker kundetilfredsheten for bedriftskundenes administratorer og våre bedriftsbrukere. Du vil bli en del av et tverrfaglig kjerneteam på rundt 10 personer bestående av Data Engineers, UX’ere, CX’ere, med mer. Hos oss vil du få jobbet tett med både forretning og IT. Vi samarbeider spesielt tett med portalteamet.


  • Jobbe tett sammen med utviklere, IT arkitekter, produkteiere, og andre interessenter i selskapet for å designe gode løsninger og konsepter som har fokus på brukeren og behov.
  • Kartlegge behov, brukerreiser, finne ut av mulige løsninger og hvordan de burde bygges.
  • Planlegge, gjennomføre, og analysere bruketester og brukerintervjuer.
  • Lage skisser og prototyper, og teste de med kundene våre.
  • Formidle verdien av design og bidra med designkompetanse til resten av selskapet.

Hva vil hjelpe deg med å ha suksess i denne rollen:

  • Vi tenker du kanskje har en bachelorgrad eller lignende innenfor designfeltet og allerede jobber i din første jobb. Relevant erfaring kan veie opp for manglende utdanning, men vi forventer du har rundt 3-5 års erfaring.
  • Du kan håndtere komplekse prosesser i større selskap og samarbeider godt i tverrfaglige team.
  • Du har god erfaring med verktøy som Figma/FigJam og ser verdien av å bruke reell data for å evaluere effekt av design.
  • Du er god med tekst og klarspråk, og ser på innholdsdesign som en viktig del av brukeropplevelsen.
  • Du har gode kommunikasjonsevner på både norsk og engelsk.
  • Uansett hva du holder på med, har du forståelse for designprosesser og god kjennskap til universell utforming og WCAG.

Bli med og form smartere liv for mennesker, virksomheter og planeten

Hos Telia er vi et team på 15 000 kolleger i Norden og Baltikum, med en sterk lidenskap for teknologi og konnektivet. Som en ledende telekommunikasjonsaktør og klimaforkjemper driver vi endring gjennom store, virkningsfulle prosjekter, samtidig som vi bygger en bærekraftig og inkluderende verden.

Hos oss kan du utvikle kompetansen din, lede meningsfulle prosjekter og trives i et støttende og mangfoldig arbeidsmiljø. Enten du tar ditt første steg i karrieren eller ditt neste, er Telia et sted hvor du kan vokse, høre til og skape reell påvirkning.

Hva vi tilbyr

Når du blir en del av Telia, får du en helhetlig kompensasjons- og fordels­pakke tilpasset ditt lokale marked, muligheter for fjernarbeid og mer. Du vil også ha mulighet til å oppnå bonus basert på din prestasjon og Telias samlede resultater.

Klar for å få bedre ting til å skje?

Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad innen 2026-11-13. Vennligst merk at stillingen kan bli besatt før søknadsfristen dersom vi finner den rette kandidaten, så ikke vent for lenge med å søke.

Dersom du går videre til neste steg i prosessen, vil du bli kontaktet av vår Talent Acquisition Partner, Helen Riiknurm. Bakgrunns- og referansesjekk vil være en del av rekrutteringsprosessen. Husk å legge ved portefølje når du søker.

Vil du vite mer om stillingen? Ta gjerne kontakt med Mattias Kirchhoff, Head of Digital, Data & Experience på mattias.kirchhoff@telia.no.

Like Muligheter

Hos Telia anerkjenner vi talent basert på faglige ferdigheter og vekstpotensial. Vi fremmer mangfold og sørger for at alles behov blir møtt, uavhengig av funksjonshemming, kjønn, alder, nasjonalitet, seksuell legning eller sosial status. Sammen er vi dedikert til å fremme et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø der din unike karakter er vår styrke.

Join us and let’s make better happen - together!

title: Systems Engineer
description:

  • Knowledge of aircraft certification processes and regulatory guidance.
  • Flight test or navigation system troubleshooting experience.

title: Simulation Coordinator
description:
Job Description:

The Simulation Coordinator schedules, plans, and delivers highly realistic, simulated scenarios for learning, research, and process improvement. This includes preparation and maintenance of computerized manikins (software and hardware), task trainers, healthcare equipment, and related peripherals. In partnership with Simulation Caregivers, the Simulation Coordinator will manage simulation operations and facilities within the assigned geographic area. This position collaborates with leaders and interprofessional teams from across the enterprise to coordinate, align, and deliver simulation activities that support Intermountain Health’s Mission, Vision, and Values.

Work Schedule

  • Full-Time, 40 hours per week
  • Flexible/variable scheduling within core business hours of Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.

Job Essentials

  • Coordinates simulation activities within the assigned geographical area including scheduling and LMS utilization
  • Administers approved system-wide simulation programs to meet outlined objectives.
  • Serves as a recognized expert for facilitators in team trainings to promote the Intermountain culture of extraordinary care
  • Collaborates with simulation specialists to ensure accurate execution of scenarios, programming, and data collection
  • Collects and inputs data to support process improvement, operations, strategy, cost reduction, and increased patient safety and satisfaction.
  • With direction from leadership, collaborate with facilitators to ensure maintenance of certification and reinstatement as necessary.
  • Generates reports for the assigned geographical area to ensure activities are meeting simulation KPIs (Key Process Indicators)
  • Manages inventory including organizing, tracking, and restocking consumables used in simulation.
  • Provides oversight to scenario set up in coordination with content experts
  • Facilitates simulation activities within scope
  • Assists with the Intermountain Simulation Facilitator Course and workshops as needed.
  • Develops and maintains productive, supportive relationships with caregivers, philanthropic organizations, and community supporters.
  • Effectively provisions, installs, programs, configures, operates, and maintains system hardware, software, and related infrastructure.
  • Provides technical support for computer-based multimedia systems and their components, including operation of digital cameras, video cameras, audio/video mixer, digital/analog converter, monitors, LCD projectors, anesthesia machines, low and high-fidelity manikins/patient simulators, and other equipment.
  • Collaborates with leadership to identify simulation technology needs for growth and sustainability within assigned geographical area.
  • Orients staff, facilitators, and learners to safely utilize technology resources.
  • Travels to support center-based and in-situ simulations throughout the Intermountain Network of Care.
    Works with leadership to maintain an inventory list of equipment sent for repair. Works with clinical engineering to ensure that equipment is repaired in a timely manner.
  • Collaborates with customers to identity existing scenarios to support requested objectives, or connects them with a consultant for scenario development.

Minimum Qualification:

  • Two years of experience in clinical or medical simulation environments.
  • Experience working with and troubleshooting audio visual or clinical equipment.
  • Experience working with basic computer programs including word processing, spreadsheets, and email.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality regarding job assignments and sensitive issues.
  • Ability to learn new software and hardware quickly and independently.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Ability to move, manipulate, place up to 50 lbs.

Preferred Qualification:

  • Basic Life Support (BLS) for Healthcare Professional.
  • Certification from the Society for Simulation in Healthcare (CHSE or CHSOS)

title: EMT Class - Oak Creek, Wisconsin

title: Claim Specialist
description:
Job Type:

Full time

Exempt/Non Exempt:

Salary

Job Description:



Location Details: Remote


Position Schedule / Shift: Monday-Friday 8:30am-5:30pm ET


Position Summary:

As a Claim Specialist, you will evaluate coverage, assess claim exposures, and make informed decisions that drive fair and timely resolutions. Working closely with members, medical providers, attorneys, and internal partners under minimal supervision, you'll manage challenging and complex claim scenarios while ensuring compliance with applicable regulations and company standards. The ideal candidate will have experience interpreting and applying Michigan No-Fault reform regulations to support accurate claim handling and benefit determinations. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who thrives on problem-solving, sound judgment, and delivering positive outcomes for members.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review assigned claims and initiate claim handling activities.
  • Contact insureds and other affected parties to gather information and set expectations for the claims process.
  • Document claim activity and maintain accurate records within the claims management system.
  • Perform complex coverage analysis and identify all applicable policyholder benefits.
  • Establish and manage sub-claims as needed.
  • Conduct thorough investigations to determine coverage applicability, claim validity, policy limits, exclusions, and recovery opportunities.
  • Analyze claim facts, damages, state laws, and other relevant factors impacting claim decisions.
  • Evaluate the financial value of losses and authorize appropriate claim payments.
  • Negotiate settlements and claim resolutions using strong negotiation skills.
  • Refer claims to specialized departments when necessary, including Underwriting, Recovery Units, and the Claims Special Investigation Unit (SIU).
  • Ensure complete and accurate claim documentation, coding, closure activities, and compliance with company procedures.
  • Handle intermediate to complex Michigan Personal Injury Protection (PIP) claims, including:
  • Fractures
  • Mild closed head injuries
  • Surgical procedures
  • Attendant care claims
  • Manage claims involving the Michigan Catastrophic Claims Association (MCCA).
  • Handle attorney-represented claims and effectively navigate legal involvement throughout the claim process.
  • Investigate and manage losses that may extend beyond standard PIP claim scenarios.
  • Collaborate with insureds, physician offices, medical providers, and insurance carriers to obtain necessary documentation and information.
  • Review medical and claim-related information to make accurate coverage and payment determinations.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable state regulations, company policies, and claim handling standards.

Qualifications:


Required

Education (including minimum education and any licensing/certifications):

  • Complete ACG Claim Representative Training Program or demonstrate equivalent knowledge or experience
  • In states where an Adjuster’s license is required, the candidate must be eligible to acquire a State Adjuster’s license within 90 days of hire and maintain as specified for appropriate states
  • A valid driver's license is required if the primary responsibilities of the role involve conducting in-person inspections or frequent in-person meetings with members

Experience:

  • Three years of experience or equivalent training in the following:
  • Negotiation of claim settlements
  • Securing and evaluating evidence
  • Preparing manual and electronic estimates
  • Subrogation claims
  • Resolving coverage questions
  • Taking statements
  • Establishing clear evaluation and resolution plans for claims

Knowledge of:

Advanced knowledge of:

  • Essential Insurance Act (Michigan)
  • Fair Trade Practices Act as it relates to claims
  • Subrogation procedures and processes
  • Intercompany arbitration
  • Handling simple litigation
  • Negligence Law
  • No-Fault Law
  • medical terminology and human anatomy
  • MCCA and attorney represented claims

Skills:

  • Handle claims to the line Claim Handling Standards
  • Follow and apply ACG Claim policies, procedures and guidelines
  • Work within assigned ACG Claim systems including basic PC software
  • Perform basic claim file review and investigations
  • Demonstrate effective communication skills (verbal and written)
  • Demonstrate customer service skills by building and maintaining relationships with insureds/claimants while exhibiting understanding of their problems and responding to questions and concerns
  • Analyze and solve problems while demonstrating sound decision making skills
  • Prioritize claim related functions
  • Process time sensitive data and information from multiple sources
  • Manage time, organize and plan work load and responsibilities
  • Safely operate a motor vehicle in order to visit repair facilities, homes (for inspections), patients, etc.
  • Research analyze and interpret subrogation laws in various states
  • Travel outside of assigned territory which may involve overnight stay
  • Work evenings or weekends

Preferred

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Business Administration, Human Resources Management, or related field

Experience:

  • Associate degree in Business Administration, Insurance or a related field or the equivalent in related work experience
  • Completion of the Insurance Institute of America's: General Insurance Program, Associate in Claims, Associate in Management, or equivalent
  • CPCU coursework or designation

Work Environment:

This position is currently able to work remotely from a home office location for day-to-day operations unless occasional travel for meetings, collaborative activities, or team building activities is specified by leadership. This is subject to change based on amendments and/or modifications to the ACG Flex Work policy.


Compensation & Benefits Overview:

ACG complies with all applicable state and local laws regarding required benefits (including PTO, paid sick leave, etc.).


Compensation

A Claim Specialist earns a competitive annual salary of $67,300-$104,000, along with the opportunity for an annual company bonus incentive.


Benefits


At ACG, we offer a comprehensive and flexible benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and professional growth.

  • Medical plans with multiple coverage options, including HSA eligibility.

title: Network & Facilities Technician
description:
Ledcor Technical Services has been building and servicing communication networks for customers across North America since 1979. Utilizing our broad expertise and experience, we customize solutions to best meet our client's needs. We act as a key partner for our clients by delivering exceptional quality, reliability, and safety in all that we do.

Reporting to the Cable Station Manager, the Network & Facilities Technician supports the safe, reliable and continuous operation of a cable landing station and its associated submarine network infrastructure. The role combines critical-facilities monitoring and first-line maintenance with network smart-hands, fiber testing, equipment installation, incident response and outside-plant support. Work is ticket-driven and performed in close coordination with the customer Network Operations Center (NOC), approved vendors and site leadership.

Apply today to join the Ledcor Technical Services team!

Essential Responsibilities:


  • Operate, inspect and document critical facility systems, including BMS/PMS, generators, UPS and DC plant, HVAC/CRAC, fire/life-safety systems, utility services and general building conditions
  • Complete scheduled rounds, first-line maintenance and vendor coordination within assigned authorization
  • Provide NOC-directed network smart-hands support, including inspection, patching, loopback and signal testing, OTDR and optical power testing, equipment reboot or replacement, circuit implementation and fault isolation across SLTE, DWDM, DCN, PFE and related systems
  • Respond to alarms, incidents and emergency callouts
  • Protect life and infrastructure, support restoration, escalate appropriately and maintain accurate ticket updates and communications
  • Support equipment receipt, rack-and-stack, power and signal cabling, labeling, initial configuration, commissioning tests, troubleshooting, as-built updates, inventory, RMA and calibration coordination
  • Support OSP/fronthaul route surveillance, BMH and OGB inspections, initial fiber-fault response, vendor escort and compliance with site safety, security and environmental requirements

Qualifications:


  • Minimum of 4 years experience in telecommunications, data centers, critical facilities, industrial maintenance, fiber optics or network operations
  • Cable landing station, submarine cable, SLTE, DWDM, PFE, critical-power or critical-cooling experience
  • Experience troubleshooting operational systems and working from procedures, MOPs, drawings, alarms and work orders
  • Fiber-optic inspection, cleaning, patching and testing using OTDRs and optical power meters
  • Safe monitoring and first-line work on critical power, cooling, BMS and facility systems within authorization limits
  • Installation and replacement of network hardware, cabling, basic configuration/connectivity tests and as-built records
  • Strong incident communication, documentation and customer service in a 24/7 environment
  • Must complete customer-required screening before assignment, maintain access eligibility and complete role-specific training

Work Conditions:


  • Comfortable with secure cable landing station, data hall, equipment-room, office and outside-plant environments, including controlled-access areas with exposure to energized equipment, noise, temperature variation and coastal weather
  • Able to meet the physical requirements of the position which include regular walking, standing, bending, climbing stairs or ladders and handling tools, test equipment and hardware
  • Occasional travel may be required for training, certification or support of other customer locations

Additional Information

Ledcor Technical Services (LTS) designs, builds, and maintains wireline or wireless networks that span North America and beyond. We are a proven leader and innovator in telecommunications network construction, maintenance, and service installation and repair.

Ledcor has been recognized as a Top 100 Inspiring Workplace in North America.

Our competitive total rewards package provides compensation and benefits that support your physical, mental and financial well-being. We offer exciting, challenging work with opportunities to develop your skills and knowledge.

All qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status or any other identifying characteristic are encouraged to apply.

Our True Blue team consists of individuals from all backgrounds who contribute diverse perspectives and experiences to Ledcor. description:
Salary Range:

Band

Job Description Summary

LI-Hybrid
Lokacija / Location: Ljubljana
Nadomeščanje porodniškega dopusta za določen čas.
Maternity Leave Cover fixed term duration.

Je osrednji kontakt za področje medicinskih zadev ter usklajuje znanstveno sodelovanje, medicinsko usmerjanje in ključne odgovornosti medicinskega upravljanja v okviru razpoložljivih zmogljivosti in lokalnih izvedbenih možnosti. Vodja medicinskih zadev terapevtskega področja in sodelavec za povezavo z medicinsko znanostjo je hibridna vloga na področju medicinskih zadev, ki združuje znanstveno sodelovanje na terenu z odgovornostmi za vodenje in koordinacijo medicinskih aktivnosti.
Zagotavlja kakovostno in skladno znanstveno izmenjavo z zdravstvenimi delavci in medicinskimi strokovnjaki ter se odziva na lokalne medicinske potrebe, podpira medicinsko izobraževanje in pridobivanje strokovnih spoznanj. Na enem ali več prednostnih terapevtskih področjih prevzema osrednjo odgovornost za medicinske zadeve in je ključni medicinski kontakt. Vloga krepi znanstveno prisotnost družbe Novartis, podpira odločanje na podlagi dokazov ter zagotavlja usklajenost z načeli medicinskega upravljanja in prioritetami države. Aktivnosti se prednostno razvrščajo glede na medicinsko tveganje, vpliv na paciente in prioritete terapevtskega področja.
Deluje skladno z veljavno zakonodajo, internimi predpisi, dobrimi praksami in poslovnimi cilji.
------------
Serves as the single Medical Affairs point of contact, balancing scientific engagement, medical direction and essential medical governance responsibilities within defined capacity and local feasibility constraints.
The MSL / Medical Manager is a hybrid Medical Affairs role, combining field-based scientific engagement with office-based medical management responsibilities. Ensures high-quality, compliant scientific exchange with Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) and Medical Experts (MEs), while supporting local medical needs, medical education and insight generation. Across one or more priority Therapeutic Areas (TAs), it acts as a single accountable medical point of contact. The position strengthens Novartis’ scientific presence, supports evidence-based decision-making and ensures alignment with Medical governance and country priorities. Activities are prioritized based on medical risk, patient impact and TA priorities.
Works in accordance with the legislation, internal rules, good practices and business objectives.


Job Description

Ključne odgovornosti:

  • Znanstveno sodelovanje: Izvaja kakovostno, nepromocijsko znanstveno izmenjavo z zdravstvenimi delavci in medicinskimi strokovnjaki ter ustrezno umešča pomembne klinične podatke in znanstvena spoznanja.
  • Odnosi in medicinska partnerstva: Gradi zaupanja vredne strokovne odnose z medicinskimi strokovnjaki, zdravstvenimi ustanovami, strokovnimi združenji in akademskimi institucijami.
  • Lokalno medicinsko usmerjanje:. Regionalne in globalne medicinske usmeritve pretvarja v prednostne lokalne aktivnosti ter deluje kot ključni medicinski kontakt za dodeljena terapevtska področja.
  • Medicinska in medfunkcijska podpora: Zagotavlja medicinsko strokovno podporo medfunkcijskim ekipam ter podpira priprave na lansiranje in aktivnosti v življenjskem ciklu zdravila ob ohranjanju nepromocijske narave vloge.
  • Medicinsko izobraževanje in znanstvena komunikacija: Načrtuje in podpira medicinska izobraževanja, znanstvena srečanja, strokovne posvete in druge znanstvene aktivnosti ter zagotavlja znanstveno pravilnost in lokalno ustreznost.
  • Medicinski vpogledi in pridobivanje dokazov: Sistematično pridobiva in posreduje uporabna spoznanja s terena ter neizpolnjene medicinske potrebe in podpira dovoljene aktivnosti pridobivanja dokazov.
  • Medicinsko upravljanje in skladnost: Deluje kot ključna povezava oziroma lokalna kontaktna oseba za medicinsko upravljanje ter zagotavlja, da so interakcije, gradiva in aktivnosti skladni z globalnimi in lokalnimi SOP, politikami, etičnimi standardi ter zahtevami ERC in regulative.
  • Medicinske informacije:Obravnava oziroma usklajuje poizvedbe s področja medicinskih informacij ter zagotavlja znanstveno pravilne, uravnotežene in nepromocijske odgovore.
  • Dokumentacija in pripravljenost na presoje:. Zagotavlja ustrezno dokumentacijo, zapise v sistemu CRM, sledljivost in skladnost procesov ter s tem pripravljenost na presoje.
  • Strokovni razvoj in organizacijske odgovornosti: Skrbi za strokovni razvoj in izmenjavo znanja, doseganje dogovorjenih ciljev in ključnih kazalnikov uspešnosti ter izpolnjevanje organizacijskih zahtev.

Pričakujemo:

  • Izobrazba: Visoka stopnja izobrazbe s področja naravoslovnih oziroma biomedicinskih znanosti (MD, PharmD, PhD, MSc s področja ved o življenju) ali enakovredna izobrazba.
  • Zahtevano je tekoče znanje slovenskega in angleškega jezika.
  • Najmanj dve leti strokovnih izkušenj v farmacevtski industriji na področju medicinskih zadev (Medical Affairs) ali v sorodnih funkcijah.
  • Znanstvene in medicinske izkušnje: Zaželene so izkušnje s terenskim znanstvenim sodelovanjem, pri čemer so prednost izkušnje z lokalnimi medicinskimi in izobraževalnimi aktivnostmi, interpretacijo kliničnih podatkov in znanstvenih dokazov ter podporo kliničnim raziskavam.
  • Znanstveno sodelovanje in komunikacija: Sposobnost samozavestnega strokovnega znanstvenega dialoga, strukturiranega zbiranja, sintetiziranja in posredovanja strokovnih spoznanj ter jasnega in učinkovitega poenostavljanja kompleksnih znanstvenih vsebin.
  • Skladnost in integriteta: Poznavanje standardov skladnosti v farmacevtski industriji in standardov medicinskega upravljanja ter visoka integriteta, etična presoja in osredotočenost na paciente pri vseh interakcijah.
  • Načrtovanje in sodelovanje: Dobre sposobnosti načrtovanja in določanja prioritet v okolju z omejenimi viri ter učinkovito delovanje v terenskih in pisarniških medicinskih vlogah ter v medfunkcijskem in matričnem okolju.
  • Medosebne sposobnosti in miselnost: Znanstvena radovednost in razvojna miselnost ter sposobnost vplivanja brez formalne avtoritete, grajenja verodostojnih in sodelovalnih odnosov ter prilagodljivega in odpornega delovanja v nejasnih okoliščinah.

Nagrajevanje:

V Novartisu smo zavezani k soustvarjanju prihodnosti medicine ter priznavanju in nagrajevanju ljudi, ki to omogočajo.


Osnovna plača se določa na podlagi vnaprej opredeljenih in transparentnih kriterijev, kot so relevantne veščine, kompetence in izkušnje, ne glede na spol, ter v skladu z Novartisovo politiko določanja plač. Po zaposlitvi v Novartisu se plača periodično pregleda v skladu z internimi akti in postopki.


Plačna enakost je temeljno načelo naše kadrovske politike in odraža našo zavezo k ustvarjanju raznolikega, pravičnega in vključujočega okolja, ki vse zaposlene obravnava dostojanstveno in spoštljivo, kot je opredeljeno v našem Kodeksu etike.

Poleg letne bruto plače ste upravičeni tudi do: fleksibilnega načina dela z možnostjo prilagajanja urnika in delom od doma, pokojninske sheme, možnosti vključitve v kolektivno zdravstveno zavarovanje, sheme nagrajevanja in priznanja dosežkov, razširjenega programa promocije zdravja na področju fizičnega in duševnega dobrega počutja ter delovne obremenitve (Polni življenja), številnih priložnosti za učenje in razvoj, zaposlitve v podjetju s certifikatom Družini prijazno podjetje.

Preberite brošuro in izvedite več o našem sistemu nagrajevanja:

Opomba: Ugodnosti se lahko razlikujejo glede na državo ter so skladni z lokalno zakonodajo, vključno z določili kolektivnih pogodb. Celovit pregled vašega paketa prejemkov, vključno z morebitnimi relevantnimi določbami kolektivne pogodbe, ki veljajo za vašo delovno mesto glede na lokacijo zaposlitve in delodajalca Novartis, vam bo posredovan v okviru nadaljnjih korakov zaposlitvenega postopka.

Predani smo raznolikosti in vključenosti: Novartis si prizadeva ustvariti izjemno, vključujoče delovno okolje in oblikovanje raznolikih timov, saj ti predstavljajo naše bolnike in skupnosti, ki jih oskrbujemo.

Zakaj Novartis: Pomagati bolnikom in njihovim družinam zahteva več kot le inovativno znanost. Potrebna je skupnost zavzetih ljudi, kot ste vi. V Novartisu cenimo sodelovanje, podporo in navdihovanje drug drugega za razvoj prebojnih terapij, ki spreminjajo življenja pacientov. Ste pripravljeni ustvariti svetlejšo prihodnost skupaj z nami?

________________________

Responsibilities:

  • Scientific engagement: Conduct high-quality, non-promotional scientific exchange with HCPs and Medical Experts, contextualizing relevant clinical data and scientific developments in line with local TA priorities.
  • External relationships and partnerships: Build and maintain trusted relationships and scientific partnerships with MEs, key institutions, scientific societies, and academia, representing the company as a credible scientific ambassador.
  • Local medical direction: Translate regional and global medical direction into prioritized local activities and serve as a key medical contact for assigned TAs.
  • Launch and cross-functional medical support: Provide medical expertise to cross-functional teams and support launch readiness and lifecycle activities within appropriate non-promotional boundaries.
  • Medical education and scientific communication: Plan and support medical education, scientific meetings, advisory boards, and other scientific activities, ensuring scientific accuracy and local relevance.
  • Insights and evidence generation: Capture and communicate actionable field insights and unmet needs, and support permitted evidence-generation activities.
  • Medical Governance: Act as a key interface or local point of contact for Medical Governance, ensuring activities, engagements, materials, reviews, documentation, and traceability comply with global/local SOPs, policies, ethical standards, and applicable regulatory and ERC requirements.
  • Medical Information: Manage or coordinate Medical Information requests and ensure scientifically accurate, balanced, and non-promotional responses.
  • Documentation and audit readiness: Maintain accurate reporting, CRM records, activity tracking, and other required documentation to ensure traceability, process adherence, and audit readiness.
  • Professional and organizational responsibilities: Maintain professional development, share knowledge, meet agreed objectives and KPIs, and comply with organizational requirements.

Requirements:

  • Education: Advanced scientific degree (MD, PharmD, PhD, MSc in Life Sciences) or equivalent.
  • Business fluency in Slovene and English language is required.
  • At least two years of professional experience in pharmaceutical industry in Medical Affairs roles or in related functions.
  • Scientific and medical experience: Field-based scientific engagement experience is preferred, with experience in local medical/educational activities, clinical data interpretation, and clinical research considered an advantage.
  • Scientific engagement: Ability to engage confidently in peer-to-peer scientific dialogue, simplify complex scientific information, and collect, synthesize, and communicate insights effectively.
  • Medical governance & integrity: Familiarity with pharmaceutical compliance and Medical governance standards, combined with high integrity, sound ethical judgment, and a patient-centric mindset.
  • Planning & collaboration: Strong planning and prioritization skills, with the ability to operate effectively across field- and office-based medical roles and collaborate successfully in cross-functional, matrix environments.
  • Mindset & interpersonal effectiveness: Scientific curiosity and a growth mindset, with the credibility to build strong relationships, influence without authority, and remain adaptable and resilient when navigating ambiguity.

Rewards

title: Quality and Compliance Regulated Software Systems
description:
We are seeking a Quality & Compliance Manager to lead the quality assurance and regulatory compliance efforts for a new cloud-native software platform being developed for a highly regulated industry. This role will be instrumental in ensuring that our software development lifecycle, deployment processes, and product releases meet all applicable regulatory requirements, including GxP and FDA 21 CFR Part 11.

As the Quality & Compliance Manager, you will work closely with internal leadership and external development partners to define and enforce quality standards, oversee validation activities, and ensure that our systems are built and maintained in a state of control. This is a hands-on role that combines quality leadership with practical execution of validation and compliance processes.

What you will do:

  • Define and implement the quality and compliance strategy for a regulated software product, including validation planning, risk management, and change control.

  • Ensure all software development and deployment activities comply with applicable regulations (e.g., FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, GAMP 5).

  • Lead the Computer System Validation (CSV) process, including authoring and reviewing validation plans, test protocols (IQ/OQ/PQ), traceability matrices, and validation summary reports.

  • Collaborate with internal product and engineering leads to embed quality and compliance requirements into the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

  • Review and approve documentation, including user requirements, functional specifications, and design documents, to ensure traceability and audit readiness.

  • Oversee the implementation of audit trails, electronic signatures, access controls, and data integrity features in the product.

  • Coordinate with external development partners to ensure quality standards and validation deliverables are met.

  • Support internal and external audits, including preparation of documentation and responses to findings.

  • Establish and maintain a quality management system (QMS) for software development and deployment activities.

  • Provide training and guidance to internal and external teams on quality and compliance best practices.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, or Quality Management).

  • 8 years of experience in software quality assurance or compliance roles, with at least 3 years in a regulated industry (e.g., life sciences, medical devices, healthcare).

  • Deep understanding of GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, and Computer System Validation (CSV) principles.

  • Experience with validation of cloud-based and/or SaaS software platforms.

  • Familiarity with Agile and DevOps methodologies, and how to adapt them for compliance in regulated environments.

  • Strong documentation skills and experience with validation artifacts (e.g., URS, FRS, test protocols, traceability matrices).

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across internal teams and external partners.

  • No immigration sponsorship is available for this role at this time.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with GAMP 5, ISO 13485, or other relevant quality frameworks.

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure preferred; AWS or GCP also valued).

  • Experience supporting regulatory inspections or audits (e.g., FDA, EMA).

  • Knowledge of AI/ML systems and their validation in regulated environments is a plus.

Annual or Hourly Compensation Range

The base salary range for this position is $107,600.00 - $161,500.00. This position is eligible for annual bonus pay based on performance, per plan terms. Many factors are taken into consideration when determining compensation, such as experience, education, training, geography, etc. We comply with all minimum wage and overtime laws.

title: Structured Data Foundation Model Engineer, Modern Data Stack
description:
Our work at NVIDIA is dedicated towards a computing model focused on visual and AI computing. For two decades, NVIDIA has pioneered visual computing, the art and science of computer graphics, with our invention of the GPU. The GPU has also shown to be spectacularly effective at solving some of the most complex problems in computer science. Today, NVIDIA’s GPU simulates human intelligence, running deep learning algorithms and acting as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. We are looking to grow our company and teams with the smartest people in the world and there has never been a more exciting time to join us!


NVIDIA is redefining what’s possible with AI, and our Structured Data Foundation Model team is at the forefront of that mission. We’re building unified foundation models that understand structured data in its many forms: relational databases and heterogeneous graphs, tabular data, and time series. As an engineer on this team, you’ll be designing and experimenting with novel architectures (Transformers, GNNs, and beyond) that generalize across diverse schemas, domains, and data modalities. Your work will directly impact real-world applications spanning recommendation systems, demand forecasting, fraud detection, and predictive maintenance. If you’re excited about relational learning, tabular modeling, time series forecasting, and building AI systems that go far beyond single-table benchmarks, this is the team for you.


What you’ll be doing:

· You will contribute to our next generation of structured data foundation models.

· Collaborate with researchers/engineers to enhance our foundation models to operate over relational schemas, heterogeneous graphs, tabular data, and time series.

· Design and run benchmarks that evaluate generalization across structured data domains, and use the results to drive model improvements.

· Leverage your knowledge in ML and AI to tackle real challenges while contributing to scalable and adaptable solutions that push the boundaries of what’s possible.

· Work may span the full lifecycle of modern ML systems: from architecture design/training to post-training optimization and inference acceleration.


What we need to see:

· MS or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or equivalent program

· Proficiency in Python and PyTorch

· At least 5 years of research experience in designing ML algorithm solutions

· Practical experience in using Predictive Models in Real World Applications


Ways to stand out from the crowd:

· Experience with time series forecasting, tabular, or relational foundation models (e.g., Chronos, TimesFM, TabICL, TabPFN, or similar), including pretraining, fine-tuning, or benchmarking

· Familiarity with graph-based machine learning; publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, KDD, or similar


NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

description:
NVIDIA is at the forefront of the generative AI revolution! The Algorithmic Model Optimization Team focuses on optimizing generative AI models such as large language models (LLMs), vision-language models (VLMs), and diffusion models for maximal inference efficiency using techniques ranging from quantization, speculative decoding, sparsity, distillation, pruning to neural architecture search, and automated deployment strategies.

Our work includes conducting applied research to improve model efficiency as well as developing an innovative open-source model optimization platform (NVIDIA Model Optimizer). Our software is used both internally across NVIDIA and externally by research and engineering teams alike developing best-in-class AI models.

We are seeking a GenAI Algorithms Intern to help optimize state-of-the-art generative AI models like LLMs, VLMs, multimodal and diffusion models. In this role, you will design, implement, and productionize model optimization algorithms for inference and deployment on NVIDIA’s latest hardware platforms. The focus is on ease of use, compute and memory efficiency, and achieving the best accuracy–performance tradeoffs through software–hardware co-design.

Your work will span multiple layers of the AI software stack—ranging from algorithm design to integration—within NVIDIA’s ecosystem (Model Optimizer, NeMo/Megatron, TensorRT-LLM) and open-source frameworks (PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, SGLang). You may also dive deeper into GPU-level optimization, including custom kernel development with CUDA and Triton.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Help design and build modular, scalable model optimization software platforms that deliver exceptional user experiences while supporting diverse AI models and optimization techniques.
  • Explore, develop, and integrate innovative deep learning optimization algorithms (quantization, speculative decoding, sparsity, distillation, pruning, neural architecture search) into NVIDIA's AI software stack.
  • Deploy optimized models into leading open-source inference frameworks and contribute specialized APIs, model-level optimizations, and new features tailored to the latest NVIDIA hardware capabilities.
  • Collaborate with NVIDIA teams on model optimization solutions for customer use cases, aiming for optimal end-to-end workflows and balanced accuracy–performance trade-offs.
  • Conduct GPU kernel-level profiling to identify and capitalize on hardware and software optimization opportunities (e.g., efficient attention kernels, KV cache optimization, parallelism strategies).

What we need to see:

  • Pursuing a Master's or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Applied Math, or a related field.
  • Strong deep learning background and hands-on experience with language models.
  • Solid foundation in algorithms and programming.
  • Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and modern ML frameworks/tools.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with model optimization and efficiency (e.g., quantization, distillation, pruning).
  • Contributions to PyTorch, JAX, vLLM, SGLang, or other machine learning training and inference frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning generative AI models on large-scale GPU clusters.
  • Knowledge of GPU architectures and compilation stacks, and the ability to analyze and debug end-to-end performance.
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA’s deep learning SDKs (Model Optimizer, NeMo).

Increasingly known as “the AI computing company” and widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. Are you creative, motivated, and love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you! Come, join our model optimization group, where you can help build real-time, cost-effective computing platforms driving our success in this exciting and rapidly-growing field.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Software Engineer - AI Solutions
description:
We are looking for a talented Software Engineer to join the AI Solutions team in NVIDIA's Linux Networking Drivers organization. Our mission is to bring AI into every stage of how we build software: design, development, verification, debugging, and release. We build AI agents and tools that make our engineers faster and our drivers better.
