title: Java developer
description:
Location: Praha, Czechia

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

Thales in the Czech Republic employs over 400 people from 45 different nationalities. A total of 15 teams work on projects for government agencies, banking, mobile services and the Internet Of Things (IoT) technology. At the core of our business is the development of software which we configure and embed in a multitude of different devices and form factors. These include many kinds of payment cards, SIM cards, travel passes, secure eBanking devices, authentication tokens, machine identification modules (MIM), and secure ID documents including ePassports, eID and eHealth cards, as well as eDriving licenses. Because of the international environment surrounding us every day, it comes as no surprise that English is our official corporate language.

Build security-critical backend system that millions of users rely on - with modern Java, modern Spring, and a team that ships, owns, and continuously improves the platform.

We’re a product company in the cybersecurity/identity space. That means real engineering problems (security, scale, correctness, reliability), real ownership (you build it, you run it), and real influence (strong partnership with Product, not ticket-taking).

Why this role is different

  • Modern stack, by design: We stay on the newest Java LTS and the newest Spring Framework (security expectations make this non-negotiable - and it’s a great side effect for engineers).
  • Pragmatic testing: We value confidence over coverage. Integration-first where it matters. Minimal mocking. Tests that catch real issues.
  • Strong CI/CD culture: Automated pipelines, multiple test layers, fast feedback, high signal.
  • True ownership: We deploy to production ourselves and own the full lifecycle.
  • AI-enabled engineering (for real): Company-backed initiative with tooling, guidelines, and people driving adoption - great opportunity to level up how you use AI effectively.
  • Voice and influence: Engineers are expected to speak up, challenge solutions, and improve the platform, even beyond our team boundaries.

What you’ll do

  • Design and deliver backend services where security, correctness, and maintainability are first-class requirements.
  • Break down ambiguous, high-impact problems into a clear plan and ship iteratively.
  • Collaborate closely with Product to craft solutions that are both technically sound and user-aware.
  • Improve platform-wide concerns: reliability, observability, performance, developer experience, and deployment safety.
  • Raise the bar through thoughtful code reviews, pragmatic architecture decisions, and knowledge sharing.

Our tech stack (high-level)

  • Java (latest LTS), Spring Framework (latest)
  • Kubernetes, Helm, Skaffold, GitOps
  • AWS
  • CI/CD with extensive automated testing
  • Strong automation mindset across build, deploy, and operations

What we’re looking for

Must-haves

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Deep expertise in Java and strong hands-on experience with Spring
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Fluent English (spoken and written)
  • Ability to work autonomously: you can take a big problem, de-risk it, and drive it to completion, while pulling others in when needed
  • Strong engineering intuition: you challenge weak solutions, avoid “bare minimum,” and care about long-term quality

How you work

  • You like clarity, but you’re not blocked by ambiguity
  • You optimize for outcomes, not just activity
  • You enjoy improving shared foundations (platform, tooling, patterns), not only “your” service

Bonus points (nice to have, not required)

If you don’t have these yet - curiosity and the willingness to learn matter more. We’ll help you grow through hands-on work with experienced engineers.

  • AuthN/AuthZ flows: OIDC, OAuth2, MFA, WebAuthn, SAML, SCIM
  • Interest in CIAM/IAM concepts: consent, identity lifecycle, federation, credential management, RBAC, token-based security
  • Distributed systems / event-driven experience where scale, availability, and consistency matter
  • Observability & performance tuning: metrics/tracing, JVM optimization, load testing
  • Cryptography fundamentals: key management, secure hashing, TLS, JWT signing
  • Multi-tenant architectures, data isolation, secure configuration management
  • IaC / DevOps: Terraform, CloudFormation, GitOps workflows
  • Balanced testing strategy: contract tests, integration-first, minimal mocking, maintainable test suites

What you get

  • High-impact work in a security domain that genuinely matters
  • Modern Java + Spring, with a team that actively keeps tech current
  • A culture of ownership: build, ship, operate, improve
  • Strong DevEx focus and automation mindset
  • Free access to Udemy courses
  • Mentorship, onboarding, and an environment where learning is expected and supported

Hiring process (transparent and respectful)

Typical steps:

  • Intro call (mutual fit, expectations)
  • Technical conversation focused on real-world backend engineering with practical exercise and deep-dive discussion (designed to be relevant, not “leetcode theatre”)
  • Final team / culture conversation

Ready to build secure, modern backend systems in Prague?

Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile. If you’d rather start with a conversation, send a short note with:

  • what you’re building now,
  • what kind of problems you want next,
  • and what “great engineering culture” means to you.

At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

title: Postdoctoral Researcher/Assistant Research Scientist – AI, Cybersecurity & High-Performance Research Computing
description:
Job Title

Postdoctoral Researcher/Assistant Research Scientist – AI, Cybersecurity & High-Performance Research Computing

Agency

Texas A&M University - Central Texas

Department

College of Business Administration

Proposed Minimum Salary

$6,666.67 monthly

Job Location

Killeen, Texas

Job Type

Staff

Job Description

Texas A&M University–Central Texas invites applications for a Postdoctoral Researcher/Assistant or Associate Research Scientist position with expertise in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Cybersecurity, and High-Performance Computing (HPC).

The successful candidate will be self-motivated, creative, and team-oriented, with a strong background or research interests in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Cybersecurity. We are especially interested in candidates with hands-on experience applying agentic AI to cybersecurity, for example, autonomous or multi-agent, tool-using systems for threat detection, incident response, or vulnerability assessment.

You will work in the Center for Cybersecurity Innovation at Texas A&M University – Central Texas, as we actively expand our research focus to include emerging areas such as agentic AI, next-generation deep learning architectures, privacy-preserving techniques, automated frameworks for real-time cyber threat detection and mitigation, and the design and implementation of a dedicated High-Performance Computing (HPC) lab. This standalone HPC facility will serve as an open, high-capacity computing infrastructure accessible to researchers, faculty, and students across the university.

In this position, you will design and implement practical, agentic AI solutions for cybersecurity anomaly detection, conduct real-world empirical evaluations, explore innovative techniques for privacy preservation, and assist in the setup, configuration, and ongoing operational rollout of the new multi-user HPC lab environment.


This position is currently funded through a grant with an anticipated funding end date of November 22, 2027. Texas A&M University - Central Texas is committed to retaining this position after the grant has ended, if financially feasible.

About the University:

Texas A&M University-Central Texas (A&M-Central Texas) became a stand-alone university on May 27, 2009, one of 12 universities within the Texas A&M University System. A&M-Central Texas is an upper-level institution offering the junior- and senior-level coursework needed to successfully complete baccalaureate degrees and all coursework leading to the completion of graduate degrees, including master’s and specialist programs.

The university provides a wide range of flexible course schedules, including online, hybrid, evening, and weekend classes. The beautiful new campus of A&M-Central Texas is located on 672 acres of land in Killeen, Texas. Located in the heart of Central Texas, Killeen has a city population of over 153,000, a metro population of 496,000, and a thriving economy fueled by Fort Hood, one of the largest military bases in the country. Killeen is approximately an hour north of Austin and is situated within the I-35 corridor, one of the fastest-growing trans-metropolitan regions in North America. This area is known for its affordable living, welcoming community, rich cultural offerings, and well-developed infrastructure. Killeen offers convenient access to major metro areas such as Dallas-Fort Worth, Austin, and Houston.

A Presidential Proclamation issued on September 19, 2025, imposes a $100,000 fee on all new H‑1B petitions filed after September 21, 2025, and Texas A&M University–Central Texas will not pay this fee. Additionally, a moratorium issued by Governor Abbott on January 27, 2026, restricts the filing of new H‑1B petitions unless approved by the Texas Workforce Commission. Accordingly, if you will now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status this moratorium may affect our ability to employ you should you be selected as the final candidate. Applicants must be authorized to work for any U.S. employer.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead or assist with the technical implementation, deployment, and configuration of a standalone High-Performance Computing (HPC) lab environment; help establish user onboarding protocols, multi-tenant resource management policies, and hardware access workflows so the facility can be used broadly by cross-disciplinary researchers and students.
  • Architect, implement, and evaluate next-generation AI/ML frameworks (including agentic AI, deep learning, and privacy-preserving methods) for threat detection and mitigation.
  • Design, build, and evaluate agentic AI systems (e.g., autonomous or multi-agent, tool-using LLM-based agents) for cybersecurity use cases such as automated threat hunting, incident triage/response, and vulnerability assessment.
  • Execute rigorous experimental evaluations to benchmark AI performance and privacy safeguards in realistic cybersecurity environments.
  • Supervise and guide undergraduate and graduate research assistants working on AI and cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Author high-impact manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals and top-tier conference proceedings, providing empirical benchmarks for the broader research community.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Earned doctorate in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, or a closely related field; or an equivalent combination of education and related experience.
  • Strong programming background (e.g., Python, C/C++).
  • High self-motivation, creativity, and a collaborative mindset.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience in cybersecurity, AI research, and/or high-performance computing (HPC) lab environments.
  • Demonstrated experience with agentic AI (e.g., autonomous or multi-agent, tool-using LLM-based systems) applied to cybersecurity problems such as threat detection, automated incident response, or vulnerability assessment.
  • Hands-on proficiency with AI frameworks and libraries (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Jupyter).
  • A track record of peer-reviewed scientific publications.
  • Experience conducting empirical evaluations, user studies, or usability assessments.

Salary: $80,000

Hours: Monday - Friday; 8:00 am to 5pm. Occasional weeknights and/or weekends.

Supervision of Others: This position does not supervise employees.

Work Location: This is not a remote position. The selected candidate will be required to work on campus.

To Apply:

Please apply directly on our Texas A&M University-Central Texas Job Site. Please submit a cover letter, a resume, and the contact information of three professional references when applying for this position.

All positions are security-sensitive. Applicants are subject to a criminal history investigation, and employment is contingent upon the institution’s verification of credentials and/or other information required by the institution’s procedures, including the completion of the criminal history check.

Equal Opportunity/Veterans/Disability Employer.

title: Communications Business Analyst
description:
At TC Energy, we are proud to connect the world to the energy it needs. Guided by our values of safety in every step, personal accountability, one team and active learning, we deliver the critical energy that North America and the world rely on while balancing reliability, affordability and sustainability.


Join us. Connect to what matters.


The Opportunity

Reporting to the Manager, Communications Operations, Brand & Governance, the Communications Business Analyst plays a key role in shaping how employees connect, communicate and access information across TC Energy.

Working as part of an integrated communications team, this position leads strategic initiatives that enhance communication channels, tools and programs across Canada, the U.S. and Mexico. A significant focus of the role is advancing communications channel modernization, partnering with Communications, Information Services and business leaders to improve the employee experience, strengthen connection across a geographically dispersed workforce and enhance access to information for field and operational employees.

Combining business analysis, project management and communications strategy, the role supports digital transformation and continuous improvement initiatives that help shape the future of employee communications at TC Energy. The position also plays an important role in the operational effectiveness of the Communications function through governance, business planning, budget management and performance reporting.

The successful candidate will be process-focused and adaptable in their approach to meet business needs and organizational culture. An organized, collaborative and self-motivated professional with strong curiosity and a passion for continuous improvement will be well positioned to succeed in this role.

Note: We request all applicants to please include a cover letter at the beginning of their resume.

What you'll do

  • Lead communications channel modernization initiatives, including evaluating, implementing and optimizing technology solutions that improve the employee communication experience and better connect field and operational employees.
  • Support the development of the Communications technology roadmap, helping identify future opportunities, business requirements and investment priorities.
  • Provide business analysis and project management support for cross-functional initiatives, including digital transformation, communications technology and employee experience projects.
  • Provide support for Communications budgeting, forecasting and reporting processes, delivering analysis and recommendations that support strategic planning, investment decisions and departmental priorities.
  • Monitor Communications budgets and vendor expenditures by tracking spend, reporting on performance against plan and identifying opportunities to optimize resources in support of business objectives.
  • Support the operational effectiveness of the Communications function through governance, business planning, performance measurement, reporting and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain communications policies, standards and governance frameworks, working with business partners to support compliance, consistency and effective channel management.
  • Lead communications channel reviews, audits and optimization initiatives, using data and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Build strong relationships across Communications, Information Services and business teams to support stakeholder alignment and successful project delivery.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or certificate in a relevant post-secondary field such as business analytics or business technology
  • 4+ years of progressive experience in business analysis, project management, communications, technology implementation, operational planning or a related discipline.
  • Experience leading or supporting cross-functional projects involving technology, process improvement, organizational change or communications transformation.
  • Demonstrated ability to gather business requirements, analyze information and translate business needs into practical solutions and recommendations.
  • Experience managing budgets, forecasting, reporting or business planning activities.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and critical thinking skills with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing or supporting technology solutions, digital transformation projects or communications channel modernization initiatives.
  • Experience with communications platforms and Microsoft 365 tools, including SharePoint and Viva.
  • Experience developing governance frameworks, policies, standards or business processes.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships and supporting procurement or contract administration activities.
  • Knowledge of change management principles and practices.
  • Experience working in a large, complex or highly regulated organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to introduce and implement governance and programs successfully
  • Experience working with individuals from all levels of an organization, from field support to senior leaders
  • Background in managing budgets and programs
  • Ability to analyze diverse data sets and multi-task effectively while maintaining a strong focus and attention to detail


This position requires candidates to:

  • Participate in the Communications on-call program as part of a shared team rotation, including periodic digital support shifts involving media monitoring, social media monitoring, website updates and content publishing. This responsibility may require support outside regular business hours while on call.
  • Occasional travel within North America.

To remain competitive, support our high-performance culture and allow for more flexibility in the way we work, we offer a hybrid work model and flexible dress code for our eligible office-based workforce in Canada, the U.S. and Mexico. #LI-Hybrid


About our business


We are a leader in North American energy infrastructure, spanning Canada, the U.S. and Mexico. For over 75 years, we have proudly connected the world to the energy it needs. Every day, we move more than 30 per cent of the natural gas used across the continent and connect LNG exports to global markets, powering communities and industries. Complemented by strategic ownership and low-risk investments in power generation, our infrastructure delivers affordable, reliable and sustainable energy across North America. Our field operations span seven Canadian provinces, 34 U.S. states and seven Mexican states. Together, we strengthen the connections that deliver the energy the world relies on-every day.

title: Quality Assurance Chemist
description:
Ecolab is seeking a Quality Assurance Chemist to join our team in Vancouver, WA. The Quality Assurance Chemist is responsible for ensuring product quality, regulatory compliance, and laboratory excellence through inspection, testing, documentation management, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role supports manufacturing, warehouse, and quality systems activities by conducting inspections, maintaining laboratory operations, investigating quality issues, and supporting internal and external audits. The successful candidate will serve as a technical resource to Operations and Warehouse teams while maintaining compliance with company, customer, and regulatory requirements.


What You Will Do:

Quality Inspection & Testing

  • Perform batch inspections in accordance with Quality Control Requirements (QCR).
  • Prepare reagents, standards, and test solutions for laboratory testing.
  • Conduct non-routine testing, sample preparation, and special project work as required.
  • Review inspection methods, specifications, and testing requirements through the Management of Change (MOC) process.

Laboratory Operations

  • Inspect, calibrate, verify, and maintain laboratory equipment.
  • Maintain adequate inventory of laboratory consumables, chemicals, reagents, and testing supplies.
  • Maintain accurate records related to inspections, reagent preparation, equipment calibration, and laboratory activities.
  • Dispose of expired chemicals and reagents in accordance with company safety and environmental procedures.
  • Maintain laboratory notebooks and quality records in accordance with retention requirements.

Quality Systems & Compliance

  • Support external audits and certification activities, including NSF, Kosher, Halal, ISO, and Responsible Care (RC) programs.
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation and records.
  • Review and maintain laboratory Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and work instructions.
  • Review controlled documents through the Electronic Quality Management System (eQMS).
  • Submit and manage Quality Change Requests (QCRs) and correction requests as needed.

Investigation & Continuous Improvement

  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for first-pass failures and quality deviations.
  • Recommend material treatment, rework, release, or disposition decisions.
  • Support customer complaints, laboratory inquiries, quality investigations, and corrective actions.
  • Identify and implement process and quality improvement opportunities.
  • Participate in Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) initiatives and cross-functional improvement projects.

Inventory & Material Management

  • Review blocked, restricted, expired, and short shelf-life inventory for disposition decisions.
  • Coordinate the management and physical inventory of restricted and blocked stock.
  • Provide quality support related to material status, release decisions, and inventory controls.

Safety & Environmental Compliance

  • Record, communicate, and escalate safety and quality observations.
  • Conduct stormwater inspections and disposition evaluations.
  • Support environmental compliance programs and site safety initiatives.
  • Promote a culture of quality, safety, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Food Science, or a related scientific field.
  • 2 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, laboratory testing, or manufacturing quality systems.
  • Knowledge of laboratory techniques, analytical testing, and quality documentation practices.
  • Experience with equipment calibration, maintenance, and laboratory recordkeeping.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience in root cause analysis.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and electronic quality management systems.
  • No immigration sponsorship is available for this role

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in chemical manufacturing or related industries. Water chemistry experience.
  • Familiarity with ISO or Responsible Care standards.
  • Experience supporting internal and external audits.
  • Knowledge of quality management systems, and change control processes.
  • Experience with environmental compliance programs and stormwater inspections.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Ability to interpret specifications, testing requirements, and quality standards.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Effective organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects and meet deadlines.
  • Strong customer service mindset when supporting internal and external stakeholders.

Working Conditions:

  • Laboratory and manufacturing environment.
  • Frequent standing, walking, and movement throughout production and warehouse areas.
  • Occasional lifting of laboratory supplies and samples.
  • Use of personal protective equipment (PPE) as required.
  • Exposure to chemicals, laboratory reagents, and manufacturing processes in accordance with established safety procedures.

title: Sr. Director, Wealth Financial Consolidation & KPI Reporting
description:
About the Role

Integrity Wealth is a multi-business platform, and leadership needs one trusted view of how it performs. We are looking for a Senior Director to own the consolidation of financial and KPI reporting across every wealth business unit, and to make sure the data behind it is correct, consistently defined, and well managed.

Reporting to the CFO of Integrity Wealth, you will build the division-level view that executives, the Board, and our ownership group rely on, and you will be a key collaborator across the business units to help them build the systems and processes to clearly manage the data. This is a leadership role for someone who combines technical depth in consolidation and FP&A with the influence to set standards across business units that do not directly report to you.


What You Will Do


Consolidated reporting and planning

  • Own the consolidated monthly and quarterly financial and KPI reporting package for Integrity Wealth, including P&L, EBITDA, margins, revenue by business unit, and division-level KPIs.
  • Lead the consolidated annual budget, rolling forecast, and long-range plan, rolling up BU submissions into a single division view.
  • Deliver executive-level commentary on variances, trends, risks, and opportunities across the division, with forward-looking analysis, not only historical results.
  • Prepare Board, lender, and sponsor-ready materials and support ad hoc requests from the CFO and executive leadership.

Data verification and BU accountability

KPI framework and governance

  • Own the division-wide KPI dictionary: definitions, calculation methodologies, targets, and data sources, applied consistently across every business unit.
  • Maintain the reporting calendar, data-submission standards, and documentation and controls over models, KPI calculations, and consolidation processes.

Leadership and partnership

  • Lead and develop the consolidation and reporting team.

  • Work with Accounting, Data & Analytics, Technology, and Sales and Operations leaders to connect operational activity to financial outcomes.
  • Support M&A diligence and the integration of newly acquired businesses into the consolidated reporting structure.

KPIs You Will Oversee

  • Financial: revenue growth, gross profit and margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and margin, forecast accuracy, operating leverage, cash flow and liquidity.
  • Revenue and business performance: revenue by business unit and advisor group, recurring vs. transactional revenue, advisory revenue and AUM, production trends, retention, concentration, and revenue per advisor.
  • Operational: advisor growth, AUM/AUA, account and client growth, productivity, compensation and payout trends, technology and vendor costs, and headcount.
  • New / Existing / Lost advisor NNA tracking, with associated revenue and profit impacts

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or financial reporting, including experience consolidating results across multiple business units or legal entities.
  • Experience leading teams and influencing finance partners and business leaders outside your direct reporting line.
  • Demonstrated experience designing KPI frameworks and data governance or certification processes.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements, account mapping, intercompany eliminations, and reconciliation of management reporting to the general ledger.
  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills; experience with consolidation, planning, and BI tools such as OneStream, Anaplan, Oracle EPM / Hyperion, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across multiple BU rollup environments.
  • Experience presenting to senior leadership and Boards; ability to explain complex results to non-financial audiences.
  • Sound judgment, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities against executive deadlines.
  • Clear ability to utilize AI to solve complex problems at a detailed data level.

Preferred

  • Experience in a private equity–backed or rapidly growing, multi-entity organization, including sponsor or lender reporting.
  • M&A diligence and integration experience.

title: Engineering Technician
description:
Engineering Technician I – VTC


Position Summary


The Engineering Technician I provides hands-on support for engineering development, testing, and product validation activities. This role assists with the assembly, troubleshooting, modification, and testing of mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and electromechanical systems. The successful candidate will support engineers in developing new products, improving existing designs, and maintaining laboratory and test equipment.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with their hands, solving real-world technical problems, building and modifying equipment, and seeing projects progress from concept through testing and validation. The candidate should be comfortable working independently on assigned projects while also contributing as part of a collaborative engineering team when required.


Essential Responsibilities


  • Set up, operate, maintain, and troubleshoot laboratory and test equipment.
  • Assemble, modify, repair, and test mechanical and electromechanical systems.
  • Assist engineers with prototype development, product testing, validation, and continuous improvement projects.
  • Develop and execute test procedures while collecting, analyzing, and documenting test data.
  • Support PLC-based control systems, instrumentation, sensors, and automated test equipment.
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of National Instruments LabVIEW applications and data acquisition systems.
  • Perform machining, fabrication, and modification of test fixtures, tooling, and prototype components.
  • Support programming and integration of control systems, sensors, and data acquisition hardware.
  • Maintain accurate test records, reports, drawings, and technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Operations personnel to resolve technical issues and support project objectives.
  • Maintain a safe, clean, and organized laboratory and shop environment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications


  • Associate degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering Technology, Engineering Technology, or a related technical field preferred.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to read engineering drawings, schematics, and technical documentation.
  • Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while managing multiple tasks.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with PLC programming and industrial control systems.
  • Familiarity with National Instruments LabVIEW and data acquisition systems.
  • Experience with machining, fabrication, or operation of manual and CNC equipment.
  • Basic programming knowledge (Python, C#, LabVIEW, Ladder Logic, or similar).
  • Experience with instrumentation, sensors, electrical wiring, and automation equipment.
  • Experience using hand tools, power tools, machine tools, and test equipment.
  • Hands-on experience through technical school projects, co-ops, internships, robotics teams, military technical training, makerspaces, automotive projects, or personal technical projects.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who enjoys hands-on technical work and isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves and get dirty when needed. They take pride in building, troubleshooting, repairing, and improving equipment. They are equally comfortable working independently on assigned tasks and collaborating with engineers and fellow technicians to achieve team goals. A natural curiosity, mechanical mindset, strong work ethic, and willingness to learn new technologies are essential for success in this role.

VF Corporation is looking for an exceptional Manager, Financial Closing & Gross-to-Net to join the Financial Closing & Reporting team based in Stabio, Switzerland. The role sits within EMEA central Controllership team and supports a portfolio of iconic brands such as The North Face®, Vans® and Timberland®.

Let’s talk about the role!

In this role, you will be responsible for leading a small team and for month-end closing and reporting activities for the EMEA region, with a specific focus on revenues, margin and customer settlements. You will make sure that provisions, settlements, credit and debit notes, and related accruals are correctly accounted for and reported in the monthly financial results.

You will oversee the preparation of Top Management dashboards and provide ad hoc analysis to support Senior Management decisions. Using a firm understanding of our entity structure, general ledger and financial systems, you will ensure data integrity and drive process improvements by leveraging automation and AI. You will also represent the team in cross-functional projects affecting systems and financial data flows.

Primary Accountabilities:

· Manage, coach and develop team members in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Set priorities, balance the workload and review the team's work.

· Lead the design, management and improvement of the month-end closing process, ensuring that all activities are completed within tight closing deadlines. This includes revenue recognition and accruals, as well as support to the finance community during the monthly close.

· Own the balance sheet reserves for returns, bad debt, off-invoice discounts, chargebacks, cash discounts, and loyalty programmes, ensuring they are adequately supported, reconciled and correctly reflected in the monthly financial results.

· Oversee Gross-to-Net reporting and analysis, as well as the preparation of Top Management dashboards, including variance analysis on revenues and standard margin, customer profitability and the unshipped order book. Provide ad hoc analysis to support Senior Management decisions, often at short notice.

· Oversee daily monitoring of actuals to ensure financial data is complete and accurate.

· Oversee and approve a high volume of credit and debit notes, invoice adjustments, sundry documents and agent commissions, with direct review of complex and high-value cases.

· Coordinate customer claims, disputes and the customer AR reconciliation for terms and conditions with Customer Operations, Credit and the Brands. Coordinate the activities delegated to external service providers.

· Own master data governance and mapping maintenance, making sure the technical structure of the systems stays aligned with business and reporting needs.

· Lead the preparation of the Balance Sheet Review for the areas in scope and support the related review discussions.

· Maintain strong controls and documentation, act as the point of contact for internal and external auditors, and work with Accounting to make sure new accounting standards and policies are correctly implemented.

· Identify and drive process improvements using automation and AI tools to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy and speed up the close.

· Work with Business Intelligence, D&T (Digital & Technology) and AMS (Application Management Services) to improve the tools used for actuals and reporting, resolve system or process issues, and deliver cross-functional projects, including new business models, alongside day-to-day activities.

Skills for Success

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Management Engineering or a related field.
  • 6+ years of relevant experience in Finance, Accounting or Management Accounting, preferably in a multinational company or a Big Four firm.
  • Previous experience managing or coordinating a team.
  • Fluent written and spoken English. Knowledge of Italian is a plus; other European languages (e.g. German, French or Spanish) are an advantage.
  • Strong financial background and solid knowledge of accounting principles.
  • Experience in month-end closing, revenue and margin reporting, and settlement processes.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insights for Senior Management.
  • Strong relationship and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and a heavy workload under tight deadlines, while staying accurate and keeping attention to detail.
  • Continuous improvement mindset, with interest in or experience of applying automation and AI tools to finance processes.
  • Excellent Excel skills and good knowledge of SAP. Knowledge of Vistex, BlackLine, Cognos or other BI tools is a plus.

The Manager, Instrument Systems is responsible for personally conducting while also leading a team of instrument systems professionals who support the lifecycle management, operational performance, and continuous improvement of Biotherapeutics Pharmaceutical Sciences ARD GxP-regulated laboratory systems. The role ensures that instrument systems remain compliant, reliable, inspection-ready, and aligned with business and regulatory requirements while enabling efficient scientific and operational execution.

The role serves as a key liaison between Quality, Global Workplace Experience, Digital, Validation, and Scientific functions to ensure instrument-related risks are proactively managed, regulatory requirements are met, and continuous improvement opportunities are identified and implemented.

  • Develop and maintain procedures, standards, work practices, and documentation supporting the instrument systems program and compliance framework.

  • Identify, prioritize, and implement continuous improvement initiatives that enhance compliance, reliability, system performance, user experience, efficiency, and scalability across the instrument systems organization.

  • BS degree in Biology, Chemistry, or related field with 6+ years of experience in a GMP laboratory or similar field; MS degree with 5+ years, or PhD with 1+ years
  • Significant experience supporting regulated laboratory, manufacturing, or quality environments.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing technical, quality, compliance, or instrument systems teams.
  • Experience with regulated computerized systems, validation, and data integrity programs.
  • Experience supporting audits/inspections on the topic of instrument lifecycle.

Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements)

Key responsibilities include definition and flow-down requirements, system architecture and design, integration, modeling, risk management (FMEA), verification and validation testing, reliability assessment, manufacturing support, and resolution of customer issues. This position influences engineering approaches, projects, and programs within the business, driving improvements in product quality, team effectiveness, and operational efficiency. Operating with moderate autonomy, the role requires strong technical expertise, sound judgment, and significant input into priorities, processes, and strategic decisions.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

The Senior Systems Designer of Digital Cardiovascular Ultrasound, responsible for all systems engineering activities throughout the lifecycle of the digital product. The role ensures alignment of customer workflows, product functionality, quality, reliability, serviceability, manufacturability, regulatory compliance, and cost objectives.

Key responsibilities include definition and flow-down requirements, system architecture and design, integration, modeling, risk management (FMEA), verification and validation testing, reliability assessment, manufacturing support, and resolution of customer issues. The role applies systems engineering principles to translate requirements into effective product solutions through design trade-off analyses, integration, and verification.

This position influences engineering approaches, projects, and programs within the business, driving improvements in product quality, team effectiveness, and operational efficiency. Operating with moderate autonomy, the role requires strong technical expertise, sound judgment, and significant input into priorities, processes, and strategic decisions.

Roles and Responsibilities:

· Lead end-to-end systems engineering activities for digital cardiovascular ultrasound products throughout the medical device development lifecycle, from concept through commercialization and post-market support.

· Own the definition, development, and delivery of product features and clinical applications, including requirements management, architecture development, design analysis, integration, verification, validation, and risk management.

· Drive technical risk identification and retirement while ensuring compliance with applicable quality, regulatory, cybersecurity, and safety requirements.

· Lead cross-functional development teams across engineering, clinical, quality, regulatory, product management, manufacturing, service, and marketing organizations.

· Ensure effective requirements flow-down and traceability from customer and clinical needs to subsystem and component-level specifications.

· Conduct system design trade-off analyses and make data-driven decisions that balance performance, reliability, manufacturability, serviceability, scalability, and cost objectives.

· Lead design control activities including FMEA, hazard analysis, verification and validation planning, reliability testing, defect prevention, and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

· Serve as the primary systems engineering representative for internal and external audits, regulatory submissions, product reviews, and compliance activities.

· Provide technical leadership and mentoring to systems engineering teams, influencing program priorities, development strategies, and execution plans across multiple product generations.

· Collaborate closely with global stakeholders to resolve complex technical challenges, manage dependencies across subsystems, and ensure seamless product integration and customer satisfaction.

· Support manufacturing, field service, and customer issue resolution activities, driving root cause analysis and continuous product improvement initiatives.

Educational Qualifications:

· Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related STEM discipline.


Required Qualifications:

· Minimum of 8+ years of engineering work experience in product development

· Minimum of 6+ years of experience with systems engineering, product development, and design control processes within the medical device or healthcare technology industry.

· Strong understanding of medical device development lifecycle, requirements management, risk management, verification and validation, and regulatory compliance.

· Experience leading cross-functional product development teams and complex technical programs.

· Knowledge of system architecture, subsystem integration, software-hardware interactions, and clinical workflow development.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.


Desired Characteristics:

· Demonstrated experience in systems engineering methodologies in healthcare product development.

· Expertise in FMEA, reliability engineering, and healthcare quality management systems.

· Demonstrated successfully leading new product introductions and multi-generational product development programs.

· Working knowledge of FDA, MDR, IEC 60601, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, and related medical device standards.

· Proven ability to influence technical strategy, mentor engineering teams, and drive execution across global organizations.

Engineering Expectations:

· Cloud-native and hybrid cloud/on-premises product development using AWS services.

· Containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and production observability.

· Secure engineering, identity and access management, encryption, secrets management and DevSecOps.

· Performance, scalability, availability, reliability, fault tolerance and disaster recovery.

· Automated unit, integration, API, system, performance and reliability testing.

· Strong design, coding, debugging, root-cause analysis and technical documentation practices.

· Integration challenges of third party and second party SaaS solutions.

· Working with AI-DLC and software development acceleration.


Healthcare and Medical Device Context:

· Experience in regulated healthcare or medical-device development is required for the Verification Lead and strongly preferred for senior architecture, automation and program roles.

· Strong knowledge on SDLC, PRD process, Risks, FMEAs.

· Awareness of patient-data privacy, cybersecurity and secure handling of clinical information.

· Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards such as DICOM, HL7 and FHIR.

· Experience with real-time clinical data, device connectivity, patient monitoring or high-availability clinical applications is advantageous.

title: Senior Algorithm Engineer -- Autonomous Vehicles
description:
Join our DRIVE Road Structure, Online Mapping, and Context Fusion team as we shape the future of autonomous driving! In this role, you’ll play a key part in developing a comprehensive 3D world model by integrating map and perception data, enabling our vehicles to navigate even the most complex roads and intersections in the U.S. and Europe. Collaborate closely with our perception and planning teams to deliver robust solutions central to our vision for autonomous vehicles. If you’re passionate about advancing human-level AI for navigation in real-world, unconstrained environments, we want you on our team!

  • Build Real-Time 3D World Models: Integrate sensor and external inputs to generate dynamic 3D models for planning and navigation.
  • Enable HD Mapless Driving: Design enriched bird’s-eye-view (BEV) models to support autonomous driving in complex urban environments.
  • Enhance AV Scenarios: Construct fused static obstacle and occupancy grids, and generate occlusion masks to improve scenario understanding.
  • Lead Technology Initiatives: Guide the team in solving challenging AV problems and collaborate hands-on to drive innovation.
  • Mentor and Grow the Team: Recruit, hire, and mentor talented engineers.
  • Ensure Quality and Safety: Develop algorithms that perform reliably on large datasets across varied conditions, adhering to automotive quality and safety standards.

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of experience, including at least 2 years in autonomous vehicles or robotics.
  • 2+ years of technical leadership experience.
  • Deep passion for robotics and autonomous vehicles.
  • Eagerness to learn and solve impactful challenges.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, especially with global teams.
  • Strong independent and analytical software engineering abilities.
  • Experience with embedded or automotive software development.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Expertise in 3D geometry, computer vision, sensor calibration, or state estimation (e.g., Kalman/particle filters).
  • Significant industry experience with self-driving cars.
  • Background in developing real-time computer vision systems.
  • Strong skills in API and framework design.

At NVIDIA, we believe self-driving vehicles will be a transformative achievement for our generation, with the potential to save millions of lives. title: Solutions Architect, Digital Platforms
description:
Job Description Summary

The Architect, Data Integration & Digital Platform Solutions is responsible for designing and governing the data architecture that enables customer data to be securely ingested, transformed, integrated, and leveraged across the organization's digital platform ecosystem.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

The Architect, Data Integration & Digital Platform Solutions is responsible for designing and governing the data architecture that enables customer data to be securely ingested, transformed, integrated, and leveraged across the organization's digital platform ecosystem. This role serves as the technical leader for customer data onboarding, interoperability, integration frameworks, and enterprise data architecture, ensuring that customer data becomes a scalable foundation for analytics, operational intelligence, workflow optimization, and decision support.


Working across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Customer Success, and Commercial teams, this individual will establish the architecture required to connect disparate customer systems and transform fragmented data into actionable insights across Capital Planning, Operations, Clinical Operations, Revenue Optimization, and Supply Chain domains.


This role will require 50% travel.


Essential Responsibilities


Customer Data Integration Strategy

  • Define and execute the architectural strategy for onboarding and integrating customer data into commercial digital platforms.
  • Design scalable data ingestion frameworks to support structured, semi-structured, and unstructured customer data sources.
  • Establish standards and best practices for customer data acquisition, transformation, validation, and enrichment.
  • Ensure data integration architectures support current business requirements and future platform growth.
  • Drive technology decisions that simplify customer onboarding while improving data quality and usability.

Healthcare & Enterprise Data Architecture

  • Design enterprise data models that create a unified view across customer operational, clinical, financial, and asset management systems.
  • Develop architectures that support healthcare interoperability standards including HL7, FHIR, DICOM, and API-based integrations.
  • Create standardized integration patterns for EHR, ERP, CMMS, supply chain, financial, and operational systems.
  • Ensure platform architectures support advanced analytics, machine learning, and enterprise decision intelligence capabilities.

Data Platform & Cloud Architecture

  • Design scalable cloud-based architectures supporting data ingestion, storage, processing, governance, and analytics.
  • Define data pipelines and integration frameworks that support real-time, near real-time, and batch processing requirements.
  • Architect solutions that support large-scale customer data onboarding and multi-tenant platform growth.
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, performance, and scalability of data services.

Data Quality, Governance & Security

  • Establish architecture standards for data quality, lineage, governance, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
  • Design controls that ensure customer data accuracy, completeness, and integrity throughout the data lifecycle.
  • Embed cybersecurity, access controls, and compliance requirements into all integration and data management solutions.
  • Partner with governance teams to ensure adherence to security and regulatory standards.

Cross-Functional Technical Leadership

  • Collaborate with Product Management to define data requirements supporting commercial and customer outcomes.
  • Partner with Engineering teams to implement scalable integration and data platform solutions.
  • Serve as the technical advisor for customer onboarding initiatives, integration planning, and architecture reviews.
  • Guide solution designs that accelerate implementation timelines while minimizing integration complexity.
  • Mentor engineering and technical teams on data architecture best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Healthcare Informatics, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, data architecture, integration architecture, or software engineering leadership.
  • Experience designing and implementing large-scale data integration and analytics platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of data engineering, ETL/ELT frameworks, APIs, cloud platforms, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience working with healthcare, operational, financial, or supply chain data environments.
  • Demonstrated success translating complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Experience with healthcare interoperability standards, including FHIR, HL7, and DICOM.
  • Expertise in cloud-native data platforms and modern data architectures.
  • Experience supporting SaaS, digital health, enterprise analytics, or decision intelligence platforms.
  • Knowledge of AI/ML, predictive analytics, and enterprise reporting architectures.
  • Industry certifications in cloud architecture, data engineering, or enterprise architecture.

Impact of the Role

This role is foundational to the organization's digital growth strategy. The Architect will establish the technical framework that transforms customer data into a strategic asset, enabling scalable platform growth and powering enterprise decision intelligence across Capital Planning, Operations, Clinical Operations, Revenue Management, and Supply Chain optimization. By creating a robust and repeatable data integration architecture, this leader will accelerate customer onboarding, improve data quality, and unlock measurable value for customers through advanced analytics and operational insights.


We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership always with unyielding integrity.


Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

description:

Simple Mills is on a mission to transform the way food is made, creating nourishing products with astounding ingredients and amazing taste. Founded in 2012 by Katlin Smith, our brand has redefined center-aisle grocery by delivering better-for-you products made with unique, nutrient-dense ingredients. Our work has been recognized by Fast Company as a Brand That Matters and a Most Innovative Company, and has been featured in Vogue, Forbes, Women’s Health, and NPR’s How I Built This. In 2024, Inc. named us one of its Best Workplaces, reflecting our dedication to fostering an inspiring and inclusive environment where passionate individuals can make a difference.

Join us as we shape the future of food. Learn more at .

Requirements

Role Description

The Senior Manager, Operations Finance will provide strategic financial leadership and decision support across the Operations organization. This role sits between the Manager and Director levels, combining hands-on ownership of core Operations Finance processes with broader leadership, cross-functional influence, and accountability for improving financial performance. The position will report to the Director, Operations Finance and will partner closely with Operations, Finance, and Accounting leadership. Responsibilities will include:

  • Lead long range planning, annual planning, monthly forecasting, and development of Operations financial KPIs, including gross margin, cost savings, and productivity targets.
  • Own insightful and actionable reporting on Operations financial performance, including COGS forecasting and variance analysis by puct line, spend type, and operational driver.
  • Partner closely with Procurement, Manufacturing, Demand and Supply Planning, Accounting, and other stakeholders to identify risks, evaluate trade-offs, and unlock opportunities to improve financial outcomes.
  • Lead and strengthen BOM management, standard costing, inventory accounting, and cost variance processes in partnership with Accounting and Operations.
  • Drive the identification, prioritization, financial validation, tracking, and measurement of margin improvement and cost savings initiatives.
  • Support capital expenditure budgets and financial analysis for capital projects and other strategic Operations investments.
  • Provide financial leadership for new supplier and co-manufacturer qualifications, transitions, network changes, and other strategic initiatives, including scenario modeling and risk-benefit analysis.
  • Translate complex operational and financial data into clear recommendations and executive-ready narratives that support timely decision-making.
  • Lead cross-functional process improvements, system enhancements, and automation that improve accuracy, visibility, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Build financial acumen across cross-functional teams and foster a culture of strong financial stewardship and accountability.
  • Coach and develop Finance team members while providing day-to-day leadership across key workstreams, with the potential to assume direct people-management responsibilities as the team evolves.
  • Serve as a delegate and thought partner to the Director, Operations Finance, helping shape priorities and represent Operations Finance in cross-functional forums.
  • Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned

Position Requirements

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Finance, with significant experience in Operations, Supply Chain, or CPG Finance preferred.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; advanced degree or professional certification is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of COGS forecasting, variance analysis, standard costing, BOMs, inventory accounting, and key operational performance drivers, including volume, mix, material pricing, scrap, freight, and capacity utilization.
  • Proven ability to lead annual planning and forecasting processes and convert analysis into clear, actionable business recommendations.
  • Demonstrated success driving cost savings, margin improvement, process improvement, and system implementation initiatives.
  • Excellent leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and levels without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Strong business acumen and sound judgment, including the ability to evaluate trade-offs between growth, service, risk, and profitability.
  • Advanced financial modeling and Excel skills; experience with integrated ERP systems required, with NetSuite experience preferred.
  • Experience coaching, developing, or managing others preferred.
  • Self-starter and creative problem solver who thrives in ambiguity, manages multiple priorities, and works with speed and accuracy.
  • A passion for natural food and healthy eating, as well as a desire to positively impact the way food is made.

Benefits

Working at Simple Mills

At Simple Mills, we’re not just building a brand, we’re leading a movement that’s transforming how food is made and enjoyed. If you’re passionate about purpose-driven work and crave a role where you can have a meaningful impact, this is your chance to be part of something bigger.

Why Join Us?

  • Be a Change-Maker
    Play a key role in redefining the food industry, crafting products that nourish people and contribute to a healthier planet.
  • Thrive in a Mission-Driven Community
    Work alongside a dynamic team of innovators and food lovers who are committed to positive change and bold ideas.
  • A Workplace Where You Belong
    We foster an environment where every voice is heard, valued, and empowered. Inclusion and belonging are at the heart of our culture, ensuring that everyone can thrive.
  • A Culture of Integrity and Impact
    We don’t just talk about doing good, we live it. Our team is committed to ethical practices, responsible sourcing, and making decisions that drive real, positive change.
  • Grow with People-First Leadership
    Our supportive leadership team is dedicated to mentorship, collaboration, and your long-term success.
  • Continuous Learning & Development

title: Skin Care Consultant
description:
OVERVIEW

Experience a place of energy, passion, and excitement. A place where the joy of discovery and uncommon artistry blend to create exhilarating buying experiences—for true beauty enthusiasts. At Ulta Beauty, we’re transforming the world one shade, one lash, one cut at a time. Because beauty is powerful.

If you seek greater purpose—a place of vision, mission, and lived values—where voices are heard, contributions valued and recognized and growth opportunities abound, consider Ulta Beauty. Nowhere else are the possibilities quite this beautiful.

GENERAL SUMMARY & SCOPE

The Skin Care Consultant (SCC) is responsible for maximizing sales in the skin category by engaging guests to determine their individual needs, assisting guests in the selection and purchase of skin care merchandise, and maintaining overall store standards, including cleanliness and replenishment. They support the Experience Manager (EM) through a focus on performance (service/retail sales and in-store events), people (guest service and associate culture), and process (operating procedures and compliance standards). This position requires knowledge of skin needs, concerns and functions, a passion for the beauty industry, exceptional guest service, and the aptitude to learn and communicate product knowledge.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES (*Essential Functions)

The SCC is a champion of Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision, and values, and should demonstrate them skillfully and consistently by performing the following duties and responsibilities of the position (as well as all other projects/duties as assigned):

Performance

  • Contribute to meeting or exceeding the store’s goals related to retail and service sales, guest loyalty (including credit), retail shrink and omni-channel sales, with a specific focus on the skin care category as set by Ulta Beauty.
  • Ensure that each guest receives exceptional service by greeting and engaging every guest, personalizing service to their needs, and recommending complementary products and/or services.
  • Courteously handle sales, refunds, and exchanges.
  • Routinely perform skincare analysis and product demonstrations with guests to drive sales and the guest experience.
  • Book appointments for, and support the execution of, services and in-store events that deliver an unrivaled guest experience while delivering on skin care sales goals.
  • Take the initiative to stay informed regarding new and existing industry trends, products, and services during work time and be knowledgeable about the ingredients and benefits of these trends, products, and services to better serve guests.
  • Maintain prompt, regular attendance.

People

  • Contribute to an inclusive environment that supports teammates, peers, and the internal and external guests served.
  • Share the benefits of the guest loyalty program, including credit and the Ulta Beauty app, with guests on the sales floor and when prompted by the Ulta Beauty’s systems.
  • Collaborate with managers and associates throughout the store to help grow the business.
  • Regularly participate in ongoing training, including brand and category education, to enable continuous professional development and drive skin care sales performance.

Process

  • Be knowledgeable of and ensure compliance with Ulta Beauty’s policies, procedures, and standards.
  • Adhere to Ulta Beauty’s dress code.
  • Drive sales by keeping assigned work area replenished, signed, and faced, and ensuring testers are available and maintained in compliance with hygiene standards.
  • Maintain outstanding store operational standards, including cleanliness of the salesfloor, restrooms, cashwrap, backroom, and break area.
  • Participate in completing merchandise resets, planograms, marketing displays, physical inventory procedures, and processing shipment using Ulta Beauty’s technology and best practices.
  • Protect company assets by following loss prevention best practices and providing exceptional guest service.
  • Execute other operational tasks as directed.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • High school diploma is preferred

Experience

  • 1 year of relevant work experience or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience

Skills

  • Demonstrate significant competency in sales, products, and service
  • Demonstrate a passion for skin care, solution-oriented products, and consultative selling
  • Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to positively and proactively handle guest concerns and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills

SPECIAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Work a flexible schedule to include days, evenings, weekends, and holidays
  • Attend brand sponsored trainings

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Frequent mobility throughout the store during shift
  • Frequent standing, bending, reaching, pulling, pushing, and twisting during shift
  • Continuous lifting and/or moving up to 10 lbs. during shift
  • Continuous coordination and manipulation of objects during shift

If an associate has a disability that prevents them from performing an essential function of the job, the Company will engage in the interactive process with the associate to determine whether there is a reasonable accommodation that will enable the associate to perform the essential functions of the job.

description:
Job Description:

The Patient Service Representative (PSR) serves as the first connection between Intermountain and patients. This role embodies Intermountain values and focuses on establishing collaborative relationships with patients and fellow caregivers to deliver the highest level of customer/patient satisfaction. The PSR ensures a superior customer experience by identifying and resolving patient needs related to patient intake and care, which may include greeting and checking-in/out patients, as well as verifying information supplied by patients.

Essential Functions.

  • Provides courteous and professional connections with patients over the phone, in person or via secure messaging. Resolves patient needs skills to ensure a superior customer experience by identifying and resolving patient needs related to patient intake and care.

Proactively requests payments from patients on current and past medical services. Receives and processes those payments following appropriate procedures for handling payments.

title: Help Desk Agent I
description:
Job Description

MileOne Automotive has an exciting opportunity for a Help Desk Technician in our Towson call center.

HOURS: Monday - Friday 8:00 am-4:30 pm.

IN OFFICE

Compensation: $20 - $25 per hour, commensurate with experience

Join our dynamic, growing company as a Help Desk Technician and launch your technology career path in our internal IT department. We are looking for a Tier 1 or Tier 2 level technician who wants to grow with us. This is a fantastic opportunity for a service-oriented problem-solver to join our team, with proactive career paths for learning and advancement.

Help Desk Technician Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customers seeking technical assistance over the phone or email
  • De-escalate situations involving frustrated customers, offering patient assistance and support
  • From the receipt of customer calls and email provide accurate, satisfactory resolution to their technical issues and requests
  • Create tickets that accurately define an issue or service request, and own the ticket through its life cycle
  • Learn and implement ITSM best practices related to Help Desk ticketing and issue troubleshooting and resolution
  • Collaborate with other help desk and IT team staff to improve customer service and to find resolution to more complex issues
  • Learn and implement documentation best practices to support service
  • Utilize escalation processes for unresolved and complex issues to the next level of support personnel

Candidate must-have qualifications:

  • Displays excellent customer service and active listening skills
  • Will be able to ask discovery questions, gather relevant information, and diffuse tense situations with a diverse group of end users
  • Displays excellent customer and management communication, with clear and detailed written communication, professional phone etiquette, and timely communication with IT teams, managers, and users regarding issue status
  • Is energetic, team and service oriented, inquisitive, and professional
  • Has a patient, friendly, and empathetic attitude with end-users and team members
  • Has strong time management, issue management, and decision-making skills, and will take initiative in troubleshooting and resolution
  • Is self-motivated, proactive, and constantly learning
  • Has the ability to identify and troubleshoot basic technical issues (account management, application troubleshooting, network connectivity, device deployment, hardware management, etc.)
  • Lives locally and has reliable transportation to Towson. This role is in-office, and training will include some field service work in the local area.

We would like to see:

  • Previous IT Help Desk experience or previous IT Field Service experience and/or
  • Previous experience with ticketing systems, and/or
  • Limited IT experience and CompTIA A+, Net+, and/or Sec+ certificates, and/or
  • No previous IT experience but have completed computer simulation course work (ex: uCertify, TestOut, Cloud Labs).

Our MileOne Employee Advantage:

MileOne believes that taking care of our employees is the most important step in creating a positive workplace and a successful company. MileOne offers a number of exclusive benefits and programs that are designed to help our employees and their families succeed both at home and in the workplace.

MileOne Employee Advantage includes health and financial benefits, and training and mentoring. We also offer an Employee Purchase Program, the MileOne Support Fund: by Employees, for Employees, the NextMile Scholarship Program, an Employee Assistance Program and more.

MileOne Autogroup is an equal opportunity employer and we maintain a drug free work environment

  • You will take pride in your work and encourage others to do the same
  • Experience with large code bases and version control systems

  • A keen interest in AI and ability to use any AI tool in your day-to-day job
  • Some familiarity with agile frameworks and methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe), and knowledge of their various advantages and pitfalls

title: VP Materials R&D
description:
About the Role

In this key leadership role, you will be responsible for materials innovation, strategic fabric sourcing and development, providing holistic materials leadership across all Gap Inc brands (Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic, Athleta). You will also be directly responsible for Banana Republic materials leadership, translating individual brand aesthetic into clear, executable direction. [MW3.1][MS3.2][MW3.3]You will be a strong, inspirational leader who can leverage consumer insights, mill strategies and key trends to drive fabric development, innovation, costing and positioning. You will lead Gap Inc color operations strategy and the enterprise digital color library. [MW4.1]You will drive a ‘Fabric First’ mentality and strategy throughout the product-to-market process. You will also provide direction and thought partnership to internal Gap Inc teams in North America, as well as the Mill Management and Fabric Engineering teams in Asia based on cross-functional strategies.

Salary Range: $275,000 - $330,000
Employee pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the Gap Inc US-based Materials teams, developing and executing a multi-year fabric R&D strategy aligned with brand and company objectives
  • Partner closely with design, merchandising, production, and sourcing teams to ensure materials meet creative, functional, and commercial requirements; present seasonal R&D trend insights to these teams (as well as company senior executives as needed)
  • Contribute to global sourcing and product assortment strategies based on market research and competitive analysis
  • Lead the Banana Republic R&D team, overseeing key milestones across the product-to-market calendar in collaboration with brand product leadership
  • Research and analyze global textile trends, market needs, new technologies/processes, and consumer preferences to inform and drive fabric innovation
  • Set annual and seasonal trend direction and drive innovation based on Design direction​ and textile industry innovations and macro trends
  • Analyze fabric needs across the company, communicating recommendations to cross functional partners for leveraging qualities across brands and divisions that meet brand and customer needs
  • Establish and monitor seasonal fabric development KPIs and cross-brand discipline on number of seasonal developments, fabric testing and risk assessment to set Gap Inc standards
  • Drive consistent fabric process operating model and discipline
  • Build and maintain physical and digital materials library across Brands​
  • Manage color library, inclusive of color processes, testing and custom color development​
  • Stay abreast of market trends, competitor activity and emerging technologies in the fabric industry
  • Ensure Brand and company Sustainability targets are met through material innovation, supplier collaboration, fiber and fabric innovators

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in textile design, material science, or related field; post-graduate qualifications preferred
  • 15+ years in senior materials roles, with global leadership scope across apparel categories
  • Proven experience driving materials innovation in a global, multi-brand, omni-channel enterprise; proven ability to lead end-to-end fabric development, from ideation to bulk production
  • Deep expertise in textile fibers, yarns, knits, wovens, dying/finishing techniques, fabric construction, textile processes, and color services; Proficiency in fabric testing protocols (colorfastness, shrinkage, pilling, etc.) and compliance standards to ensure product integrity
  • Understanding of technical fabrics including performance materials, wovens, warp knits and seamless garment construction; familiarity with sustainable materials and eco-friendly processes, including knowledge of relevant certifications (GOTS, OEKO-TEX)
  • Ability to specify custom engineering requirements for new materials and resolve manufacturing or costing issues before production; Familiarity with legal aspects of material exclusivity and patent agreements
  • Strong understanding of cost/value engineering, margin management, and the business impact of material choices
  • Strong vendor/mill network across key global regions (Asia, Europe, Americas)
  • Executive-level oral and written business communication skills with demonstrated ability to present complex technical and market information across multiple levels, and to influence at the senior leadership level and across matrixed organizations
  • Track record of recruiting, retaining, and developing high-performing technical talent
  • Strong operational mindset with ability to translate product quality and customer metrics into actioned process innovation
  • Exceptional problem solving and analytical skills; ability to frame new, ambiguous and complex issues; able to generate insight through rigorous analysis
  • Experience leading transformation efforts, including business model innovation and large-scale cost improvements; ability to drive digitization and process improvements within the fabric development workflow
  • Ability to manage multiple projects with urgency and attention to detail
  • Experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems and digital tools for trend analysis, CAD and fabric design

Ability to travel globally

description:
