This leader manages a distributed onshore/offshore support team, drives incident and problem management to resolution, represents TOPS in change governance forums (CAB) and translates operational data into executive-ready insight for senior technology leadership.


Success in this role requires equal strength in technical troubleshooting, process discipline, and clear communication with partners ranging from frontline agents to EVP-level stakeholders.


Responsibilities:


Production Support & Incident Management

  • Lead Level 2/Level 3 triage, escalation, and resolution for advisor-, investor-, and Home O
  • ffice-facing applications, driving issues to closure with development and infrastructure partners.
  • Participate in and, when required, lead incident bridges — setting expectations for participants, capturing impact, coordinating technical towers, and communicating status to business and technology stakeholders.
  • Own ServiceNow queue health across assignment groups: incident, request, problem, and task SLA adherence, backlog aging, unassigned ticket cleanup, and quality of work notes and closure documentation.
  • Direct application and batch monitoring practices (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, AlertSite, and job schedulers), ensuring alerts are actioned using a Problem–Action–Resolution approach rather than acknowledged and closed.
  • Conduct post-incident reviews, identify recurring failure patterns, and convert them into problem records, monitoring enhancements, or permanent fixes.

Change, Release & Risk Governance

  • Serve as an active CAB board member — reviewing change records for risk, blast radius, back-out plans, testing evidence, and implementation quality, and challenging submissions that do not meet standards.
  • Coordinate primary, off-cycle, and emergency release readiness: change breakdowns, restricted change windows, holiday and event freezes, and weekend implementation coverage.
  • Support Disaster Recovery exercises and data center failover events, including go/no-go participation, runbook execution oversight, and post-exercise defect capture.
  • Ensure audit- and regulatory-ready documentation across incidents, changes, and standard operating procedures.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Manage and develop a geographically distributed onshore/offshore support team, including coverage planning, holiday and out-of-office scheduling, and on-call rotation.
  • Facilitate daily and weekly operational huddles covering leadership updates, domain-by-domain ticket health, planned changes, and knowledge transfer status.
  • Set and enforce work expectations for monitoring, ticket updates, follow-ups, and communication standards; hold the team accountable through attestation and spot checks.
  • Mentor analysts and emerging leaders, build cross-training depth across domains, and reduce single points of knowledge.
  • Own the Knowledge Transfer (KT) intake process for new applications entering TOPS support — validating runbooks, access, monitoring, assignment groups, and shadowing before accepting support ownership.

Stakeholder Partnership & Executive Communication

  • Own the recurring handshake between frontline support (ATST/TSHD) and TOPS — reviewing call and ticket trends, closing feedback loops, and eliminating repeat escalations.
  • Draft executive-ready summaries, escalations, and risk communications that are concise, factual, and decision-oriented for senior and EVP-level leadership.
  • Represent TOPS in cross-functional programs such as security uplift, platform migrations, and enterprise modernization efforts, providing operational readiness input and go-live support.
  • Build durable partnerships with Development, QA, Infrastructure, Incident Management, Service Desk, and business operations teams.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Build and maintain operational reporting — SLA assessments, assignment group performance, incident trend analysis, and change volume breakdowns — using ServiceNow reporting, SQL, and Excel.
  • Query supporting data stores directly to validate issues, confirm data integrity, and accelerate root cause analysis.
  • Identify automation and AI-enabled opportunities (within approved enterprise tooling) to reduce manual effort in monitoring, reporting, and ticket handling.
  • Champion documentation standards in Confluence and ServiceNow, including runbooks, SOPs, checklists, and knowledge articles.

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Finance, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum of 7 years in technology operations, production support, or business analysis, including 2+ years leading or formally mentoring a support team.
  • Demonstrated ownership of incident, problem, and change management processes aligned to ITIL practices.
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow (incidents, requests, changes, tasks, reporting) and enterprise monitoring platforms.
  • Working proficiency in SQL for troubleshooting and data validation, plus strong Excel skills for operational reporting.

Preferences:

  • Financial services, wealth management, or broker-dealer experience with familiarity in brokerage and advisory operations.
  • Prior frontline or Level 2 escalation experience that translates into empathy for advisors and end users.
  • Experience managing distributed onshore/offshore teams across time zones.
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (or equivalent process improvement certification).
  • ITIL Foundation certification.
  • Experience with Confluence, Jira, Dynatrace, SolarWinds, AlertSite, Kafka, and enterprise job schedulers.
  • Exposure to Disaster Recovery planning and execution at the data center level.
  • Practical experience applying approved AI tooling to drive support and reporting efficiency.
  • Proven ability to write and deliver executive-level communications — concise summaries, escalations, and risk statements.
  • Experience supporting business-critical, customer-facing applications in a regulated environment.
  • Willingness to support scheduled weekend releases, restricted change windows, and periodic after-hours incident response.

Core Competencies

  • Operational discipline — holds the line on SLAs, documentation quality, and follow-through.
  • Clear communication — adjusts message and depth appropriately for engineers, business partners, and executives.
  • Analytical rigor — asks "why" until root cause is understood; comfortable working directly with data.
  • Calm under pressure — manages competing priorities and high-visibility outages without losing structure.
  • Collaborative influence — builds trust across teams that do not report to them.
  • Continuous improvement mindset — turns recurring pain into repeatable process.
  • Developer of people — invests in mentoring, cross-training, and career growth for the team.

title: Supplier Order Management Planner
description:
ABOUT US


PHINIA: Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow.


PHINIA is a diversified industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket solutions, with a strong portfolio of trusted brands that includes DELPHI®, DELCO REMY®, and HARTRIDGE™. With over 100 years of manufacturing expertise and industry relationships, PHINIA has approximately 12,500 talented employees and over 40 locations in 20 countries and is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA. Read More

JOB PURPOSE

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Supplier Order Management Planner is a key strategic role responsible for ensuring an uninterrupted flow of materials to support manufacturing operations through flawless execution of the supplier ordering process. This position requires an autonomous, highly analytical professional with deep SAP expertise to balance inventory levels, optimize cash flow, and manage relationship metrics with global suppliers.


Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, schedule, and release purchase orders for production materials, ensuring appropriate lead times to maximize plant operating efficiency.
  • Analyze daily inventory availability (Days of Supply) to meet production schedules, maximize cash flow, and increase inventory turnover.
  • Proactively monitor the supply chain to eliminate manufacturing downtime and eradicate extra expenses from premium freights.
  • Partner closely with the supplier base to anticipate bottlenecks, prevent delivery disruptions, and manage recovery plans.
  • Actively participate in engineering change management to smoothly phase components in and out, eliminating financial exposure from obsolete inventory.
  • Own and report operational metrics including OTIF (On-Time In-Full), inventory target variations, and transit costs.


Requirements & Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3 to 5+ years of proven experience in Material Planning, Production Control, or Supplier Order Management within a fast-paced manufacturing environment (Automotive preferred).
  • Bilingual (English & Spanish). Must be fully capable of negotiating and handling complex issues with international suppliers.

title: Cold Caller
description:
We are hiring part-time cold callers to support the US relaunch of a B2B beauty-tech offer. Callers will phone spas, beauty salons, medical clinics, and pharmacies, present a smart mirror and mini lab offer quickly and clearly, and book meetings with interested prospects. The goal of each call is to book a meeting, not to close the sale.

This is a remote, part-time, hourly role of about 20 hours a week, Monday to Friday during US Eastern Time business hours, with no weekends. Callers work from a provided lead list, log all activity in the CRM, and are held to daily activity and results targets. The target start date is the first week of November 2026. Calling begins in Florida, with possible expansion to other US time zones later. The role can grow into self-prospecting and into full-time work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Make 100 to 125 cold calls a day to spas, beauty salons, medical clinics, and pharmacies
  • Present the smart mirror and mini lab offer clearly and quickly on each call
  • Book meetings with interested prospects
  • Hand booked meetings over to the assigned team member
  • Log every call, outcome, and next step in the CRM the same day
  • Work from the provided lead lists (self-prospecting may be added later)
  • Make B2B calls only; no B2C calls
  • Work toward daily and weekly KPIs, with hours and productivity tracked through a time-tracking tool

Requirements

  • 2 years of experience in cold calling, sales, or appointment setting
  • Excellent spoken English and strong communication skills, without a heavy accent
  • Comfortable using a dialer and logging calls in a CRM
  • Confident pitching to business owners and managers
  • Available to start the first week of November 2026
  • Available to work US Eastern Time business hours, Monday to Friday
  • Performs well on a mock cold call in the 2nd interview
  • Experience with a CRM-based dialer (preferred)
  • Experience selling to spas, salons, clinics, or pharmacies, or in beauty, skincare, or wellness (preferred)

Benefits

  • Join Our Dynamic Team: Experience our fun, inclusive, innovative culture that values your unique contributions and supports your professional growth.
  • Embrace the Opportunities: Seize daily chances to learn, innovate, and excel. Make a real impact in your field.

  • Fast-Paced Thrills: Thrive in a high-energy, engaging atmosphere. Embrace challenges and reap stimulating rewards.

title: Senior Lead Architect
location: New York / New Jersey Metro Area - USA (Remote)
description:
Cohesity is a leader in AI-powered data security and management. Aided by an extensive ecosystem of partners, Cohesity makes it easy to secure, protect, manage, and get value from data — across the data center, edge, and cloud. Cohesity helps organizations defend against cybersecurity threats with comprehensive data security and management capabilities, including immutable backup snapshots, AI-based threat detection, monitoring for malicious behavior, and rapid recovery at scale.

We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design.

Join us on our mission to shape the future of our industry.




Cohesity's Professional Services team is looking for a hands-on automation architect who can design, build, and validate automated end-to-end deployment architectures that customers, partners, and internal teams can consistently implement. This role blends deep system design, automation engineering, customer engagement, field validation, and enablement. You will create scalable, code-driven blueprints, replace manual deployment practices with repeatable automation, and serve as the technical authority across automation, architecture, integration, and system design.


HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE:


Customer Engagement & Collaboration

  • Deliver automation-led architecture and professional services to customers.
  • Build strategic relationships with key customers and Cohesity teams.
  • Partner with Product Solutions, engineering, SEs, tech marketing, and support to align product capabilities and APIs with customer automation requirements and ensure smooth knowledge transfer.
  • Engage directly with customers to understand their operational workflows and map Cohesity's solutions and automation capabilities to their objectives.

Architecture & Delivery

  • Design and validate automated deployment architectures, including sizing, performance, integrations, and migrations.
  • Develop reusable automation assets such as Ansible playbooks, Python modules, workflow templates, and code-backed runbooks.
  • Support deployment execution and ensure design fidelity across delivery teams and partners through standardized, version-controlled automation.
  • Conduct field validation and beta testing of new automated procedures, including testing for idempotency, error handling, and rollback.

Practice Development & Enablement

  • Convert automation designs into training content and deliver hands-on training to customers, partners, and internal teams.
  • Create high-quality documentation, code repositories, and knowledge base articles.
  • Continuously refine automation assets as new products, features, and API versions are released.

Process & Alignment

  • Maintain JIRA user stories and an automation backlog to ensure alignment across product, engineering, and delivery teams.

System Design & Architecture

  • Deep System Design: Build end-to-end automated architectures across services, applications, data stores, and integrations, producing implementation-ready diagrams, workflow definitions, and sequence flows.
  • API & Integration Architecture: Design and consume REST APIs, JSON schemas, and integration patterns (sync/async, event-driven, webhooks, retries) to orchestrate workflows across Cohesity and third-party platforms.
  • AuthN/AuthZ: Implement OAuth/JWT, RBAC, scopes, token flows, service accounts, and secure secrets handling for automated pipelines.
  • Data Architecture: Design efficient SQL schemas and queries; understand NoSQL modeling and storage decisions for automation state, inventory, and reporting.
  • Independent Technical Execution: Research new automation tools and technologies independently.
  • Security Architecture: Apply security-by-design principles to automation, including least-privilege access, auditability of automated actions, and data protection.

WE'D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING:

  • Bachelor's degree in CS/Engineering or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of professional IT experience, including significant time designing and delivering infrastructure or workflow automation.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, accelerate automation development, streamline workflows, and support decision making.
  • Hands-on experience automating: Virtualization (VMware, Hyper-V, Citrix) Linux/Unix Oracle and SQL Storage platforms (Isilon, NetApp, Pure) Data protection, disaster recovery, data management Public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Expert proficiency in Python and Ansible; experience with ServiceNow workflow and orchestration, Git-based version control, and architecture tools such as Visio.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills; strong ability to teach and enable others.
  • Strong organization, project management, and deadline-driven execution

  • Develop and maintain an enterprise-wide Coding and Billing Compliance Program aligned with organizational compliance objectives and regulatory expectations.
  • Conduct ongoing coding and billing compliance risk assessments and develop annual risk-based audit and monitoring plans.
  • Monitor regulatory and enforcement developments to identify emerging reimbursement, billing, coding, documentation, medical necessity, and revenue cycle compliance risks, and provide guidance to support organizational compliance.
  • Design and oversee auditing and monitoring activities to evaluate compliance with Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payer, and organizational requirements.

  • Lead root-cause analysis and corrective action planning related to audit findings, investigations, overpayments, repayment obligations, and identified compliance vulnerabilities.
  • Develop compliance reporting and dashboards that provide meaningful insights into revenue integrity risks, trends, audit outcomes, corrective actions, and program effectiveness.
  • Partner with Revenue Cycle, Finance, HIMS, CDI, and operational leaders to strengthen internal controls and mitigate compliance risks.
  • Oversee compliance education and communication initiatives, including targeted training for leadership, providers, and revenue cycle personnel.
  • Prepare reports and presentations for executive leadership, management committees, and other governance bodies regarding significant compliance risks, trends, and program activities.
  • Manage and develop Coding and Billing Compliance staff, including performance management, professional development, and workload prioritization.

Minimum Education and Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.
  • Minimum ten (10) years of healthcare experience in revenue cycle, revenue integrity, reimbursement, coding and billing compliance, healthcare compliance, internal audit, or related healthcare financial operations.
  • Minimum five (5) years of progressive leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or overseeing compliance auditing, monitoring, investigations, risk assessments, and corrective action processes.
  • Experience within large hospitals, health systems, or integrated delivery networks preferred.
  • Preferred experience with Epic electronic health record (EHR) systems in a hospital environment

Special Requirements


One or more of the following certifications preferred:


  • Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC)
  • Certified Professional Medical Auditor (CPMA)
  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC)
  • Certified Coding Specialist (CCS/CCS-P)
  • Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA)

description:
About the Role

As a Mold Process Development Engineer, you will be responsible for driving the development, characterization, and industrialization of advanced molding technologies for semiconductor packages. You will play a critical role in enabling new package platforms, improving process robustness, and supporting Nexperia's technology roadmap through innovative process solutions and technical leadership. title: Dermatology Franchise Health Equity Lead
location: United States - New York - New York City
description:
Dermatology Franchise Health Equity Lead

ROLE SUMMARY

Pfizer's US Dermatology franchise is a fast-growing and high-priority therapeutic area, anchored by two inline priority products — CIBINQO and LITFULO — and a pipeline that includes tilrekimig, a potential first-in-class trispecific biologic being studied in multiple indications.

· LITFULO is a JAK3/TEC molecule that received approval in June 2023 and is the first and only FDA-approved treatment for severe alopecia areata (AA) in adolescents (ages 12-17) and adults. LITFULO is also expected to gain approval for a new indication in 2027.

· CIBINQO is an oral JAK inhibitor for moderate to severe Atopic Dermatitis that received FDA breakthrough designation and was approved in the US in January 2022.

While skin diseases occur in all racial and ethnic groups, people of color may be disproportionately affected by certain skin conditions in terms of disease prevalence, severity, and how diseases present clinically. Our vision is to create a world in which people of all skin tones feel seen, heard, and cared for from the burden of physical, emotional, and mental symptoms of dermatologic diseases.

The dermatology franchise has made significant investment in health equity initiatives, particularly through its “Every Color is Primary” (ECIP) platform and collaborations with organizations such as the Skin of Color Society.

The Dermatology Franchise Health Equity Lead will be responsible for shaping and executing the US and Global health equity strategy across Pfizer’s Dermatology portfolio, ensuring that every patient and healthcare professional has equitable access to education, resources, and our innovative therapies. This role will serve as the enterprise champion for embedding equity into commercial strategy, omnichannel engagement, clinical trial reach, community partnerships, and thought leadership. The leader will drive measurable impact while modeling Pfizer’s values of Courage, Excellence, Equity, and Joy. The successful candidate should demonstrate strong leadership, communication, passion for health equity, and agility in a highly dynamic and rapidly evolving environment. The selected individual will report to the Dermatology Franchise Co-Lead.


ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Specific responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to:

Health Equity Strategy & Vision

  • Define and execute the US and Global health equity strategy, vision, and business objectives for the Dermatology franchise, including anticipated indication expansion (e.g., vitiligo)
  • Establish and monitor key performance metrics that measure health equity impact and align with brand and portfolio objectives
  • Design and lead an omnichannel health equity strategy (social, digital, CRM, video, KOL, congress) for both branded and unbranded HCP and patient education
  • Partner with global and US medical teams to ensure HCP and patient voices inform all strategies; track diversity in clinical trial design, reach, and participation
  • Oversee the strategic evolution of ECIP and digital equity platforms, ensuring measurable ROI and continuous optimization

Health Equity Activation & ROI

  • Collaborate closely with brand marketing, sales leadership, scientific and medical affairs, and AI/innovation partners to activate health equity strategies across channels
  • Drive performance measurement and ROI analysis for health equity initiatives; proactively address performance gaps with agile solutions
  • Manage agency and vendor relationships, ensuring high-quality execution, fiscal responsibility, and maximum impact from health equity budgets
  • Translate market insights and disparities data into impactful educational resources for HCPs and patients; guide the development of equity-focused sales tools and key account deliverables

Strategic Engagement & Leadership

  • Establish and lead strategic partnerships with community-based organizations (CBOs), regional and national advocacy groups, and professional societies to expand dermatology health equity reach
  • Lead Pfizer’s Health Equity Advisory Boards and Steering Committees, ensuring diverse perspectives shape strategy and execution
  • Represent Pfizer Dermatology at major industry conferences, congresses, and equity forums, strengthening the company’s reputation as a thought leader in equitable healthcare
  • Serve as an active member of the Dermatology Franchise leadership team, contributing to broader strategic imperatives and organizational culture
  • Champion a high-performance, inclusive team environment, embodying Pfizer’s values and embedding equity as a non-negotiable standard in commercial decision-making


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree required with 8+ years of marketing and/or consulting experience, including significant US pharmaceutical marketing experience
  • Deep understanding of the US healthcare system, health disparities, and evolving access landscape
  • Demonstrated track record of designing and executing strategies that advance business performance while addressing inequities
  • Proven ability to extract actionable insights from customers and stakeholders and translate them into meaningful in-market impact
  • Strong strategic and analytical skills; fluency in business planning, performance measurement, and scenario planning
  • Extensive experience partnering with external agencies, medical societies, advocacy organizations, and other key stakeholders
  • Exceptional influence, negotiation, and communication skills, with a proven ability to mobilize internal and external partners
  • Confidence presenting strategies and business cases to senior leadership and executive stakeholders
  • Enthusiasm, self-motivation, and accountability with a passion for advancing equity in healthcare


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • MBA or advanced degree in business, public health, or health policy
  • Experience in Specialty Care therapeutic areas
  • Experience creating and implementing health equity strategies in pharma or healthcare settings
  • Recognized participation in equity-focused professional organizations or industry thought leadership initiatives

NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

  • US-based role with primarily domestic travel of up to 60%, including nights and weekends


Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

title: Principal Engineer - Data Retrieval
description:
NVIDIA is seeking an engineering lead to architect and scale the data acquisition infrastructure that powers our foundation models. Starting with code and STEM data for Nemotron, you will build the systems that discover valuable sources, crawl the open web at scale, and deliver reliable, high-quality data to training pipelines. This is a hands-on technical leadership role spanning distributed systems, crawl infrastructure, and third-party data ingestion. You will own the architecture of a unified platform covering source discovery, URL indexing, crawl frontiers, predictive ranking, scheduling, distributed fetching, and ingestion. We have existing infrastructure to build on, and the goal is to bring it to pretraining scale and extend it to additional model families, modalities, and acquisition workflows over time. Along the way, you will lead architecture reviews and critical implementation work, mentor engineers, and help build the team.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Work with storage and scaling teams to design scalable frontier storage and queueing systems with high-throughput writes, efficient lookups, deduplication, and scheduling based on data quality, diversity, and freshness. Build a continuous discovery loop that extracts links and feeds new candidates back into the crawl frontier.
  • Develop a shared crawl execution layer that fetches reliably and politely at scale, handling dynamic websites while keeping resource use under control.
  • Build extensible pipelines for open-web, licensed, and partner content, including text, PDFs, code repositories, and multimodal assets. Define stable interfaces for source connectors so teams can add sources without rebuilding the platform.
  • Partner with parsing and curation teams to preserve valuable code, math, and structured content, and improve accepted data yield.
  • Implement provenance and policy enforcement with legal, privacy, security, and data governance partners. Translate approved publisher preferences, opt-outs, licensing terms, and use restrictions into auditable controls that follow the data downstream.
  • Own production readiness, including capacity planning, observability, fault tolerance, recovery, and cost efficiency. Instrument the pipeline end to end and set service objectives for throughput, freshness, reliability, and meeting training cutoffs.
  • Work with research and product teams to evaluate internal crawls and external datasets through comparable pilots. Deliver reproducible data releases that tie source coverage and processing quality to controlled training experiments.
  • Coordinate dependencies across teams and make clear tradeoffs between immediate data delivery and long-term platform development.

What we need to see:

  • A BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • 15+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, including designing and operating large-scale distributed systems, setting technical direction, and delivering complex infrastructure across multiple teams.
  • Deep experience with web crawling or closely related discovery, indexing, or ingestion infrastructure, including distributed scheduling, stateful services, storage, and high-throughput data processing.
  • Strong hands-on engineering and system design skills. Ability to move between architecture, implementation, performance analysis, and production debugging.
  • Experience building batch or streaming pipelines and reasoning about consistency, retries, duplicate processing, backpressure, and recovery. A track record of improving throughput, latency, resource efficiency, or operational reliability.
  • Experience delivering data platforms for research, ML, search, or other demanding technical users. Ability to translate evolving requirements into clear interfaces and measurable engineering outcomes.
  • Strong technical communication and leadership through influence across engineering, product, research, and governance teams.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience architecting a web-wide crawl platform, scaling crawl frontier storage, or consolidating multiple acquisition systems into shared infrastructure.
  • Direct experience supplying foundation-model pretraining data, including targeted discovery, quality-aware crawl ranking, and acquisition of code or technical content.
  • Experience implementing publisher consent, training-use opt-outs, dataset licensing controls, or provenance infrastructure at scale.
  • Background with browser-based or agentic data collection, programmable extraction, and sandboxed environments for tool-use data or post-training evaluation.
  • Experience onboarding licensed or multimodal datasets, building reusable partner integrations, or delivering streaming feeds with low latency for retrieval and grounding.

The platform is a core capability for NVIDIA’s AI models and directly shapes the reach and quality of our training data. If you enjoy solving difficult distributed systems problems and building platforms that other teams depend on, we want to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

title: Undergrad Intern Technical
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

About Altera

At Altera™, our independence as the world’s largest pure‑play FPGA solutions provider gives us the focus, speed, and agility to innovate without compromise. With more than four decades of industry‑leading FPGA expertise, our singular mission is to deliver the programmable technologies that help customers differentiate, innovate, and scale across rapidly evolving markets like AI, cloud, networking, and edge. As an independent company, we move faster, invest deeper, and partner more closely—empowering our teams to drive breakthrough innovation and shape the future of the FPGA industry.


About the Role

Join Altera’s Product Architecture and Chip Engineering (PACE) team and help develop cutting-edge FPGA RTL and IP solutions. The PACE team creates comprehensive solutions that give customers easy and efficient access to the capabilities of Altera’s FPGA devices. These solutions are delivered as highly configurable intellectual property (IP) cores, fully integrated with Altera’s Quartus Prime software CAD tool.


Altera's IP cores provide configurable access to the high-speed, high-bandwidth, low-latency interfaces, leveraging dedicated and specialized silicon subsystems in the FPGA. The constantly rising speed and complexity of video, display, and high-speed data transmission interfaces presents a challenging design problem that requires system-level knowledge of silicon, software, IP, and customer applications.

You will work with a team of engineers to develop and verify state-of-the-art PHY-lite, MIPI, and LVDS-based IP cores for high-speed data transmission. You will be working on advanced FPGA architectures, design definition, implementation, and verification. Additionally, you will also be developing design examples and simulation models, accompanied by a rich set of technical documentation. In this role, you will work closely with multiple teams, including silicon design and validation, post-silicon validation, application engineering, and customer experience teams, to ensure seamless development, integration, and optimization of high-speed interface IP solutions.


Your specific responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Architecture and Design based on the latest protocol specifications for video processing, display interfaces, chip-to-chip, and high-speed data transmission interfaces
  • RTL development
  • Device support and CAD tool integration
  • Verification (e.g. verification IP, methodologies, frameworks, bus functional models, regression tests)
  • Hardware power-on and debug
  • New product release and rollout support
  • Customer technical support

The candidate should possess the following behavioral traits:

  • Strong skills in communication, initiative, innovation, and teamwork
  • Highly motivated to learn and adapt to fast-changing technologies and environments
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Demonstrate fundamental values such as accountability, integrity, and a winning mindset
  • Collaborative mindset, strong influencing skills, and a willingness to work across geographical locations

Salary

Our compensation is designed to reflect the Canadian labour market. The actual salary offered may vary based on several factors, including the position’s location, as well as the candidate’s experience, skills, training, and job-specific knowledge. In addition to base salary, we offer performance-based incentive opportunities that reward both individual contributions and overall company success.​

Estimated Salary Range: $90,000 - $100,000 CAD​

​

We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess, or select applicants for the position.​ This posting is for an existing vacancy.​ Canadian work experience is not required for this role. Applicants must be eligible for any required Canada export authorizations.


#LI-MD1

You must possess the below minimum education requirements and minimum required qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Relevant experience can be obtained through schoolwork, classes, project work, internships, and/or military experience. Additional preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Currently pursuing a BS degree in Computer Engineering, Engineering Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or related field

  • 3+ months of experience in Digital logic hardware (e.g. SystemVerilog, Verilog and/or VHDL) design or verification

  • 3+ months of experience in scripting languages and/or software programming (e.g. Python/TCL/Perl and/or C/C++)

title: Cube Developer
description:
We are

At Synechron, we believe in the power of digital to transform businesses for the better. Our global consulting firm combines creativity and innovative technology to deliver industry-leading digital solutions. Synechron’s progressive technologies and optimization strategies span end-to-end Artificial Intelligence, Consulting, Digital, Cloud & DevOps, Data, and Software Engineering, servicing an array of noteworthy financial services and technology firms. Through research and development initiatives in our FinLabs we develop solutions for modernization, from Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain to Data Science models, Digital Underwriting, mobile-first applications and more. Over the last 20+ years, our company has been honored with multiple employer awards, recognizing our commitment to our talented teams. With top clients to boast about, Synechron has a global workforce of 17,000+, and has 58 offices in 22 countries within key global markets.


Our challenge

We are seeking an experienced Cube Developer / Power BI Developer to design, develop, and maintain enterprise semantic models, analytics solutions, reports, dashboards, and data integration processes. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Cube Dev, Power BI, DAX, SQL, data modeling, and cloud data platforms, along with a solid understanding of data governance, security, and performance optimization. This role will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and technology teams to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing analytics solutions.


Additional Information*

The base salary for this position will vary based on geography and other factors. In accordance with law, the base salary for this role if filled within Mississauga, ON is CAD $115k – CAD $125k/year & benefits (see below).

The Role

Responsibilities:

  • Cube Dev Development
  • Design and develop Cube Dev semantic models using YAML-based cube definitions.
  • Build and maintain dimensions, facts, measures, joins, and pre-aggregation logic.
  • Create and manage Cube Views and access policies.
  • Develop analytical solutions using DAX, MDX, SQL, and GraphQL APIs.
  • Implement security controls, including:
  • Row-Level Security (RLS)
  • Column-Level Security (CLS)
  • Role-based access control
  • Optimize semantic-layer performance through caching, query optimization, and pre-aggregation strategies.
  • Establish and maintain modeling standards, naming conventions, and reusable semantic components.
  • Troubleshoot Cube Dev models, queries, access issues, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Power BI Development
  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, scorecards, and analytical applications.
  • Create and optimize complex DAX measures, calculated columns, KPIs, and time-intelligence calculations.
  • Develop reusable Power BI semantic models, datasets, and reporting templates.
  • Implement and maintain Row-Level Security and other Power BI security controls.
  • Apply performance optimization techniques for reports, datasets, and data models.
  • Manage Power BI Service workspaces, deployment pipelines, apps, permissions, and scheduled refreshes.
  • Troubleshoot report, gateway, dataset, refresh, and performance issues.
  • Promote best practices for Power BI development, deployment, governance, and lifecycle management.
  • Data Integration and Modeling
  • Work with Snowflake, SQL Server, Databricks, Dataiku, or similar data platforms.
  • Design star and snowflake schemas for reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Develop ETL and ELT processes using SQL, Power Query/M, and cloud-native data integration tools.
  • Integrate data from multiple enterprise sources into governed semantic models.
  • Validate data quality, consistency, completeness, and reconciliation.
  • Apply data governance, metadata management, and modeling standards.
  • Partner with data engineering teams to improve source data structures and downstream analytics performance.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration and Production Support
  • Gather, analyze, and document business and reporting requirements.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical and analytical solutions.
  • Collaborate with business users, data engineers, architects, and application teams.
  • Provide production support for semantic models, reports, dashboards, and data pipelines.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and best-practice initiatives.
  • Contribute to Agile/Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and delivery activities.
  • Prepare technical documentation, data dictionaries, solution designs, and support procedures.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5–10 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or data development.
  • At least 4 years of hands-on Power BI development experience.
  • Strong experience with Cube Dev semantic modeling and YAML configuration.
  • Experience developing enterprise semantic layers and analytical data models.
  • Experience with GraphQL, MDX, or similar analytical query and semantic-layer technologies.
  • Strong expertise in:
  • Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service
  • DAX
  • Power Query/M
  • SQL
  • Data modeling
  • Semantic model development
  • Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse
  • Experience implementing RLS, CLS, role-based access management, and other data security controls.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, and reporting standards.
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD deployment processes.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

Preferred, but not required:

  • Experience with Azure Data Platform services.

  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.

We offer:

description:

Intro paragraph

As a faith-based and patient-focused organization, Mercy Health exists to enhance the health and well-being of all people in mind, body and spirit through exceptional patient care. Success in this goal requires a culture of compassion, collaboration, excellence and respect. Mercy Health seeks people that are committed to our values of compassion, human dignity, integrity, service and stewardship to create an environment where associates want to work and help communities thrive.


PRN Respiratory Care Practitioner II – West Hospital


Job Summary:

The Respiratory Care Practitioner II is responsible for providing respiratory care through patient assessment, planning, intervention, education, and evaluation. Performs all respiratory care procedures including but not limited to oxygen and aerosolized medication delivery, ventilator care, bronchial hygiene therapy, diagnostic services and patient and staff education. Monitors the patient's response to such therapies and makes recommendations to change or modify based on the assessment.


Essential Functions:

  • May serve as the shift “Charge Therapist” with responsibility of ensuring adequate number of respiratory care staff to cover patient care areas and needs. This may include assigning respiratory care staff to work areas and/or work assignments, modifying work assignments, assisting with meal coverage, fielding call offs and providing adequate staffing levels for the next shift.
  • May assist physician performing procedures such as bronchoscopy, transtracheal catheter insertion, tracheotomy intubation (if intubation is performed by respiratory therapy in the facility), assists with tracheostomy endotracheal tube changes and invasive monitoring.
  • Performs CPR including closed chest compressions and airway management techniques in accordance with the AHA ACLS protocol.
  • Conducts prescribed therapeutic procedures to achieve maintenance of a patient airway, including use of appropriate airways including endotracheal tubes, nasopharyngeal and oropharyngeal airways, maintenance of airway humidification, aspiration of secretions, extubation, maintenance of correct ETT cuff pressures and documents procedures in patient and department records.
  • Selects, assembles, monitors and evaluates mechanical ventilators for proper function and operation, including correction of malfunctions, cleanliness and determines appropriateness use for patient condition.
  • May perform pulmonary function tests (PFT).
  • Serves as a preceptor to new team members and/or students.
  • Assesses patient's physical status by inspection, palpation, auscultation, percussion, patient behavior and reviewing existing data in patient's record.
  • Performs treatments according to physician orders, explains therapy and therapeutic goals to patient; modifies treatment procedures based on patient response.
  • Determines appropriateness of prescribed therapy and recommends methods to physician to achieve therapeutic goals including IPPB, Aerosol therapy, Postural drainage and percussion, ultrasonic nebulizer, incentive spirometry, metered dose inhalers and spacers, etc.
  • Sets up and maintains different modes of oxygen therapy, to maintain adequate PaO2’s with accurate inspired levels of oxygen.
  • Administers intermittent positive pressure breathing (IPPB) or Aerosol Therapy by first preparing the prescribed medication ordered by the physician and adjusting the machine or device to accomplish patient’s individual clinical needs; document and observe patient’s vital signs, productivity of cough, relief of Dyspnea, improved breath sounds and any adverse reactions to therapy; and use judgement and technical skill to determine possible adverse reactions and suggestions for appropriateness of therapy.
  • Gives postural drainage, vibration, percussion to ensure proper drainage of bronchial secretions by use of manual or mechanical percussion; check orders and X-rays for segments to be treated prior to initiating treatment; auscultation prior to and after procedure to note presence of clearance of secretions and response to therapy.
  • Instructs patients and families in incentive spirometer, metered dose inhaler (MDI) administration, postural drainage and clapping, oxygen therapy, ventilator care and home aerosol therapy.
  • Procurement of sputum for culture and sensitivity or airway clearance either by patient coaching, administration of mucolytics, aerosol therapy or endotracheal / nasopharyngeal suctioning.
  • Evaluates normal and pathologic blood and urine laboratory value ranges.
  • Performs arterial punctures and analysis; has an in-depth knowledge of analysis and arterial blood gas (ABG) interpretation. Performs arterial line procedures, takes safety precautions, sterile procedure, flushing, and ABG aspirations.
  • May perform EKG’s; understands electronic monitoring, lead placement, and basic arrhythmias.
  • Maintains all Respiratory Therapy equipment and supplies.
  • Responds to cardio-pulmonary resuscitations and actively participates as indicated by clinical circumstances.

This document is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, duties, requirements, or working conditions associated with the job. Employees may be required to perform other job-related duties as required by their supervisor, subject to reasonable accommodation.

  • Bachelor's Degree, Related to Respiratory Therapy/Health care/Healthcare Admin/Business Admin (preferred)

Required Licensing & Certifications:

  • Current Respiratory Care License in the state they are working (required)
  • National Board for Respiratory Care (NBRC) credentialed (required)
  • Registered Respiratory Therapist (RRT) (preferred)
  • BLS Basic Life Support - American Heart Association (required)
  • ACLS Advanced Cardiac Life Support - American Heart Association or Red Cross (required)
  • PALS Pediatric Advanced Life Support - American Heart Association (required)
  • NRP (Neonatal Resuscitation Program) - AAP/AWHONN (preferred)
  • Certified Pulmonary Function Technologist (CPFT) (preferred)
  • Registered Pulmonary Function Technologist (RPFT) (preferred)
  • ACCS (Adult Critical Care Specialist) - NBRC (preferred)
  • Valid driver’s license (required for Home Care/DME)

Experience:

  • Two years of experience as a Respiratory Care Professional (required)

Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong interpersonal skills and able to effectively interact with patients, their families, physicians, and other staff members
  • Good communication skills
  • Able to effectively work with diverse people
  • Good customer service skills
  • Good organizational skills and time management skills
  • Good oral and written communication
  • Able to receive feedback
  • Able to gather and interpret data
  • Accountability
  • Knowledge of non-invasive respiratory therapy equipment such as oximeters or end-tidal CO2 analyzers
  • Therapeutic Procedures to include CPAP/BiPap, jet aerosol, oxygen therapy, incentive spirometry, chest physiotherapy, pulse oximetry, high flow oxygen, continuous aerosols, ventilator management, diagnostic testing.
  • Understanding of EKGs, electronic monitoring, lead placement, and basic arrhythmias.
  • Arterial blood gas punctures and testing
  • Airway maneuvers
  • Bedside pulmonary function
  • Patient assessment
  • Patient education
  • Knowledge of chest suction equipment
  • Knowledge of chest X-ray interpretation

Training:

This role is more than just keeping production moving—it’s about working with a team that supports one another, takes pride in doing things the right way, and is committed to continuous improvement. By bringing your energy, attention to detail, and respect for safety, you’ll help us deliver food experiences that consumers can trust and enjoy.

Full time

PA North East

Production Group

Job Posting Title:

Processing Area Expert

Duties and Responsibilities:

Safe Equipment Operation & Maintenance:

  • Perform and oversee equipment operations and maintenance activities, including forklift driving, die changes, troubleshooting, repairs, and preventive upkeep for manufacturing systems, and processing systems.
  • Complete equipment changeovers and address operational issues quickly.
  • Use your technical skills in SAP, IQS, MII, and Weaver to keep Processing flowing.

  • Perform routine operation checks.

This includes the ability to understand and respond to oral communications; understand written information, communications, and safety information; and communicate in writing as needed.

title: Merchandising Project Manager
description:
Do your Best Work in Mooresville

This position is based at our headquarters in Mooresville, North Carolina. Our corporate office is a space where you can collaborate and do your best work. Take a walk, grab a bite (or a cup of coffee), work out or get a check-up – we invest in you so you can find your inspiration.

Your Impact

The primary purpose of this role is to project manager within their assigned Merchandising division in order to deliver on defined scope, timeline and budget. This includes responsibility for planning and overseeing the deployment of their respective Merchandising division's go-to-market strategy by supporting each Product Group's vision, identifying project scope, developing timelines, providing status reporting, leading risk mitigation and prioritizing the day-to-day tasks of an internal CSC team across several functions. This role is critical to Lowe's because through the effective project management of these initiatives, Lowe's is able to support the market introduction of new products and selling material empowering store associates to drive incremental sales and margin

What You Will Do

  • Delivers the planned Merchandising Division project portfolio for their respective division consisting of ~50 projects and ~$60M of expenditure annually
  • Supports the Merchandising Division's leadership; aligns one-to-one with a Merchandising VP and supports the go-to-market strategy for that division
  • Prioritizes project/task priorities across the cross-functional project team usually consisting of ~10-12 members; works closely with the project team & client to ensure timely implementation and rollout of projects and ensures that all appropriate project activities are defined and appropriately assigned for accountability
  • Captures project specific intent/scope and develops timelines and functional resource alignment to execute intent; escalates deviations or variances on scope, timeline and budget to appropriate Merchandising Leadership & client
  • Identifies risks and leads mitigation efforts, identifies system, process, and training gaps, as well as notes resource constraints and escalates to the respective client and Merchandising Leadership as needed
  • Supports the Portfolio forecasting and the Project Authorization Request (PAR) processes and collaborates with leaders across the organization to ensure data and information is entered on time, aligned with key reporting dates, and accurately depicts their team’s projects
  • Participates in the preparation for the annual forecast solicitation process with clients and portfolio team and assists in monthly updates to the forecast
  • Consolidates and reports spend variances to budgets/forecasts to the portfolio team and Merchandising Operations leadership throughout the lifecycle of their team’s projects
  • Coordinates with the Portfolio & Financial Support team to ensure their team’s portfolio is accurately represented in all dashboards, monthly reports, and quarterly solicitations
  • Develops and tracks project plans in the project management tool (PMT) to identify issues and opportunities, form hypotheses, design and conduct analyses, track major milestones / progress, synthesize conclusions and approve final plans to implement change and ensures ongoing project data accuracy


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree Business Management, Business Administration, Computer Science or related field or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable
  • 4 Years Relevant business experience
  • 3 Years Experience leading operational process review, design and implementation of improvements; industry related experience
  • 2 years leadership experience with direct report responsibility, comfortable managing teams with 5+ people. Expert in project life cycle methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, etc.), stakeholder. management, conflict resolution, executive communication (written, verbal, etc.
  • 4 years experience developing project Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) / User Stories used to create project schedules and estimates


Preferred Skills/Education

  • Master’s degree Business Management, Business Administration, Computer Science or related field
  • 3 Years Experience leading operational process review, design and implementation of improvements; industry related experience

Lowe’s Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company with total fiscal year 2025 sales of more than $86 billion. Lowe’s is a core value S&P 500 equity stock and a dividend aristocrat. If your answer is yes, then your next journey starts right here at Arriva TrainCare.


📄 12-month FTC
⏰ 37.5 hours per week, Monday-Friday
💷 £50,934 p/a


About Us


At Arriva TrainCare, we provide high-quality overhaul, maintenance and servicing of passenger rolling stock, locomotives, freight wagons and track plant. We operate throughout the UK from six strategic locations: Crewe, Bristol, Eastleigh, Cambridge, Tyne Yard and Scarborough.


You will be part of a professional team with these core behaviours at heart:


  • We care passionately
  • We do the right thing
  • We make the difference

  • Pension scheme

The Role


This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated individual to lead a team of skilled fitters, ensuring that contracted modification and refurbishment work is completed safely, efficiently and to the highest quality standards while meeting customer requirements and project deadlines.


As the Rolling Stock Modifications Team Leader, you will provide day-to-day leadership and direction to a team of engineering professionals working on vehicle modification and maintenance projects. You will drive a culture of safety, compliance and continuous improvement while ensuring all activities are carried out in accordance with company procedures, engineering instructions and customer standards.


What You'll Do


  • Lead and motivate a team of fitters to deliver contracted work safely and efficiently.
  • Ensure compliance with customer Vehicle Maintenance Instructions (VMIs), Vehicle Overhaul Instructions (VOIs) and company work instructions.
  • Maintain high standards of safety, quality and production performance across the depot.
  • Liaise with customers and internal stakeholders to support project delivery and resolve technical issues.
  • Coach, mentor and develop team members to maximise performance and competence.
  • Support the development of competence assessments and training initiatives.
  • Drive continuous improvement activities and identify innovative ways to enhance operational efficiency.
  • Ensure work locations remain compliant, safe and fit for purpose.
  • Promote a positive safety culture and ensure all work is carried out in line with company, customer and legislative requirements.
  • Support the Crewe Depot Manager in the successful delivery of modification and refurbishment programmes.

title: Embedded Software Engineer - Broadband CPE
description:
At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package - this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!

Job Overview
T-Mobile Home Internet is one of our fastest growing businesses, and the software this team builds runs on every gateway and mesh extender we put in a customer's home. We're a small development team on a large program, so you'll contribute to meaningful software development work from the start.

You'll develop the device agents that manage, monitor, and troubleshoot our broadband customer premises equipment. They're written in C and C++ against the Broadband Forum's open USP standards and run on the RDK-B platform. The agent uses a microservice architecture, and you'll develop and maintain assigned services within the established architecture.

Your agents will interface with the device's Wi-Fi and cellular subsystems through RDK and RBUS. You won't be writing Wi-Fi drivers or modem firmware, but understanding those technologies, and how RDK components talk to each other, is central to doing this job well.

What you'll do

  • Develop and maintain one or more microservices within the device management agent, in C and C++ on RDK-B.
  • Implement and maintain device data model parameters and USP protocol behavior across supported hardware platforms.
  • Interface with the device's Wi-Fi and cellular subsystems through RDK and RBUS to configure them, query state, and report it upstream.
  • Build and maintain the containerized services that run on the device, delivered through a Kubernetes-based packaging and deployment pipeline.
  • Write unit tests for new and changed code and extend our automated test coverage.
  • Debug across the device software stack, from log analysis and root cause investigation through to fix verification.
  • Support device maintenance releases, including test support, firmware validation, and release verification.
  • Work with OEM partners on defect triage and reproduction.
  • Improve how we collect data and logs from the field so issues can be triaged and resolved faster.
  • Contribute ideas that improve how we build, test, and deliver device software.
  • Document your code, the data model and device behavior.

Job Summary

This role is essential for designing, implementing, and deploying scalable software solutions that meet customer requirements and support high availability environments. The role involves collaborating with engineering teams to develop software components using technologies such as virtualization, microservices, software-defined networking, network functions virtualization, and broadband device management. This position requires independent development of software components and understanding system protocols, data flows, and technology interactions, including those supporting broadband customer premises equipment (CPE). Success is measured by the ability to deliver technical solutions, produce clear documentation, and contribute to technology strategy and innovation. The work impacts the organization by enabling advanced software systems that improve operational efficiency and support business goals.

Main Responsibilities

  • Develop software solutions that support engineering projects and meet customer requirements, including developing and maintaining embedded software components and device management services for broadband CPE.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to deliver effective technical solutions and continuously learn new technologies, including supporting software debugging, testing, release verification, and defect investigation with OEM partners.
  • Create clear documentation for software code, system designs, and business requirements, including device data models and software behavior.
  • Contribute to technology strategy by understanding current technologies and supporting business goals, including improvements to device software testing, diagnostics, and development processes.
  • Present innovative ideas to improve systems, processes, or services based on industry research, including improvements to device software reliability and troubleshooting.
  • Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree plus 3 years of related work experience OR advanced degree with 1 year of related work experience OR combination of education and experience deemed equivalent.
  • Acceptable areas of study include Computer Science or Engineering.
  • 2-4 years of technical engineering experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with RDK-B and RBUS, or a comparable embedded networking platform and message bus.
  • C and C++ development on embedded Linux.
  • Strong Wi-Fi knowledge: 802.11 standards and generations, band and channel behavior, client association and steering, and practical troubleshooting.
  • Strong grounding in the IP stack and network technologies: TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, NAT, routing and bridging.
  • Working understanding of 5G networks and fixed wireless access.
  • Familiarity with TR-069, TR-369 (USP), or TR-181 device management standards.
  • Experience writing unit tests and building or extending automated test coverage.
  • Experience with containerized applications and delivering packages to embedded devices.
  • Proficiency with Git and continuous integration pipelines.
  • Hands-on development experience with cellular, Wi-Fi, mesh networking, or other carrier-side telecom products.
  • Proficiency in C and C++.
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals and comfort debugging software you did not write.

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Analytical Thinking
  • Collaboration
  • Continuous Development
  • DevOps
  • Emerging Technologies
  • Programming Languages
  • Software Design
  • Software Development
  • Technology Development
  • Test Evaluation
  • At least 18 years of age
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States

description:

Imagine a world with zero vehicle accidents, zero vehicle emissions, and wireless vehicle connectivity all around us. Every day, we move closer to making that world a reality. Software Architect – C++ / ADAS Resimulation

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Software Architect to define and develop the technical architecture of C++-based resimulation platforms and large-scale ADAS analysis solutions.

This is a hands-on architecture and development role. The Architect will define scalable software architectures while actively designing, developing, debugging and optimizing critical C++ components, frameworks and applications. The role requires strong system-level thinking without moving away from hands-on software development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define the software architecture and technical roadmap for ADAS resimulation and analysis platforms.

  • Define software components, interfaces, APIs, data flows and reusable frameworks.
  • Design and implement solutions for Linux, HPC, cloud and distributed computing environments.
  • Drive architecture decisions around performance, scalability, reliability, testability and maintainability.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of object-oriented design, design patterns, concurrency, multithreading and memory management.

Preferred Qualifications

description:

Band

Job Description Summary

You will lead the enterprise people and organization agenda for Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (DSAI) across Novartis, translating our DSAI ambition into the workforce, organization, talent and capability choices needed to deliver it. Operating at the decision-making table with senior DSAI leaders and partnering across the enterprise, you will shape how we build, attract and grow critical DSAI talent, strengthen our external value proposition, and enable responsible human-AI collaboration. You will lead the enterprise DSAI OTR, including discussion at ECN level, and create the standards, governance and frameworks needed in areas such as careers, capabilities, talent and rewards, particularly where established approaches do not yet exist.

This enterprise role complements rather than replaces the Workforce Strategy Leads directly supporting DSAI teams within their units. Unit-level accountabilities remain unchanged, while this role connects across them, providing the overarching DSAI people strategy, standards and governance and enabling enterprise-level choices where these are needed.


Job Description

#Hybrid


This role can be based in Cambridge (US), East Hanover, London or Basel.

Please only apply to one of the appropriate location.


Key Responsibilities

  • Set the enterprise DSAI people and organization strategy.
    Translate the DSAI ambition into an integrated, future-ready agenda across workforce, organization, leadership, culture, talent and capability. Success is evident when: enterprise priorities and accountabilities are clear, adopted across units, and translated into measurable outcomes.
  • Shape strategic workforce and capability choices. Use scenarios, analytics, external insight and data storytelling to anticipate demand for scarce DSAI capabilities and recommend choices on organization design, skills, capacity, location, sourcing and workforce mix. Success is evident when: critical gaps are addressed before they constrain innovation or execution.
  • Lead the enterprise DSAI OTR. Orchestrate the enterprise talent review, integrate perspectives across units, and present implications, choices and recommendations to ECN. Success is evident when: pivotal talent, succession, capability risks and enterprise actions are visible and actively managed.
  • Establish enterprise talent and career approaches. Create differentiated career development, mobility, succession and talent-allocation mechanisms suited to DSAI roles and communities. Success is evident when: Novartis can attract, develop, deploy and retain pivotal DSAI talent across organizational boundaries.
  • Build the external DSAI talent brand and pipeline. Strengthen Novartis’ visibility as an employer of choice through targeted engagement with universities, specialist talent networks and external forums. Build early-talent pathways that attract dual technical/scientific and DSAI expertise and develop judgement, experience and leadership capability. Success is evident when: Novartis has stronger external visibility and a sustainable pipeline of scarce DSAI talent.
  • Design and create enterprise DSAI standards. Build new governance, rewards approaches, career architecture, capability frameworks, talent programs and operating approaches for a field evolving faster than established internal practices. Success is evident when: scalable standards replace fragmented local approaches and remain relevant as DSAI evolves.
  • Connect enterprise strategy and unit execution. Define decision rights, interfaces and governance so the enterprise mandate is distinct from, and complementary to, unchanged unit-level P&O accountabilities. Success is evident when: there is no duplication or accountability gap between enterprise and unit roles.
  • Influence a complex enterprise stakeholder system. Partner with at least nine ECN-1 leaders across R&D, Commercial, Operations and Global Functions, the Head of GDC, unit P&O Business Partners and Expertise Hubs to resolve enterprise trade-offs without relying on formal authority. Success is evident when: leaders move beyond unit optimization and commit to enterprise decisions.
  • Redesign work for human-AI collaboration. Guide organization, role and workflow choices that enable responsible collaboration among people, automation and AI agents while sustaining accountability and a human-cantered employee experience. Success is evident when: adoption improves productivity, innovation and decision quality.
  • Coach senior leaders, shape culture and lead transformation. Challenge and coach leaders through ambiguity, build commitment to new enterprise approaches, anticipate resistance and track adoption and benefits. Success is evident when: leadership behaviour, culture and ways of working support the DSAI strategy.

What you’ll bring to the role

Essential Criteria

  • Extensive experience of progressive P&O/HR experience, including strategic partnership with executive and ECN-1 leaders in a complex global matrix.
  • Strong organization design, strategic workforce planning and transformation experience, including scenario development and enterprise trade-off recommendations.
  • Demonstrated experience creating global or enterprise-wide people strategies, standards, governance or programs, not only implementing established solutions.
  • Evidence of leading enterprise talent reviews, succession and capability discussions with senior executive forums.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence multiple senior stakeholders across business units, functions, countries and P&O disciplines without formal authority.
  • Fluency in people analytics and confidence with AI-enabled tools, responsible AI principles and emerging work technologies.

Desirable Criteria

  • Experience translating emerging technology, data science or digital strategy into workforce, organization and talent implications; direct DSAI sector experience is highly desirable.
  • Relevant university degree or equivalent experience required; advanced qualification in business, organization, analytics, technology or a related discipline.

The Respiratory Care Practitioner III is responsible for providing respiratory care through patient assessment, planning, intervention, education, and evaluation. May be responsible for data collection and accurate record keeping as well as product evaluation and assessment.

title: Hydraulic Modelling and Simulation Intern 100% (m/f/d
description:
Ultra-Pure Water+ division of Ecolab (former Ovivo Electronics), is a global provider of advanced equipment, technology, and systems to produce ultrapure water (UPW). We are dedicated to innovation, offering energy-efficient and environmentally sustainable solutions to the world’s most challenging water and wastewater issues.

As a Hydraulic Modelling and Simulation Intern, you will develop a dynamic hydraulic model of a water treatment system and connect it to a PLC and SCADA simulation platform for process validation.

Joining Ecolab means being part of a global team of innovative and passionate professionals who are committed to preserving water, our planet's most critical resource. It also means combining our efforts and talents towards a more sustainable future – together.


How You’ll Make an Impact:

· Hydraulic modelling: Develop a representative dynamic model of a water treatment system, including key hydraulic behavior and process constraints.

· Real-time deployment: Prepare the model for real-time or near-real-time execution within the simulation environment.

· PLC and SCADA connectivity: Implement communication interfaces between the hydraulic model, PLC application, and SCADA application.

· Process validation: Use the integrated platform to validate process sequences, operating scenarios, alarms, and control responses.

· Optimization and analysis: Analyze model results and support optimization of simulation performance, stability, and usability.

· Documentation and collaboration: Document model assumptions, interfaces, test scenarios, and results while working with automation and process engineers.


Qualifications:

· You are completing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in automation, industrial computing, electrical engineering, computer science, robotics, or a related field.

· Knowledge of modelling, real-time simulation, optimization, communication protocols, and software programming is expected.

· Experience with hydraulic modelling tools, Python, MATLAB/Simulink, Modelica, OPC UA, or industrial APIs is an advantage.

· You enjoy diversified tasks and hands-on work in technical workshops and on industrial systems.

· You show initiative and creativity, and you are flexible, structured, and able to work independently with guidance from experienced engineers.

· You have strong team-working and communication skills and can collaborate with international departments, suppliers, and customers.

· You have English skills suitable for daily business use. German, French, or other languages are an advantage.


What we offer:

· Working in our young and international Automation Team, with new challenges to solve every day.

· An opportunity to contribute widely and develop your skills in an agile company.

· Dealing with the cutting edge in ultrapure water technology in the electronic industry.

· Technical training in the position related field as well as the possibility for professional development in Switzerland.

· Expected start date: March 2027, or by mutual agreement.

· A modern workplace in Witterswil.

· At Ecolab we are committed to providing working environments where everyone is included and treated fairly and with respect


About Ecolab:

At Ecolab, we prioritize our talent-first philosophy by creating the most capable and diverse team to excel at our nearly three million customer sites. Building on a century of innovation, our 48,000 associates help deliver comprehensive science-based solutions, data-driven insights and world-class service to advance food safety, maintain clean and safe environments, and optimize water and energy use, and improve operational efficiencies and sustainability for customers in the food, healthcare, life sciences, hospitality and industrial markets in more than 170 countries around the world. Our solutions not only enhance operational efficiency but also contribute to sustainability and public health, making a positive impact on the world. We are committed to eliminating unnecessary complexities and embracing a beginner's mindset, continuously seeking new perspectives and innovative solutions to stay ahead in a rapidly changing world.


Ecolab’s commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) reflects our longstanding value of working together to integrate diverse perspectives to challenge ourselves, reach our goals and do what’s right.


Apply today and join one of the most ethical companies with over a hundred years of history.


Join Ecolab and help us protect what’s vital.
