title: Risk Analyst
location: George Town, George Town, Cayman Islands
description:
About Cayman First: ‘First’ is more than our name, it’s our nature. Cayman First is an industry-leading Property & Casualty and Health insurer, delivering best-in-class products and services to respond to the changing needs of individuals, households and businesses. Through our carefully selected network of agents and brokers, we provide protection for our customers today and prepare them for a brighter tomorrow. Cayman First maintains an A- (Excellent) financial strength rating from global credit rating agency AM Best.

Risk Analyst

The Role: The Risk Analyst is responsible for performing risk assessments, portfolio analysis, and technical pricing evaluations to support underwriting decisions and financial performance. Develops pricing models, Power BI dashboards, and management reports to monitor profitability, identify emerging risks, and support data-driven strategies. Ensures data integrity, regulatory compliance, and effective collaboration across departments.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Extract, validate, reconcile, and maintain renewal datasets, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and data integrity.
  • Prepare and reconcile SIF and Stamp Duty payment reports, ensuring accuracy and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Evaluate health insurance portfolio trends, claims experience, and profitability metrics to identify emerging risks and recommend corrective actions.
  • Develop and maintain complex risk-based pricing models to assess premium adequacy, renewal performance, and underwriting profitability.
  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and advanced pricing models to support performance monitoring and strategic decisions.
  • Analyze and report on Gross Written Premium (GWP), claims, insured lives, loss ratios, and other key financial and underwriting metrics.
  • Prepare and validate reinsurance and third-party provider reports, ensuring data accuracy and adherence to reporting requirements.
  • Partner with internal departments to resolve data discrepancies, address operational queries, and improve reporting processes.
  • Achieve monthly performance objectives while ensuring timely delivery of analytical reports and operational requirements.
  • Present pricing analyses, portfolio insights, and risk-based recommendations to support underwriting and pricing decisions.
  • Monitor departmental KPIs, identify opportunities for process improvement, and contribute to operational efficiency and business objectives.
  • Other related duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.

Requirements

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Mathematics, Statistics, Actuarial Science, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Professional certification in Life or Health Insurance through LOMA, HIA, or an equivalent recognized institution is highly desirable.
  • Experience in the health insurance industry, with strong knowledge of underwriting principles, technical pricing, risk assessment, and portfolio management.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities, including financial modelling, data validation, claims analysis, trend evaluation, and profitability assessment.
  • Sound understanding of insurance policy structures, underwriting guidelines, regulatory requirements, and contractual documentation to support risk-based decision-making.
  • Proficiency in insurance administration and underwriting systems, including data management, reconciliation, reporting, and analytical processes.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to present technical findings, manage competing priorities, and consistently meet reporting deadlines.

Benefits

Benefits:

This is a full-time position at our George Town office, and our office hours are Monday-Thursday (8:30am-5:00pm) and Friday (8:30am-4:30pm). The salary range is CI$65,000 – CI$85,000 depending on experience and qualifications. Cayman First offers a wide variety of benefits such as a comprehensive health insurance plan, pension plan, performance-based bonus, paid vacation, personal days, access to an employee assistance plan, paid maternity and paternity leave.

The closing date for applications on our website is November 20, 2026, and qualified Caymanians are strongly encouraged to apply for this exciting opportunity!

To apply for the Risk Analyst position, please visit Cayman First’s careers page on our company website and submit your application to Risk Analyst opening here: . WORC Portal ID: D8K3H4– Risk Analyst.

title: Senior Communications Advisor - Emergency Response
description:
At TC Energy, we are proud to connect the world to the energy it needs. Guided by our values of safety in every step, personal accountability, one team and active learning, we deliver the critical energy that North America and the world rely on while balancing reliability, affordability and sustainability.


Join us. Connect to what matters.


The Opportunity

Reporting to the Manager of Communications Operations, Brand & Governance, the Senior Advisor will work as part of an integrated communications team, with a focus on effective emergency response for the TC Energy External Relations department across Canada, the U.S. and Mexico.


This role provides oversight of the External Relations emergency management, preparedness and response program — strengthening organizational readiness and supporting communications during operational incidents, business continuity disruptions and other crisis situations.


Combining strategic communications expertise with emergency preparedness experience, the position will play a crucial role in the development of communications plans, training programs, exercises and response strategies that help External Relations effectively support the business before, during and after disruptive events.


In addition to emergency response responsibilities, the position will contribute to priority communications projects and initiatives across the team, providing strategic counsel, planning and execution support as needed.


The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, a dedication to continual improvement and consistent execution to protect and enhance TC Energy’s reputation. This role requires flexibility to provide support outside regular business hours when needed, including participation in the External Relations on-call program.


Note: We request all applicants to please include a cover letter at the beginning of their resume.


What you'll do


  • Lead and support the External Relations emergency response program including plans, initiatives, tactics and on-call administration to meet the needs of our teams in Canada, U.S. and Mexico
  • Lead and support priority communications projects and initiatives across External Relations, bringing strategic communications expertise to emerging business needs and enterprise priorities
  • Lead the development and continuous improvement of communications preparedness, response plans, tools and resources that support effective communications during incidents and business disruptions
  • Provide strategic communications counsel to leaders and business partners, translating complex business priorities into clear recommendations, messaging and communications approaches
  • Design and lead training programs, simulations and exercises that build responder capability, enhance preparedness and strengthen confidence during high-impact events
  • Develop clear, audience-focused messaging, content and communication materials for a variety of channels and audiences
  • Advise and coach responders and leaders to support effective decision-making, communications and coordination during incidents
  • Lead External Relations' participation in enterprise preparedness initiatives, partnering across the organization to strengthen response capabilities, enhance communications readiness and support coordinated management of significant incidents and disruptions
  • Coordinate and maintain on-call processes and resources that support effective incident response across the External Relations network
  • Execute governance to ensure annual training requirements are met for approximately 70 External Relations representatives
  • Monitor training participation, responder capability and program effectiveness to support continuous improvement across the External Relations emergency response program
  • Build strong relationships across Operations, Emergency Management, Enterprise Security, HR and External Relations teams to strengthen preparedness and support coordinated organizational response efforts
  • Advance new approaches, materials and tools to support the External Relations on-call team to improve their on-call experience
  • Maintain the program’s SharePoint hub, including site hygiene, information architecture, document organization and access to current materials
  • Establish and maintain communication governance processes, standards and tools to support consistency, accountability and operational excellence
  • Monitor, measure and evaluate communications effectiveness and apply insights to strengthen future strategies and approaches.

Minimum Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, public relations, journalism, political science or a related field
  • 6-8+ years of progressive experience in strategic communications, project communications, public affairs or a related field
  • Experience leading emergency management, preparedness, resilience or business continuity programs in a complex organization

Preferred Qualifications


  • Demonstrated ability to manage incidents
  • Knowledge or certification in ICS 300 as well as ICS Public Information Officer or ICS Liaison Officer roles
  • Strong understanding of emergency management, business continuity and organizational resilience principles
  • Ability to support incident response as required during office hours; provide guidance outside office hours
  • Experience working with individuals from all levels of an organization, from field support to senior leaders
  • Ability to write materials and analyze situations to provide response recommendations quickly
  • Demonstrated resourceful problem solving when situations go off-script
  • Background in Safety or Security communications
  • Familiarity with the Microsoft 365 suite including OneDrive and Teams
  • Proficiency in speaking and writing in French

This position requires candidates to:

  • Be available for extended work hours outside of standard business hours
  • Fulfill weekly on-call shifts during the year
  • Occasional travel within North America

To remain competitive, support our high-performance culture and allow for more flexibility in the way we work, we offer a hybrid work model and flexible dress code for our eligible office-based workforce in Canada, the U.S. and Mexico. #LI-Hybrid



About our business


We are a leader in North American energy infrastructure, spanning Canada, the U.S. and Mexico. For over 75 years, we have proudly connected the world to the energy it needs. Every day, we move more than 30 per cent of the natural gas used across the continent and connect LNG exports to global markets, powering communities and industries. Complemented by strategic ownership and low-risk investments in power generation, our infrastructure delivers affordable, reliable and sustainable energy across North America. Our field operations span seven Canadian provinces, 34 U.S. states and seven Mexican states. Together, we strengthen the connections that deliver the energy the world relies on-every day.


TC Energy is an equal opportunity employer and participates in the E-Verify program supervised by the US government. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, religion, age, sex, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or disability. We are also committed to providing accommodations throughout the recruitment process. Applicants requiring accommodations or accessible formats are encouraged to contact us at careers@tcenergy.com for support.


All applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where the position is based, without restrictions. Background screening is required for all positions, which may include criminal and/or credit checks. Offers may be extended at a different level or job title that best aligns with the successful candidate's qualifications.


Learn more


Visit us at TCEnergy.com and connect with us on our social media channels for our latest news, employee stories, community activities, and other updates.


Thank you for considering TC Energy in your career journey.

title: (CAN) Meat Associate

This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy hands‑on work, teamwork, and making a positive impact on every customer visit.

What you'll do...

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Maintain Department Organization and Standards
Keeps the department clean, organized, and properly zoned to ensure it is customer-ready at all times. Rotates stock regularly and removes expired or unsellable products.

Ensure Accurate Pricing and Signing
Ensures all merchandise is correctly signed and priced. Follows established procedures for ordering, clearance, markups and markdowns, signing, flagging, pricing, and labeling.

Follow Food Safety and Cold Chain Practices
Adheres to food safety and cold chain standards, including temperature checks, thermometer calibration, proper food handling, product rotation, sell-by dates, and expiration date compliance.

Takes customer orders and prepares deli items such as meat, cheese, and fried chicken. Uses slicers, stackers, rotisserie ovens, deep fryers, and other tools safely to prepare food, fill display cases, and complete special customer orders.

Health and Safety Compliance
Follows all Health and Safety guidelines and Company policies to maintain a safe, clean, and hygienic work environment.

Flexibility (Availability/Work Schedule)
• Be open to working a variety of shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, based on business needs. Your adaptability helps ensure the store runs smoothly and customers receive consistent, high-quality service.

High Task Volume in a Fast-Paced Environment

• Effectively manages work hours and plans ahead to maintain energy and focus throughout the shift.

title: Electrical & Instrumentation Technician
description:
General Purpose:

The general purpose of the Electrical and Instrumentation Technician is to provide troubleshooting and maintenance as directed in respect to plant process control systems, related instrumentation and electrical networks, as well as all related automation technologies. Technician will repair, calibrate, troubleshoot and maintain plant instrumentation, electrical control systems, peripheral devices such as Servers or applications, as well as industrial networks. Position will provide technical assistance to plant maintenance and operations personnel on a day-to-day basis. This position is expected to promote a safe working environment, maintain a sanitary food environment while following plant GMP’s, and strive to improve product quality.

.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Performs work requiring a thorough knowledge of instrument application, operation and calibration of the electrical and mechanical principles involved in repair, testing and calibration of plant instruments.
  • Manage and maintain instrument calibration documentation while working with Maintenance department to follow CMMS corrective and preventative maintenance plans.
  • Perform corrective and preventative maintenance for plant electrical power distribution and monitoring devices, VFD drives and motor control circuits.
  • Evaluate and provide recommendations of MRO spares inventory for instrumentation and electrical devices and components. performs processes to ensure accurate inventory control.
  • Performs preventive and predictive maintenance including calibration, data collection, bench and installed testing utilizing diagnostic tools, and computerized maintenance management systems
  • Investigate equipment failures and participate in plant A3 to determine root cause of failures and plant downtime, and deploy solutions as requested to eliminate repeat failures.
  • Participate in the planning and execution of minor and major plant shutdowns.
  • Maintain plant OT/IT systems such as networking devices, servers, and software for maximum efficiency and uptime.
  • Maintain, implement, and commission software changes as directed by automation team on PLC, HMI and PC-based automation systems with particular focus on Advanced Process Technologies and Automation networks. Assist in the evaluation of process management systems and related architectures.
  • As an integral member of the plant maintenance and operations team, participate in site automation department on-call to support operations reliability/availability.
  • Ability to work with both technical and non-technical personnel (internal and external of DFA) on instrumentation and control, electrical assets, OT/IT systems and infrastructure.
  • Demonstrate sound hands-on understanding of instrumentation and electrical assets and infrastructure and ability to troubleshoot problems.
  • Work with maintenance and operations personnel to scope, review, commission and troubleshoot new project installs.
  • Ability to read and understand technical documents (Electrical/Mechanical drawings, P&ID’s, Process Functional Descriptions, Control Narratives, etc.).
  • Promote a safety-conscious Company Culture and follows all DFA policies, procedures, and standards such as LOTO, Fall Protection, NFPA 70E, as well as proper PPE.

title: Product Manager – UPW Process
description:
The Product Manager – UPW Process is part of the Innovation Department and is responsible for developing and managing solutions for Ultra-Pure Water (UPW) production and distribution processes.

The role connects customer requirements, water treatment technologies, process engineering, and innovation, working closely with R&D, engineering, sales, service, and customers to develop and improve UPW solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the product strategy and roadmap for UPW process solutions.
  • Identify customer needs, market opportunities, and emerging UPW technologies.
  • Translate customer and market requirements into product and process specifications.
  • Drive the development, validation, launch, and continuous improvement of UPW solutions.
  • Work with customers to understand their UPW processes, challenges, and quality requirements.
  • Evaluate and develop technologies for UPW production, treatment, storage, and distribution.
  • Monitor market trends, competitors, regulations, and new technologies.
  • Support sales with technical information, product training, and customer opportunities.
  • Develop business cases, value propositions, and pricing recommendations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve system efficiency, reliability, water quality, and operating costs.
  • Support digitalization, process monitoring, automation, and optimization initiatives.
  • Manage the product lifecycle from concept through development, launch, improvement, and end-of-life.

Technical Knowledge

  • Ultra-Pure Water production and distribution
  • Water chemistry and UPW quality requirements
  • Process design and optimization
  • Materials and contamination control
  • Process monitoring and automation
  • Energy and water efficiency
  • Semiconductor and other high-purity applications

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Chemistry, or a related field.
  • 5–10 years of experience in water treatment, UPW, process engineering, product management, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of UPW processes and water chemistry.
  • Experience with technical B2B products and industrial customers.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and commercial skills.
  • Experience working with international, cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel as required.

Key Competencies

  • UPW process knowledge
  • Product and innovation management
  • Customer orientation, Technical and commercial mindset
  • Strategic thinking
  • Process optimization
  • Strong communication and collaboration
  • Ownership and accountability

title: Virtual Observation (Telesitter) Night Manager

description:
At Houston Methodist, the Manager Inpatient Telehealth Programs position is responsible for
impacting the management, planning, development, budget, and other administrative activities of a clinical department. Under direction, this position plans, manages and monitors operations of the Telesitter department to support the clinical activities of the department. The Manager Inpatient Telehealth Programs position is also responsible for enhancing the care and improving access to specialty care for acute patients within the telehealth network. Serves as the project manager for the emergency department/inpatient based acute care consult network, to include but not limited to Telesitter, Telepsychiatry and Telestroke programs. Responsibilities include all aspects of program management and oversight including development, oversight and coordination of all program components, and assurance that objectives are met. This position will also work closely with leadership across the organization to ensure best practices are implemented along with a thorough understanding of financial and budgeting processes and principles, which allows the Manager Inpatient Telehealth Programs to assess earnings and spending to find areas for improvement.

The manager position responsibilities include managing the daily work activities of the work unit/department staff, ensuring quality, productivity, functional excellence and efficiency while assisting management in accomplishing strategic and operational objectives. In addition, this position provides guidance to staff and is responsible for staffing, budget compliance, contributing to staffing decisions such as hiring and terminating employment, coaching and counseling employees on work related performance, and assisting in the development and implementation of policies and procedures to ensure a safe and effective work environment. This position also implements training, monitoring and operations initiatives that secure compliance with ethical and legal business practices and accreditation/regulatory/ government regulations.

Exempt

  • Ability to use appropriate interpersonal styles and techniques to gain acceptance of ideas or plans; modifying one’s own behavior to accommodate tasks, situations and individuals involved
  • Demonstrates leadership qualities and critical thinking through self-direction initiative and effective interpersonal skills and oral/written communication skills
  • Ability to identify and understand issues, problems and opportunities, comparing data from different sources to draw conclusions; using effective approaches for choosing a course of action or developing appropriate solutions; taking action that is consistent with available facts, constraints and probable consequences
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast paced environment
  • Demonstrates flexibility and adaptability in the workplace


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

PEOPLE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Performs management responsibilities of selection, scheduling, supervision, retention, and evaluation of employees in the department. Provides development and mentoring of staff. Meets or exceeds threshold goal for department turnover. Develops direct reports to perform these same functions.
  • Provides fair and consistent leadership and communication to maintain a competent and engaged employee group by conducting regular department meetings to review policies and procedures and operational matters, rounding on all employees, completing performance appraisals, conducting new hire feedback sessions, coaching/corrective counseling, and providing recognition/commendations to achieve desired outcomes. Provides timely guidance and feedback to help others strengthen specific knowledge/skill areas needed to accomplish a task or solve a problem.
  • Facilitates and promotes effective team dynamics and teambuilding strategies within and between departments; participates and/or leads and facilitates department process improvements as needed.
  • Meets or exceeds threshold goal for department and/or system metrics on employee engagement indicators: action readiness score, tier level.
  • Interacts with all system clinical departments to coordinate efforts to provide an acute care program. Works with IT to provide training to staff and customer hospitals, vendor partners as needed in the use of equipment, provide in-services, and validates competencies.

SERVICE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Plans and organizes day-to-day department operations, schedule and activities. Sets priorities and functional standards, giving direction to staff as necessary to ensure the best possible delivery of service and high customer/patient satisfaction.
  • Drives department service standards and activities to impact department and/or system score for patient/customer-based satisfaction, through role modeling and fostering accountability. Serves and actively participates on various entity committees as a voice for the department.
  • Responsible for system-wide coordination and oversight of the acute care program including outreach, operational roll out, and day to day oversight, and facilitating evaluation of the program.
  • Works closely with coordinators and clinical departments to share protocols, case reviews, and outreach rounds to network hospitals; advise on training needs to include continuing education for physicians and nurses in the region.
  • Collaborates with the virtual team to support ongoing improvement of care processes and patient outcomes through data management/ analysis, including: collection of all necessary data from clinical projects; preparing clinical outcomes and other relevant reports; and designing and implementing applied research strategies.

QUALITY/SAFETY ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Ensures a safe and effective working environment; monitors and/or revises the department safety plan and/or any specific accreditation/regulatory required safety guidelines.
  • Uses and optimizes information systems to enhance operations; supports entity-specific performance improvement and data management/analysis functions.
  • Employs a proactive approach in the optimization of safe outcomes by monitoring and improving the department workflow, using peer-to-peer accountability, and identifying solutions via collaboration. Adopts lean principles in driving process improvements. Role models situational awareness, using teachable moments to improve safety.

  • Acts as an effective liaison with hospitals that are part of the telehealth network, ensuring that hospitals are satisfied with all components of the program; collaborates closely with departments and providers, and vendors to facilitate streamlined clinical process and flow optimization, quality assurance and protocol compliance. Acts as an effective liaison to medical staff to ensure continuity and congruity of hospital services in accordance with the plan of care. May include patient and family follow-up and patient/community education and awareness efforts.
  • In collaboration with nursing director and medical director, helps to develop quality/metric dashboards for reporting to customer hospitals. Manages quality/issue resolution process.

title: Senior Member of Technical Staff – DO178/ IEC 61508/ IEC 62304 Certification
description:
ABOUT WIND RIVER

Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability.

Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. The company’s software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We’ve achieved recent 5G milestones including the world’s first successful 5G data session with Verizon and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone.

The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a “Top Workplace” for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer-focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging, come join us and help advance the future software defined world.


YOUR ROLE

As a Member of Technical Staff – Engineering Sys Cert Office, you will work with a skilled team to plan and drive execution of projects and feature development, following well-defined Agile processes. You will work cross-functionally with Architects, Technologists, Product Managers, remote development teams, and customer-facing teams to deliver capabilities across Wind River’s VxWorks and Helix Virtualization Platform products.

This role focuses on delivering high-quality, safety-critical software capabilities with excellent user experience.

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE

In your day-to-day job you will:

  • Design and maintain processes for the development of certified and safety-critical software
  • Ensure compliance with industrial, medical, aerospace and automotive standards (e.g., IEC 61508, IEC 62304, DO-178C)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive process improvements
  • Provide support to teams during project execution
  • Support training project teams in safety-critical lifecycle activities
  • Support the evaluation and selection of appropriate tools, processes, and technologies
  • Support Subject Matter Expert (SME) on the assigned process areas
  • Participate in the process definition reviews
  • Support SQA team in the process quality assurance activities
  • Work with global teams as needed to achieve project objectives

QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in software, system or product safety process definition
  • Product or process development experience in aerospace, Industrial, medical or automotive industries
  • Expertise in at least one of the following: IEC 61508, DO-178C, IEC 62304

The IB Program Manager provides end-to-end program leadership for Cardiovascular Ultrasound Installed Base initiatives. Based in India, the role partners with global stakeholders to translate customer, patient, quality, regulatory, service, supply-chain and business priorities into integrated execution plans.
The role owns program governance, prioritization, schedule, budget and resource visibility, cross-functional dependencies, risks and leadership escalation. The successful candidate will be operating independently across a complex global matrix and driving measurable customer, quality, lifecycle and business outcomes. Technical design authority remains with the accountable Engineering, Systems, Quality and Regulatory leaders.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end planning and execution of assigned CVUS Installed Base programs across the post-launch product lifecycle.
  • Define program scope, outcomes, milestones, deliverables, resources, dependencies, decision points and operating cadence.
  • Create and maintain an integrated execution plan across Engineering, Systems, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Service, Finance and Product Management.
  • Build and manage a transparent IB backlog, facilitating prioritization based on patient and customer impact, safety, regulatory commitments, product quality, service burden, fulfilment, lifecycle urgency, cost and resource availability.
  • Drive cross-functional execution for customer complaints and investigations, product quality issues, corrective actions, CAPA, SCR/SPR, CSO, FMI or field actions, CCN and standards updates, cybersecurity updates, product holds and recovery actions, as applicable.
  • Lead sustaining execution for design changes, supplier or component changes, obsolescence, component end-of-life, continuity of supply and product lifecycle or end-of-life activities.
  • Ensure effective transition from NPI into Installed Base support, with clear ownership of residual risks, sustaining commitments and field-readiness actions.
  • Lead program reviews and relevant Heartbeat operating mechanisms; maintain concise dashboards covering milestones, backlog, risks, dependencies, resources, budget, customer and quality actions, and decisions.
  • Actively manage program budgets, purchase orders, forecasts and actuals in partnership with budget owners and Finance.
  • Maintain resource and capacity visibility, surface constraints early, and facilitate cross-functional trade-off and allocation decisions.
  • Identify and mitigate program, quality, regulatory, supply, resource, schedule and implementation risks before they affect customers or commitments.
  • Escalate unresolved issues with a clear problem statement, customer and business impact, options and a recommended course of action.
  • Provide clear, fact-based communication to India, Horten and broader CVUS leadership, with documented decisions, owners and closure dates.
  • Apply Lean and continuous-improvement principles to simplify IB execution, improve predictability and standardize effective program-management practices.

Educational Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering from an accredited university or institution.

Required Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in engineering, program management, product development, sustaining engineering or product-lifecycle leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, global, cross-functional program in a matrix organization.
  • Proven ability to convert complex technical, quality, regulatory and business issues into integrated, executable program plans.
  • Strong program-management capability across scope, schedule, milestones, risk, resources, budget, dependencies, decisions and stakeholder communication.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive accountable closure without direct reporting authority.
  • Experience managing multiple competing priorities, urgent field or business issues and ambiguity with limited direction.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including concise program reviews and escalation to senior leadership.
  • Ability to work effectively across India, Europe and other global locations and time zones.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience in regulated medical devices, healthcare technology or another highly regulated product environment.
  • Working knowledge of medical-device design controls, complaints, CAPA, field actions, product risk management, regulatory compliance, design changes, running VCP programs and lifecycle or end-of-life processes.
  • Experience with diagnostic ultrasound, imaging systems, electromechanical medical equipment or comparable complex hardware and software products.
  • Experience leading sustaining releases, supplier and component changes, obsolescence, continuity-of-supply or product-quality improvement programs.
  • Financial-management experience covering program budgets, forecasts, purchase orders, external spend and actuals.
  • Lean or continuous improvement experience focused on reducing hand-offs, delays and execution variability.
  • Experience using portfolio or program-management systems, operational dashboards and data-driven reviews to support decisions.

Common Engineering Expectations:

  • Cloud-native and hybrid cloud/on-premises product development using AWS services.
  • Containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and production observability.
  • Secure engineering, identity and access management, encryption, secrets management and DevSecOps.
  • Performance, scalability, availability, reliability, fault tolerance and disaster recovery.
  • Automated unit, integration, API, system, performance and reliability testing.
  • Strong design, coding, debugging, root-cause analysis and technical documentation practices.
  • Integration challenges of third party and second party SaaS solutions.
  • Working with AI-DLC and software development acceleration.

Healthcare and Medical Device Context:

  • Experience in regulated healthcare or medical-device development is required for the Verification Lead and strongly preferred for senior architecture, automation and program roles.
  • Strong knowledge on SDLC, PRD process, Risks, FMEAs.
  • Awareness of patient-data privacy, cybersecurity and secure handling of clinical information.
  • Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards such as DICOM, HL7 and FHIR.
  • ·Experience with real-time clinical data, device connectivity, patient monitoring or high-availability clinical applications is advantageous.

title: Analyst, Geospatial (GIS)
description:
Invenergy is North America’s largest privately held developer, owner, and operator of power infrastructure. With 25 years of trusted execution, we deliver reliable, affordable energy through a diverse portfolio that includes natural gas, solar, land-based wind, energy storage, transmission, and domestic manufacturing. Headquartered in Chicago, we develop, own, and operate large scale projects that power communities and support the energy future.


Invenergy follows a hybrid schedule, working in office Monday through Thursday and remotely on Fridays if work permits.


This position will be open for application for at least 3 calendar days from the posting date. This position will remain open for application based on business need, which may be before or after the 3-day posting window.

Job Description

Position Overview

Invenergy is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Geospatial Analyst to join our collaborative Engineering & GIS team. This entry-level role is perfect for individuals eager to grow their technical skills while learning how geospatial data drives decisions across energy project lifecycles.

As a Geospatial Analyst, you will gain valuable experience supporting projects that power homes and businesses. You will learn not only technical GIS workflows but also how those workflows fit into the broader development process—giving you insight into multiple aspects of the energy business. This role is an excellent foundation for advancing into a specialist, developer, or project-focused roles while making a meaningful impact as you learn how energy infrastructure projects are built.

As a Geospatial Analyst, you will be part of a team that supports multiple departments—Development, Engineering, Environmental, and Land—ensuring geospatial data and mapping are accurate, accessible, and useful. You’ll gain exposure to many aspects of the business process, from project siting and permitting to construction and operations.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborative Mapping & Data Support

  • Work closely with GIS Analysts and Developers to deliver high-quality maps, data, and interactive, online products.

  • Partner with Development and Engineering teams to meet project needs and deadlines.

  • Incorporate feedback from multiple stakeholders to refine deliverables.

Project & Workflow Support

  • Assist with map requests, spatial data integration, and basic analyses.

  • Support project intake by organizing surveys, parcels, and environmental datasets.

  • Learn how geospatial workflows contribute to siting, land acquisition, permitting, and design.

Data Management & Learning

  • Maintain centralized GIS databases with attention to standards and version control.

  • Learn project geospatial data needs and support holistic data management for project data.

  • Follow established practices for metadata and file management.

  • Learn automation and efficiency practices to streamline repetitive tasks.

Team Contribution & Growth

  • Participate actively in team meetings, knowledge-sharing, and problem-solving sessions.

  • Build an understanding of how GIS connects across departments and contributes to business decisions.

  • Actively learn how the GIS team operates and contribute to ongoing improvements.

  • Take advantage of opportunities for skill development in GIS software, scripting, and renewable energy workflows.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geography, GIS, Environmental Science, or related field.

  • Proficiency with ESRI software (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online / ArcGIS Enterprise).

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to communicate clearly and work as part of a team.

  • Eligible to work in the United States without the need for employer visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Internship or academic experience applying GIS in real-world projects.

  • Familiarity with renewable energy, environmental datasets, or land records.

  • Exposure to automation tools (Python, SQL) or interest in learning them.

  • Exposure to raster analysis and image interpretation and processing

Bonus: 15%

title: Solutions Architect, NCP Infrastructure
description:
NVIDIA is looking for Senior Cloud Infrastructure Solutions Architect with extensive design skills in infrastructure experience to join its ANZ Team, specificically focused on working with our Neo Clouds.

In this role, you’ll connect to our Neo Cloud ecosystem (Data Center providers, OEM’s and Neo Clouds) to design large scale Neo Cloud deployments utilising NVIDIA’s hardware and software designs based on NVIDI DSX. We’re looking for someone with strong technical experience and depth who can serve as a trusted advisor and skilled designer, bridging complex design challenges, and grow into a strategic resource for the our Neo Cloud ecosystem. If you’re excited about applied technology and enabling others to succeed with advanced platforms, we’d love to hear from you


What you'll be doing:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor who understands complex or large-scale customer workloads and maps them to NVIDIA’s technology designs stack to achieve scale out approved designs.
  • Co-design advanced, scalable architectures with Partners, OEM’s and Neo Clouds, defining technical direction, integration milestones, and deployment plans.
  • Working with NVIDIA Services and post sales teams for deployment assitanced and operational excellence adoption.
  • Engage hands-on with deep technical topics—designing, validating, and supporting solutions that enable customer and partner success.
  • Identify gaps between customer or partner needs and NVIDIA offerings, communicating insights that shape internal product and engineering priorities.
  • Lead technical engagements, helping customers troubleshoot, resolve complex issues, and advocate for their technical needs.
  • Partner cross-functionally with engineering and product teams to ensure successful deployment and continuous improvement of NVIDIA solutions.
  • Serve as a key technical resource, develop, refine, and document standard methodologies and operational guidelines to be shared with internal teams.
  • Lead technical engagements, helping customers troubleshoot, resolve complex issues, and advocate for their technical needs.
  • Create and deliver high-quality documentation, including runbooks, onboarding materials, and best-practice guides for customers and internal teams.
  • Become the technical leader for assigned customer accounts, providing strategic guidance on NVIDIA DSX and platform architecture and influencing long-term infrastructure and operations decisions, both regionally and with our HQ teams.

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in Industry background spanning software/hardware engineering, developer relations, technical partnerships, solutions architecture, or product management — with 3+ years of direct, hands-on experience in design and deployment of scale out designs at data center scale.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, from engineers to C-level executives.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to helping customers succeed.
  • Proven Hardware & Software knowledge and experience at scale: deep experience with HPC and AI technologies (CPUs, GPUs, high-speed interconnects and storage) and supporting software stacks.
  • Solution Architecture & Customer Engagement/pre sales skills: Strong background in crafting scalable solutions and providing consultative support to customers.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Knowledge and experience with NVIDIA Neo Clouds, or scale out GPU deployments as well as NVIDIA specific architectures.
  • Solid hands-on knowledge of data centre level networking design, for compute architectures.
  • Experience in large-scale computing and cluster computing, data center design include high speed interconnect with Spectrum/InfiniBand, Cluster Storage and Scheduling related design and/or management experience.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for software deployment and automation.
  • Background with RDMA-based fabrics (InfiniBand or RoCE) in HPC or AI environments.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

title: Enterprise Regulatory Compliance Audit & Monitoring Program Admin I
description:
Job Description:

Summary:

The Enterprise Regulatory Compliance Program Administrator evaluates new and evolving federal and state regulatory guidance and assesses their impact on enterprise-wide business processes, products, and operational strategies. This role partners closely with functional business areas to translate complex regulatory guidance into practical risk-based compliance solutions and supports the ongoing administration of an effective regulatory compliance program.


The Administrator plays a key role in monitoring regulatory change, performing impact assessments, supporting audits and examinations, and advising business partners to ensure compliance with applicable requirements issued by regulatory and oversight agencies, including but not limited to the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), New York State Department of Health (DOH), Department of Financial Services (DFS), Department of Labor (DOL), Office of Inspector General (OIG), and Office of the Medicaid Inspector General (OMIG).


Essential Accountabilities:


Level I

  • Supports oversight and execution of regulatory compliance activities for assigned business areas, including implementation, monitoring, and documentation of regulatory requirements within the Enterprise compliance framework. This may include system research and analysis and data gathering and evaluation through interactions with internal business area staff throughout the organization.
  • Responsible for interpreting federal and state regulatory guidance and responding to compliance-related inquiries, providing clear, practical guidance to business partners regarding company products, services, and operations.
  • Monitors changes in regulations both at the state and federal level which may affect the operations of the Health Plan and its subsidiaries. Assesses for any impact to programs, operational procedures, policies, and systems supporting the organization’s Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial, and retail market programs.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams including but not limited to Customer Service, Product and Operations, Marketing, Sales, Claims, Enrollment, Pharmacy, Quality Office, Utilization Management, and Advocacy to support regulatory compliance readiness and implementation, including gathering evidence of compliance.
  • Participates in regulatory risk assessments by identifying potential compliance vulnerabilities, assisting with root cause analysis, and supporting development of corrective actions and remediation plans.
  • Collaborates with assigned internal business areas to support adherence to regulatory compliance key performance indicators (KPIs) and related reporting and remediation when metrics are not met.
  • Contributes to and supports the development of compliance communication tools, training and monitoring activities to promote awareness and understanding of regulatory requirements.
  • Attends business and project meetings to proactively identify compliance considerations and mitigate regulatory risk.
  • Participates in Compliance Oversight Committees (COCs).
  • Assists in preparing accurate documentation, reports, and responses for regulatory filings, surveys, audits, and information requests.
  • Supports Federal, State, and accreditation audits and examinations.
  • Consistently demonstrates high standards of integrity by supporting the Lifetime Healthcare Companies’ mission and values, adhering to the Corporate Code of Conduct, and leading to the Lifetime Way values and beliefs.
  • Maintains high regard for member privacy in accordance with the corporate privacy policies and procedures.
  • Regular and reliable attendance is expected and required.
  • Performs other functions as assigned by management.


Level II (in addition to Level I Accountabilities)

  • Operates with increased autonomy and serves as subject matter expert and resource to operational areas regarding compliance, governance, and risk matters.
  • Independently coordinates and facilitates cross-functional work groups, when necessary, to support implementation of new or revised regulatory requirements.
  • Leads or co-leads regulatory change management initiatives, including communication planning, implementation tracking, and effectiveness monitoring.
  • Represents the organization on external calls with vendors, business partners, industry groups, or the BlueCross BlueShield Association, as applicable.
  • Support the coordination and oversight of audits or reviews conducted by third parties or external vendors.
  • Shares regulatory knowledge and best practices with peers and business partners.


Level III (in addition to Level II Accountabilities)

  • Manages highly complex, high-risk, or enterprise-wide regulatory compliance issues and provides expert guidance to senior leadership, stakeholders, and operational teams.
  • Serves as a key point of contact with regulatory agencies and represents the organization during regulatory discussions, audits, or examinations.
  • Represents leadership in Compliance committees, governance forums, and enterprise workgroups.
  • May lead or oversee internal audits or external regulatory audits, examinations, or corrective action efforts, including regulator engagement and response strategy.
  • Provides mentorship and guidance to less experienced team members and acts as a trusted advisor.
  • Contributes to the ongoing maturity and effectiveness of the enterprise compliance program.


Minimum Qualifications:


NOTE: We include multiple levels of classification differentiated by demonstrated knowledge, skills, and the ability to manage increasingly independent and/or complex assignments, broader responsibility, additional decision making, and in some cases, becoming a resource to others. In addition to using this differentiated approach to place new hires, it also provides guideposts for employee development and promotional opportunities.


Level I

  • Seven or more years’ experience in health insurance or health care delivery, or bachelor’s degree in related area with four or more years of related experience.
  • Working knowledge of federal and state health care regulatory frameworks affecting Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial products.
  • Extensive knowledge of regulatory initiatives and legislation that impacts the health insurance industry. Understanding of regulations and ability to administer compliance for all areas across an organization.
  • Familiarity with utilization management, authorization, and claims and enrollment processing workflows and systems.
  • Strong project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct regulatory research, analyze guidance, and translate requirements into business-ready recommendations.
  • Strong research, analytical, and creative critical thinking skills. Capacity to identify and understand business objectives and associated risks of the operational area under review in order to make recommendations to improve the effectiveness or efficiency of regulatory operational processes.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and ability to communicate regulatory concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
  • High degree of accountability, follow-through, and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and enterprise systems.


Level II (in addition to Level I Qualifications)

  • Nine or more years of relevant experience, or bachelor’s degree with six or more years of related experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of health insurance regulations and compliance program operations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple complex regulatory initiatives or compliance projects.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and operate independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and influence skills.


Level III (in addition to Level II Qualifications)

  • Eleven or more years of relevant experience, or bachelor’s degree with eight or more years of related experience.
  • Professional certification preferred (i.e., CPCO, CHC, CHPC, HCCA-related credentials).
  • Proven expertise in resolving highly complex regulatory compliance issues and projects and management of regulatory audits.
  • Ability to operate with the highest degree of initiative, leadership, and strategic thinking.
  • Recognized as a trusted compliance advisor across the organization.


Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to work prolonged periods sitting and/or standing at a workstation and working on a computer.
  • Ability to travel within the service region for meetings, audits, or trainings as needed.
  • Role requires extensive review, analysis, and interpretation of regulatory documentation.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
Corporate:
Light & Wonder’s corporate team is comprised of incredible talent that works across the enterprise, defying boundaries to provide essential services in an extraordinary manner to ensure the success of the organization and the well-being of employees.

Position Summary

Serves as the technical gatekeeper for AI tools built by non-developers and aids in the builds and deployment of AI solutions across the enterprise, specifically the CFO organization. Ensures that when a business user builds something with AI, it's safe, accurate, and operates within the established governance guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

Review AI solutions built by non-developers against best-practice engineering standards and the team's governance framework before they go into production.

Champion reusable architecture patterns and templates so solutions can be redeployed across all BUs rather than rebuilt each time.

Assess citizen-developer builds for data lineage, model accuracy thresholds, human-in-the-loop safeguards, and audit trail compliance, then flag and lead to remediate gaps.

Aid to implement automated output validation, drift detection, and exception escalation for solutions post-launch.

Track token/API usage and cost at the solution and BU level; support monthly usage reporting to CFO leadership.

Design, build, and deploy AI/LLM-integrated solutions for FP&A, accounting, audit, and reporting workflows; maintain all code in Git with version control and peer review.

Partner with the FP&A AI Sr. Analyst on requirements, the AI Governance lead on control design, and enterprise IT/architecture on alignment.

Qualifications

Required Skills: Technical

Python (or equivalent) for automation and data pipeline work.

Cloud platform experience (Azure/AWS preferred).

Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI).

Git-based version control, structured code review, and change management practices.

SQL and ETL/data pipeline experience.

Working familiarity with low-code/RPA platforms (Power Platform, UiPath, Copilot Studio), with enough depth to competently review, not necessarily build in them.

Understanding of AI governance concepts: model validation, drift detection, data lineage, audit trails.

Required Skills: Domain & Communication

Able to explain technical risk in plain language to non-technical finance staff whose builds are under review.

Working knowledge of finance processes sufficient to judge business context and materiality of a given AI build.

Comfortable working across business units with varying technical maturity.

Nice to Have

Finance/accounting background or FP&A exposure.

Experience standing up a citizen-developer governance program or AI Center of Excellence.

SOX/internal controls familiarity.

title: EMT Class - Janesville, Wisconsin
description:
Overview

History of the Company: Superior Ambulance Service started in 1959 with one ambulance and today is the largest independent, locally owned, and operated emergency medical services provider in the Midwest. Superior employs more than 4,000 licensed EMT, Paramedics and Nurses, operating a fleet of more than 800 ambulances throughout Illinois, Indiana, Ohio, Michigan, and Wisconsin. Superior also provides Critical Care, helicopter, and fixed wing emergency medical transportation.

We are looking for highly motivated and self-driven candidates to join the EMS Industry. We are offering an on-site 4-month EMT Student Program that will educate students and prepare them to challenge the National Registry Exam and become a Wisconsin Licensed EMT. All materials are covered by Superior Ambulance Service (SAS). Upon receiving their Wisconsin EMT licensure, the student will be hired as a full time employee and be required to complete a 15-month commitment of continuous full-time employment. There is NO cost for the selected students to attend the class unless they are unable to complete the 15-months of employment after licensure.

Our 280 hour class will provide hands on training that will assist prospective candidates with obtaining their National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT) and state licenses. Within this 4 month course you will learn skills related but not limited to Emergency Medical Services (EMS) vehicle operations, airway management, cardiac emergencies, pharmacology, pediatrics, trauma, and obstetrics.


Responsibilities

This is a Waitlist for the Excelerated EMT Program Accelerated EMT Certification Program (Approximately 4 months, 2 to 3 days per week) that will educate and prepare you to successfully complete the National Registry Exam to become a licensed EMT. Direct employment is provided by Superior Ambulance after successful completion of the class and passing the national exam.


Qualifications

  • Possess a valid driver's license, satisfactory driving record in accordance with Superiors Driving Policy and must be able to safely operate a vehicle in various conditions, including daytime, nighttime and inclement weather.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.
  • Ability to work cooperatively with other employees and medical agencies to provide the highest level of patient care.
  • Ability to pass a background check.
  • Ability to read and interpret all required documents and write required reports and correspondence.
  • Other qualifications/certifications specific to the local operation and/or contract requirements.
  • Satisfactorily meet company physical assessments/tests/drug screening. (Must be able to lift 137.5 lbs)
  • High School diploma or GED required, unless currently enrolled in High School.
  • Past training in healthcare related fields, or Military experience is welcomed but not necessary.
  • Must be 18 years or older to be considered.
  • Admission will be approved based on passing an entrance assessment.

title: Clinical Project Manager
description:
Job Description Summary

The Clinical Research Project Manager (Research Program Integrator- RPI) is responsible for project managing defined research activity for Ultrasound business(es) within GE Healthcare. The RPI leads cross-functional planning, tracking, communication of status, and execution of research activity. The RPI manages wing to wing execution for research activity taking defined projects from the strategic research management team through development, management, and closure, while meeting all quality, content, schedule, and budget targets.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Project manages defined research activity, which includes, internal and external, GE HealthCare and Investigator Sponsored studies, product evaluations, and other activities defined to meet strategic research needs.
  • Ensures that the research activities abide by all defined cross-functional standards, meets the intent and letter of Phased Review Discipline, QMS, SOPs, GCP, and all compliance and regulatory requirements of the applicable regions.
  • Leads the cross-functional research activity team and project manages the activity to conduct assigned internal and external research activity and deliver the required deliverables per the business needs and defined study plan.
  • Partners with the Research Manager (RM) for prioritization and changes to study details.
  • Develops research documents as required, including protocols, plans, informed consent forms, and required storage of research documents including managing.
  • Negotiates budget and contracts with external partners and processes payments.
  • Conducts and/or coordinates required training, initiation, monitoring and closure with study site and study team. Serves as QC to support review and approval of these activities for peer studies as required.
  • Maintains applicable study records in a timely and accurate fashion which may include Clinical Trials Management System, MyWorkshop, regional regulatory records (e.g. ClinicalTrials.gov), Support Central, and/or other study records.
  • Develops relationships with and supports external research partners and manages communication with external sites in a professional and productive manner.
  • Works with RMs, regional RMs, research operations, engineering teams, service, QA, RA, Medical, and segment team members to conduct and deliver research activity and results on time, within budget and with the necessary deliverables.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in life science, engineering, clinical field or equivalent
  • 4+ years of experience project managing clinical and/or technical research studies in a clinical setting, industry, or government agency
  • Demonstrated understanding/experience with Good Clinical Practices, global and regional research regulations, research processes, New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle and cross-functional interdependencies
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Demonstrated success in projects requiring accuracy with details, documentation, and communication between parties
  • Experience in working with a global and virtual team with ongoing positive outcomes and impact

Desired Characteristics

  • Master’s Degree in science or related field or advance medical degree
  • Professional certification in Project Management (PMP) or clinical research (CCRP, CCRA, or CCRN)
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Ability to proactively manage project according to timelines. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.

description:

About The Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical HubSpot Business Analyst to support and optimize our HubSpot CRM environment. This role will serve as a key liaison between business users and technology, helping drive adoption, improve processes, and ensure our HubSpot platform effectively supports business objectives.


The ideal candidate has hands-on experience administering and supporting HubSpot Sales Hub and Marketing Hub, enjoys solving complex problems, and can translate business requirements into scalable CRM solutions. This is an excellent opportunity for a professional who thrives in a collaborative environment and is passionate about leveraging technology to improve user experience, data quality, and operational efficiency.


What You'll Do

As the HubSpot Business Analyst, you will:

  • Provide day-to-day support for HubSpot users, responding to system-related questions and issues.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to users, permissions, workflows, pipelines, reports, dashboards, and data integrity.
  • Administer and configure HubSpot, including properties, workflows, forms, lists, reports, dashboards, and user access controls.
  • Gather, document, and analyze business requirements, translating them into practical system solutions and process improvements.
  • Evaluate existing business processes and recommend opportunities for automation, optimization, and increased efficiency.
  • Manage and prioritize support requests and enhancement initiatives in partnership with the CRM Manager.
  • Test system changes, coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), and document outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain user guides, process documentation, training materials, and best practice resources.
  • Deliver user training and ongoing support to encourage effective adoption of HubSpot tools and functionality.
  • Support data management activities, including imports, exports, data cleansing, deduplication, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Monitor system utilization and assist with CRM governance, standards, compliance, and data quality initiatives.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders and escalate complex issues to the CRM Manager, HubSpot Support, or other technical resources as needed.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience with HubSpot Sales Hub and/or Marketing Hub in an administrative, business analyst, CRM support, or related role.
  • Experience administering and configuring CRM platforms, preferably HubSpot.
  • Strong background in end-user support and troubleshooting business applications.
  • Experience gathering, documenting, and analyzing business and system requirements.
  • Working knowledge of CRM processes, workflow automation, reporting, and data management best practices.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment while managing multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with additional HubSpot solutions such as Service Hub, CMS Hub, and/or Operations Hub.
  • HubSpot certifications in Administration, Sales Hub, Marketing Hub, or related disciplines.
  • Experience supporting CRM implementations, system enhancements, or process improvement initiatives.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems and IT application support methodologies.
  • Experience developing user documentation, process guides, and training materials.
  • Knowledge of CRM governance, data governance, access controls, and industry best practices.

Zekelman Industries offers competitive compensation and excellent benefits, including low-cost, high-quality medical and dental benefits. In addition, we have an amazing tuition assistance program, a bonus plan, a 401(k) plan with a generous company match, immediate vesting, and much more.

We manufacture superior quality tubular and related products, and provide outstanding service for our valued customers.

title: Clinical Applications Specialist - Monitoring Systems
description:
Job Description Summary

At GE HealthCare, we are committed to creating a world where healthcare has no limits. In this national field-based role, you will combine your critical care expertise, passion for education, and knowledge of patient monitoring to help clinicians confidently adopt technology in the moments that matter most.

As a Clinical Applications Specialist, you will be a trusted clinical partner before, during, and after implementation. You will assess workflows, shape education strategies, deliver outcome-focused training, and collaborate across sales, service, product, and project teams to support customer success.

Job Description

· Be the clinical expert. Serve as a subject matter expert in critical care patient monitoring, clinical workflows, and technology adoption.

· Lead implementation education. Assess customer needs and workflows, develop learning plans, and deliver role-based education for clinicians, super users, and other stakeholders.

· Deliver engaging learning experiences. Facilitate onsite and virtual training, demonstrations, workshops, and evaluations in French and English. Adapt your approach to the audience, care setting, and learning needs.

· Support safe and confident adoption. Reinforce evidence-informed practice, system capabilities, alarm-management concepts, and workflow standardization within the approved scope of GE HealthCare solutions.

· Partner across the customer journey. Support pre-sale demonstrations, implementation planning, go-live readiness, post-implementation optimization, upgrades, and strategic customer touchpoints.

· Build trusted relationships. Collaborate with clinical leaders, educators, super users, key opinion leaders, and multidisciplinary teams to strengthen adoption and long-term customer outcomes.

· Collaborate as one team. Work closely with colleagues in Clinical Applications, Sales, Service, Product, and Project Management. Communicate risks, dependencies, customer feedback, and opportunities clearly.

· Drive continuous improvement. Capture training outcomes, share field insights, contribute to education content, and remain current on critical care practice, patient monitoring, and adult learning.

· Operate with quality and integrity. Follow GE HealthCare quality, compliance, privacy, safety, and documentation requirements, along with applicable customer policies and regulation


Required Qualifications

· Professional fluency in English, including the ability to teach, present, and write effectively.

· Registered Nurse in good standing with the applicable provincial regulatory body. Current or recent critical care experience is strongly preferred.

· Degree, diploma, or equivalent combination of education and experience, with 3+ years of clinical experience in critical care, acute care, or patient monitoring.

· Demonstrated knowledge of critical care workflows and physiologic monitoring, including ECG, hemodynamic monitoring, ventilation-related parameters, and alarm management.

· Experience developing and delivering clinical education using adult learning principles.

· Ability to translate complex clinical and technical information into clear, practical guidance for varied audiences.

· Ability to work independently from a home office while contributing actively to a collaborative national team.

· Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Canada, including frequent overnight travel and occasional weekend support. Some travel to the United States may be required.

· Valid driver’s license and willingness to complete driving-record and customer credentialing requirements where applicable.


Preferred qualifications

· Certification or advanced education in critical care nursing.

· Experience with GE HealthCare patient monitoring solutions or comparable enterprise patient monitoring platforms.

· Experience supporting technology implementation, train-the-trainer programs, go-live readiness, workflow assessment, or clinical change management.

· Strong facilitation, presentation, relationship-building, planning, and documentation skills.

· Comfort using digital collaboration and virtual facilitation tools, with curiosity and a growth mindset.


We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership –always with unyielding integrity.


Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.
