title: Organic Growth Lead
description:
Job Title

Organic Growth Lead

Job Description


So, who are we?

IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn’t pivot to innovation; it’s how we’ve always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that’s rare in established businesses.


The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we’ll give you the platform to define what comes next.

Join us at IG – the future gets built here.


Your Team:

APAC | Marketing | Reports to: Head of Customer Engagement & Retention

The Organic Growth Lead will work closely with the division’s senior management team and senior marketers across APAC markets to translate commercial goals into channel-specific plans.


Your role in the Team’s Success:

To accelerate organic growth across our APAC businesses, covering web, search SEO and ASO, and grow our reach among high-quality prospects who become valuable clients. As search shifts towards AI-generated answers, this hands-on team lead will own SEO and AI search visibility, lead the SEO workstream of our CMS migration, and drive A/B testing on web to turn organic traffic into client improving conversions across the funnel.


What you’ll do:

  • CMS migration: Act as SEO owner for the migration to our new headless CMS, defining requirements for templates, metadata, URL structures, localisation and structured data, and leading URL mapping, redirects, QA and post-launch monitoring to protect rankings and traffic.
  • AI search: Define and lead our approach to visibility in AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and other answer engines, working with marketing teams to close content gaps, and establish measurement for AI citations, share of voice and referral traffic.
  • CRO and experimentation: Own the A/B testing roadmap using our CRO tool, running experiments on landing pages and key journeys to lift organic conversion rates and evidence the commercial value of the channel.
  • SEO strategy: Define and lead the organic search strategy for each market across technical, on-page and off-page SEO, including international SEO (hreflang), in line with Google’s and other search engines’ quality guidelines.
  • Own the ASO strategy with product and app teams, and partner with the Social lead to grow YouTube, social and news as acquisition channels establishing IG as an authority in the trading and investing space.
  • Oversee delivery through an in-house and agency model, setting clear priorities based on business goals and the biggest opportunities.
  • Lead, develop and motivate a multi-skilled organic team across markets.
  • Build strong relationships with product, engineering, content, paid media, compliance and local market teams to embed SEO best practice, and work with paid media to close gaps between paid and organic.
  • Own performance analysis, forecasting and reporting for all organic channels, linking activity to commercial outcomes and communicating progress to all levels, including senior management.

What You’ll Need:

  • Confident, driven leader who motivates and inspires
  • Stakeholder influencer, challenger and problem solver
  • Curious and experimental, with a genuine interest in how AI is reshaping search
  • Strong prioritization and delegation skills
  • Passionate about collaborating with other expert teams
  • Significant experience leading SEO across technical, on-page and content (agency experience welcome)
  • Hands-on experience delivering at least one large-scale CMS or platform migration while protecting organic performance
  • Demonstrable understanding of AI search and generative engine optimization, with examples of initiatives you have led
  • Hands-on experience running A/B tests and CRO programmes
  • Proven people leadership, including managing teams and agencies across multiple markets
  • Strong analytical skills using tools such as GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio and Screaming Frog, Botify or Lumar
  • Desirable: Experience with Storyblok or another headless CMS
  • Desirable: Experience with a CRO tool such as Optimizely
  • Desirable: Experience in a newsroom or fast-paced publishing environment
  • Desirable: Fluency in English plus an APAC language such as Mandarin or Japanese
  • Degree in business, marketing or a related subject, or equivalent professional experience
  • Excellent written and spoken English

The perks

It really is more than a job. We’ll recognize your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on

  • Competitive salary
  • Flexible and hybrid working (2 days working from home)
  • Private medical and dental insurance for employees and eligible dependants
  • Life insurance coverage
  • Disability income protection
  • Fitness benefits, including discounted access to Platinum Fitness Raffles Place and reimbursement of up to SGD 720/year
  • Annual health check reimbursement
  • 20 days annual leave, plus public holidays, birthday leave and volunteering days
  • Option to sell or carry forward annual leave
  • Employee Share Purchase Plan
  • Employee Assistance Programme for employees and their families
  • Health and wellbeing benefits
  • Comprehensive global and local onboarding programme
  • Strong employee community and social initiatives

title: Lab Automation Analyst
description:
Location: Collegeville, PA, Spring House, PA

*This role will require regular presence at our client site in Collegeville, PA or Spring House, PA*

**This role is not eligible for relocation assistance**

The Zifo Lab Automation Analyst provides technical laboratory automation services, including multivendor instrument, information technology and validation/compliance services when applicable. The individual will work as part of Zifo’s Lab Automation team to implement customer needs and address gaps to propose solutions for the desired automated state. He or she will work with business users and managers of customers in conjunction with the internal Zifo support teams.

Requirements

  • Provides technical support of customer laboratory environments
  • Ensure that common automation equipment is properly maintained and in good working order. This includes stand-alone liquid handlers (Hamilton, Echo, Tecan, etc), plate readers (SpectraMax, Envision, Neo2, etc) plate washers/dispensers, as well as several fully integrated robotic systems.
  • Install, operate, maintain, QC, troubleshoot problems, create methods/scripts, and train users on instruments is required.
  • Configured in-lab settings for automation software (eg: Cellario, Green Button Go) as required to train robotic equipment.
  • Perform unit test scripts for in-Lab automation equipment to validate the remote programmed software.
  • Able to build and operate debugging scripts and perform simple parallel development in the production environment.
  • Modify existing systems, instruments, methods and software to meet evolving needs.
  • Work collaboratively with discovery, engineering and expression groups at the local sites to optimize research efficiencies through implementation of automation process improvements and novel technologies
  • Ensures adherence to client’s corporate policies through periodic reporting and compliance programs
  • Document procedures, policies, troubleshooting and best practices
  • Perform system preventative maintenances based on client’s schedule, if applicable

Required Skills:

  • Knowledge of laboratory safety practices as defined by the company and/or customer’s site safety code
  • Experience in the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting and scripting for liquid handlers, dispensers, plate washers, plate readers, Octet, etc. required.
  • Programming experience using Python, Java, C# or VB.NET
  • Experience with scheduling, operation, training and troubleshooting of fully integrated robotic systems
  • Expertise with Hi-Res BioSolutions’ Cellario or Biosero’s Green Button Go scheduling software is a plus.
  • Experience with Titian Mosaic is a plus
  • Exemplary interpersonal skills including the ability to work with other automation engineers and non-automation scientists.
  • Excellent organizational skills, as exemplified by an aptitude for clear record-keeping and data analysis, and the ability to prioritize work across multiple projects.
  • Excellent customer service skills complemented by an ability to listen to and interpret client requests
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex instrument and technology issues
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to identify, track and complete tasks for multiple projects

About you:

  • Independent, self-motivated & results driven individual
  • Willingness & ability to acquire quickly new technical skills & business principles
  • Ability for Critical Thinking and Logical Reasoning
  • Good understanding of pharmaceutical research and drug Discovery & development processes and biologics workflows (preferred, not required)

Required Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor of Science in computer science, life science or equivalent industry experience
  • 2+ years of relevant technical experience including (but not limited to); biotech/pharmaceutical company or an automation provider.
  • Experience with scientific instrumentation (preferred)

Benefits

About Zifo:

CURIOSITY DRIVEN, SCIENCE FOCUSED, EMPLOYEE BUILT. Our culture is unlike any other, one where we debate, challenge ourselves, and interact with all alike. We are a curious bunch, characterized by our passion to learn and spirit of teamwork. Zifo is a global R&D solutions provider focused on the industries of Pharma, Biotech, Manufacturing QC, Medical Devices, specialty chemicals and other research-based organizations. Our team’s knowledge of science and expertise in technology help Zifo better serve our customers around the globe, including 18 of the Top 20 Biopharma companies.

We look for Science – Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Technology, Biomedical Engineering, Microbiology etc. We possess scientific and technical knowledge and bear professional and personal goals. While we have a “no doors” policy to promote free access within, we do have a tough door to walk in. We search with a two-point agenda – technical competency and cultural adaptability.

We offer a competitive compensation package including accrued vacation, medical, dental, vision, 401k with company matching, life insurance, and flexible spending accounts.

If you share these sentiments and are prepared for the atypical, then Zifo is your calling!

Zifo is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Vodja kontrole kakovosti (m/ž/d)
description:
Salary Range:

46.900,00 € - 87.100,00 €


Band

Level 5


Job Description Summary

#LI-Hybrid
Location: Ljubljana, Slovenija
Relocation Support: This role is based in Ljubljana, Slovenia. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

Ste pripravljeni prevzeti ključno vlogo pri oblikovanju prihodnosti ene najpomembnejših Novartisovih proizvodnih lokacij?

Na lokaciji Aseptika Ljubljana ustvarjamo strateško središče za lansiranje in proizvodnjo inovativnih aseptičnih zdravil, saj bo to edinstvena lokacija v Novartisovi svetovni mreži, kjer bodo na voljo vse ključne tehnologije za proizvodnjo aseptičnih zdravil. Pri nas boste imeli priložnost soustvarjati rešitve, ki bodo pacientom po vsem svetu prinašale nove možnosti zdravljenja.

Kot del naše ekipe boste sodelovali z vrhunskimi strokovnjaki iz Slovenije in mednarodnega okolja ter prispevali k postavljanju novih standardov odličnosti v farmacevtski industriji. Vaše delo bo imelo neposreden vpliv na razvoj in dostopnost inovativnih terapij za paciente po vsem svetu, hkrati pa boste imeli priložnost za strokovno rast v enem najbolj naprednih proizvodnih okolij v Novartisu.

Želite prevzeti strateško vodilno vlogo, v kateri boste povezovali strokovnost na področju kontrole kakovosti, razvoj sodelavcev in prihodnji razvoj laboratorija? Kot Vodja kontrole kakovosti boste vodili laboratorij ter ekipe kontrole kakovosti (QC) in analitskih znanosti in tehnologije (AS&T), pri čemer boste odgovorni za njihov strateški razvoj, učinkovito delovanje in zagotavljanje najvišjih standardov kakovosti. Iščemo vodjo, ki poleg odličnega razumevanja laboratorijskega okolja vidi širšo sliko ter zna povezovati kakovost, analitiko, ljudi, projekte in dolgoročne poslovne prioritete.


Job Description

Vaše ključne odgovornosti:

  • Vodenje in strateški razvoj laboratorija ter ekip kontrole kakovosti in analitskih znanosti in tehnologije.
  • Zagotavljanje skladnega, učinkovitega in pravočasnega izvajanja laboratorijskih aktivnosti ter najvišjih standardov kakovosti in integritete podatkov.
  • Usmerjanje razvoja, uvajanja in validacije analitskih metod ter zagotavljanje ustreznosti laboratorijske opreme in sistemov.
  • Vodenje izboljšav laboratorijskih procesov, povečevanje produktivnosti ter razvoj dolgoročne strategije in zmogljivosti laboratorijev.
  • Zagotavljanje učinkovite obravnave odstopanj, sprememb, reklamacij in drugih zahtev kakovosti ter podpora inšpekcijskim aktivnostim.
  • Povezovanje različnih strokovnih funkcij in laboratorijskih ekip ter spodbujanje izmenjave znanja, standardizacije in iskanja sinergij.
  • Upravljanje prioritet, virov in proračuna oddelka ter zagotavljanje učinkovitega izvajanja strateških in operativnih projektov.
  • Razvoj, usmerjanje in opolnomočenje sodelavcev ter gradnja kulture kakovosti, varnosti, sodelovanja in nenehnih izboljšav.

Vaš doprinos k delovnem mestu:

  • Visokošolska izobrazba farmacevtske, biološke, kemijske, mikrobiološke ali druge ustrezne naravoslovne smeri.
  • Najmanj 5 let delovnih izkušenj na področju kakovosti, razvoja ali proizvodnje v farmacevtski industriji oziroma na primerljivih delovnih mestih.
  • Dokazane izkušnje z neposrednim vodenjem, razvojem in usmerjanjem ekipe sodelavcev.
  • Proaktiven in v prihodnost usmerjen način razmišljanja ter sposobnost prepoznavanja priložnosti za razvoj in izboljšave.
  • Odlične komunikacijske sposobnosti, samozavestno vodenje zahtevnih pogovorov ter učinkovito sodelovanje z različnimi deležniki.
  • Aktivno znanje slovenskega in angleškega jezika ter dobro poznavanje orodij Microsoft Office.

Zaželene izkušnje:

  • Izkušnje z delom v laboratorijskem okolju aseptike ali na področju aseptične proizvodnje.
  • Izkušnje z neposrednim vodenjem večjih ekip.



Z izbranim kandidatom bomo sklenili delovno razmerje za nedoločen čas s poskusno dobo 6 mesecev. Prijavo oddajte z življenjepisom v slovenskem in angleškem jeziku.

Nagrajevanje:

V Novartisu smo zavezani k soustvarjanju prihodnosti medicine ter priznavanju in nagrajevanju ljudi, ki to omogočajo.


Pričakovani letni osnovni razpon plače za delovno mesto:

46.900,00 - 87.100,00 EUR

Plačna enakost je temeljno načelo naše kadrovske politike in odraža našo zavezo k ustvarjanju raznolikega, pravičnega in vključujočega okolja, ki vse zaposlene obravnava dostojanstveno in spoštljivo, kot je opredeljeno v našem Kodeksu etike.


Poleg osnovne letne bruto plače so zaposleni upravičeni tudi do spodaj navedenih ugodnosti:

Zavarovanje – Specialisti: Kolektivno zdravstveno zavarovanje, ki omogoča hitrejši dostop do specialističnih zdravstvenih storitev pri Zavarovalnici Triglav d.d. za vas in vaše družinske člane.
  • Care Connect: Program, ki ponuja zaupno, osebno podporo za vaše duševno zdravje in dobro počutje s pomočjo terapij, svetovanj, orodij in še mnogo več.
  • Ostale ugodnosti v skladu z zakonom in kolektivno pogodbo: Prevoz, prehrana ter ostali dodatki.

Preberite brošuro in izvedite več o našem sistemu nagrajevanja:


Opomba: Ugodnosti se lahko razlikujejo glede na državo ter so skladni z lokalno zakonodajo, vključno z določili kolektivnih pogodb. Celovit pregled vašega paketa prejemkov, vključno z morebitnimi relevantnimi določbami kolektivne pogodbe, ki veljajo za vašo delovno mesto glede na lokacijo zaposlitve in delodajalca Novartis, vam bo posredovan v okviru nadaljnjih korakov zaposlitvenega postopka.


Predani smo raznolikosti in vključenosti: Novartis si prizadeva ustvariti izjemno, vključujoče delovno okolje in oblikovanje raznolikih timov, saj ti predstavljajo naše bolnike in skupnosti, ki jih oskrbujemo.


Zakaj Novartis: Pomagati bolnikom in njihovim družinam zahteva več kot le inovativno znanost. Potrebna je skupnost zavzetih ljudi, kot ste vi. V Novartisu cenimo sodelovanje, podporo in navdihovanje drug drugega za razvoj prebojnih terapij, ki spreminjajo življenja pacientov. Ste pripravljeni ustvariti svetlejšo prihodnost skupaj z nami?


Skills Desired

Analytical Thinking, Business Acumen, Business Strategies, Change Management, Coaching, Collaboration, Communication, Continuous Improvement, Digital Fluency, Intelligent Risk Taking, Leadership, Managing Ambiguity, Problem Solving, Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Compliance, Quality Control (QC), Quality Management Systems (QMS), Regulatory Compliance, Risk-Based Decision Making, Risk Management, Stakeholder Management, Storytelling, Supplier Quality Management

title: Senior Analyst, Supply and Demand Planning
description:
SC Johnson has been leading with purpose for 140 years, building high-quality products and iconic brands found in homes, schools and businesses in virtually every country worldwide – including OFF!®, Raid®, Glade®, Windex®, Scrubbing Bubbles®, Ziploc®, Mrs. Meyer’s Clean Day®, method®, Autan®, Baygon®, Mr Muscle®, Duck®, Lysoform® and more.

The 13,000 people of our global, fifth-generation family company are committed to making the world a better place today and for future generations.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Senior Analyst, Supply and Demand Planning, your primary responsibility is to own the relationship and input from sales. In this role you will ensure a forecast for a subset of the Canadian business is developed, reviewed, published and adjusted as needed through partnerships with cross functionals in Sales, Finance, and Supply Chain. You will manage a portfolio of approximately 300 SKUs and will develop a forecast by using insights such as promotional plans, distribution changes, shipment history, competitor activities and marketing plans. This position is a key driver in creating and managing the true consumer demand signals by which to align the rest of the supply chain.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead collaboration calls with key sales accounts to review and adjust the forecast, based on customer input
  • Act as a key contributor in the S&OE process, to ensure our short term plans are reflective of changes, pacing, sale demand change requests and mitigate risk.
  • Participate in Step 1 and 2 of the S&OP process, collaborating with Design Planner and presenting short term and customer specific forecast changes to senior leadership teams for alignment.
  • Analyze historical and future demand inputs such as distribution changes, price changes, new product launches, and calculate their impacts on demand.
  • Make recommendations to enhance business processes and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiencies.
  • Review monthly demand sensing recommendations for short term forecast changes
  • Work with cross-functional partners on projects such as new product launches, obsolescence, and transitions to evaluate assumptions– new product forecast, pipeline fill, and cannibalization.
  • Collaborate with Sales on advertising and promotional plans and evaluate against performance from similar historical activities.
  • Ensure demand plan is shared in level of detail and timing required by internal customers and supply chain partners with documented assumptions, including risks and opportunities.
  • Conduct monthly root cause analyses on forecast error and identify corrective actions.
  • Measure, analyze, and communicate key process metrics and monitor adherence to key performance indicators, while driving continuous improvement.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE YOU’LL BRING

  • University Degree Required.
  • +3 years of combined experience in demand planning, sales, and/or supply chain.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCES AND SKILLS


  • University Degree in Operations Management, Economics, Supply Chain Management, Finance, or related field
  • Experience in CPG industry preferred
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally across all levels within the organization.
  • Ability to drive action and influence decision making at all levels of the organization.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, decision-making, problem-solving, and presentation skills.
  • Experience leading process improvement initiatives.
  • Quantitative and qualitative data analysis, including business process metrics and measures linking to business KPIs.
  • Experience with planning applications such as SAP, APO, Kinaxis, or SAS
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and experience with the use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Copilot

JOB REQUIREMENTS


  • Office work environment with regular business hours Monday to Friday
  • Remote work available once a week for eligible employees
  • This role is not eligible for relocation

BENEFITS AND PERKS

  • Company paid defined contribution pension plan
  • Profit Sharing
  • Johnson Employee Association (JEA) – fun events for you and your families, draws, prizes and use of our on-site fitness facility
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Shop in our Employee Store
  • Short Term and Long-Term Disability programs, Optional Life Insurance, Accidental Death and Dismemberment
  • Company matching on savings plan contributions
  • The use of Lake Joseph Resort - company cottages in the Muskokas!

title: Field Work Planner
description:
At TC Energy, we are proud to connect the world to the energy it needs. Guided by our values of safety in every step, personal accountability, one team and active learning, we deliver the critical energy that North America and the world rely on while balancing reliability, affordability and sustainability.


Join us. Connect to what matters.


The Opportunity

Our Canada Gas Maintenance Program & Planning team is evolving to meet the needs of our growing business. TC Energy is seeking a Field Work Planner with excellent verbal and written communication skills to work closely with field teams and Management, and coordinate work with other appropriate technical resources. The successful candidate will complete the planning and scheduling for the region. The candidate will be using multiple automated tools to track, plan, and schedule a monthly work plan. You will be working on a high performing planning team that will allow you to expand your skills and provide knowledge and feedback for other initiatives.


What you’ll do

  • Develop, manage, publish, and communicate monthly maintenance work plans for the assets within designated area(s)
  • Build work plans for major activities that could significantly impact system operations if not executed successfully and escalate to Maintenance Program Manager for review
  • Publish work plans monthly and update them weekly
  • Monitor execution of the work plans, assess and report on the effectiveness of work plans
  • Work with area leaders to schedule and assign work from the work plans and SAP backlog on a weekly basis
  • Be responsible for training, operation qualifications, regulatory, and compliance schedules
  • Maintain up-to-date regional technician availability (including time allocated for training, administrative activities, and not available for work time)
  • Ensure adjustments to the standard maintenance programs resulting from the development of equipment plans are properly processed and incorporated into the computerized maintenance management systems
  • Manage the collection and completion of revisions to entity management information for systems and equipment that is installed, replaced, or retired
  • Work with all critical stakeholders to ensure alignment with project plans and schedules
  • Collaborate with Commercial Operations to gain acceptance/approval of outage plans
  • Other tasks as required

Minimum Qualifications

  • Technical school graduation or associate degree
  • 3 or more years of related experience in pipeline operations, project management and/or work planning and scheduling
  • Working knowledge and expertise with CMMS systems for work planning and information retrieval, specifically SAP.
  • Demonstrated ability to monitor and assess changing resource demands and make suitable adjustments to existing plans with limited management guidance
  • Superior organizational and analytical skills
  • Must have high level of emotional intelligence and people relations skills to effectively operate in a team-oriented environment
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively communicate with Field Teams and Area Leadership
  • Ability to coordinate work with other appropriate technical resources as needed
  • Ability to effectively interact with all levels of the organization
  • Must be able to handle rapidly shifting priorities and multiple projects concurrently, requiring resolution of complex problems in stressful situations
  • Ability and initiative to work independently, display creativity, and exercise sound judgement

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiar with project management practices
  • Understanding of organization change management
  • Experience with Power Apps, power automate, Power Bi, and access

This position requires candidates to:

  • Have and maintain a valid driver’s license and safe driving record.
  • Be subject to callouts with extended workdays/weeks as required to complete assignments or emergency support.
  • Travel occasionally to other company locations, which may include air travel and overnight stays.

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


Genesys is seeking a strategic and proactive Senior Program Manager to help lead the growth and evolution of our global Voice of the Customer (VoC) practice. This role will translate practice strategy into execution, driving the portfolio of work required to build, scale, and continuously improve the practice, including offer development, methodology and playbook creation, enablement, research initiatives, go-to-market activities, and other strategic priorities.


You will work closely with VoC practice leadership, subject matter experts, and cross-functional partners to establish priorities, connect work across initiatives, and ensure the practice can execute effectively at scale. You will bring structure to ambiguity, anticipate risks and dependencies, facilitate decisions, and create visibility across a complex portfolio of work.


The ideal candidate combines strong program leadership with strategic thinking, sound business judgment, and a passion for customer experience. You should be equally comfortable building an execution framework, facilitating a cross-functional discussion, analyzing what is preventing progress, and translating complex activity into a clear narrative for senior leaders.

What you’ll do

Lead Practice Planning & Execution

  • Own the integrated portfolio of initiatives required to build, scale, and continuously improve the VoC practice, connecting individual projects to broader practice priorities and outcomes.
  • Partner with practice leadership to translate strategy and priorities into actionable roadmaps, workstreams, milestones, ownership, and measures of success.
  • Establish and manage the operating rhythm for the practice, creating visibility into priorities, progress, dependencies, decisions, risks, and outcomes.
  • Evaluate competing priorities and dependencies across the portfolio, identifying tradeoffs and recommending paths forward when resources, timing, or objectives conflict.
  • Anticipate risks and barriers to execution, proactively resolving issues where possible and bringing clear recommendations to practice leadership when decisions are required.
  • Drive accountability across cross-functional teams, ensuring commitments, decisions, and actions translate into progress.
  • Develop clear, executive-ready communications that synthesize portfolio status, emerging issues, decisions, and implications.
  • Establish scalable program management approaches, tools, templates, and processes that support the needs of a growing global practice.
  • Use practice and program data to identify execution trends, capacity constraints, opportunities for improvement, and areas requiring leadership attention.

Drive Strategic Practice Initiatives

  • Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives that advance the growth and maturity of the VoC practice, from initial concept through rollout and measurement.
  • Drive the development and launch of new VoC offers, coordinating methodology, delivery readiness, enablement, go-to-market dependencies, and launch activities.
  • Lead planning and execution for strategic research initiatives, coordinating internal teams, customers, external partners, and resulting thought leadership or practice assets.
  • Partner with subject matter experts to turn emerging ideas into structured initiatives, defining the path from concept to repeatable practice capability.
  • Coordinate VoC practice socialization and go-to-market initiatives across marketing, enablement, thought leadership, research, sales, and other cross-functional partners.
  • Connect work across initiatives to identify opportunities for reuse, simplification, or greater impact rather than managing projects as independent efforts.
  • Define success measures for major initiatives and establish mechanisms to assess adoption, effectiveness, and impact.
  • Lead retrospectives and continuous improvement efforts, translating lessons learned into changes to practice processes, methodologies, and ways of working.
  • Serve as a trusted program partner to practice leadership, bringing an informed point of view on execution, prioritization, dependencies, and opportunities to scale.

What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional programs in program management, consulting, professional services, customer experience, practice development, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience managing a portfolio of interconnected initiatives and translating strategic priorities into executable plans.
  • Strong program management expertise, including portfolio planning, prioritization, dependency management, risk management, governance, and measurement.
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and evolving environments, bringing structure to work that may not have predefined requirements, processes, or solutions.
  • Strong business judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate issues, evaluate tradeoffs, develop recommendations, and drive decisions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, including experience driving outcomes across teams without direct reporting authority.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information and communicate effectively with both working teams and senior leadership.
  • Ability to move fluidly between strategic context and execution detail, understanding both why an initiative matters and what is required to deliver it successfully.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort using program, operational, or business data to identify trends, assess progress, and inform decisions.
  • A proactive working style with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs, connect the dots across workstreams, and maintain momentum in a fast-moving environment.
  • A continuous improvement mindset and demonstrated ability to build scalable processes without creating unnecessary complexity.
  • Experience with Voice of the Customer practices, customer experience, consulting, CX research, or go-to-market offer development is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in a SaaS, professional services, consulting, or other complex cross-functional environment is preferred.
  • Experience with Asana, Smartsheet or comparable work management and portfolio management platforms is beneficial.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Agile, or related program management training or certification is a plus.

Why this role

The Voice of the Customer practice is building new ways to help organizations turn customer feedback into meaningful action. Doing that successfully requires more than strong ideas. It requires disciplined execution, clear priorities, and visibility across the many initiatives needed to build and scale the practice.

In this role, you will help create that structure. You will work closely with practice leaders and subject matter experts to move research, new offers, methodologies, tools, and other priorities from concept through completion.

You will have broad exposure to the development of a growing consulting practice and the opportunity to work across customer experience, analytics, research, consulting, and technology. title: Solutions Architect - NCP DevOps
description:
NVIDIA is looking for Senior Cloud Infrastructure Solutions Architect with extensive DevOps platforms and Accelerated Compute Infrastructure experience to join its ANZ Team, specificically focused on working with our Neo Clouds. Enterprise, Academic Research groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to redefine deep learning and data analytics, and to power data workloads. Be involved with the crew developing many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with Neo Clouds, customers, partners and various departments, to analyze, define and implement large scale AI Operational projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of System Building, Kubernetes-based platforms, Automation, Hardware and Networking.


What you'll be doing:

  • Maintaining large scale computational and AI infrastructure, focusing on monitoring, logging, workload orchestration (Kubernetes and Linux job schedulers).
  • Optimize scalable, production-ready Kubernetes-based container platforms coordinated with enterprise-grade networking and storage.
  • Serve as a key technical resource, develop, refine, and document standard methodologies and operational guidelines to be shared with internal teams.
  • Lead technical engagements, helping customers troubleshoot, resolve complex issues, and advocate for their technical needs.
  • Support Enterprise, Research & Development activities and engage in POCs/POVs to validate new features, architectures, and upgrade approaches.
  • Partner with APAC Regional and HQ Engineering, Product and Sales teams to develop, plan best suitable solutions for Partners. Enable development and growth of product features through customer feedback and proof-of-concept evaluations
  • Develop tooling to automate deployment and management of large-scale infrastructure environments, to automate operational monitoring and alerting, and to enable self-service consumption of resources.
  • Create and deliver high-quality documentation, including runbooks, onboarding materials, and best-practice guides for customers and internal teams.
  • Become the technical leader for assigned customer accounts, providing strategic guidance on DevOps and platform architecture and influencing long-term infrastructure and operations decisions.

What we need to see:

  • Education & Experience: BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields, with 5+ years of professional experience in managing scalable cloud environments and automation engineering roles.
  • Proven Hardware & Software knowledge and experience at scale: Familiarity with HPC and AI technologies (CPUs, GPUs, high-speed interconnects) and supporting software stacks.
  • Cloud & HPC Expertise: Proven understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP stack), data center architectures (from storage to Network, GPU accelerated compute and of course DevOps software stacks, as well as hands-on experience managing HPC/AI clusters, including deployment, optimization, and fixing issues.
  • Kubernetes & AI/ML Workloads: Extensive experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration, resource scheduling, scaling, and integration with HPC environments.
  • Linux & Storage Systems: Deep knowledge of Linux (RedHat/CentOS, Ubuntu), OS-level security, and protocols (TCP, DHCP, DNS). Experience with storage solutions such as Lustre, GPFS, ZFS, XFS, and emerging Kubernetes storage technologies.
  • Automation & Observability: Proficiency in Python and Bash scripting, configuration management, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform). Experience with observability stacks (Grafana, Loki, Prometheus) for monitoring, logging, and building fault-tolerant systems.
  • Solution Architecture & Customer Engagement: Strong background in crafting scalable solutions and providing consultative support to customers.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with GPU-focused hardware and software (e.g., NVIDIA DGX, CUDA, GPU Operator).
  • Solid hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes and container-based microservices architectures.
  • Skills in large-scale computing and cluster computing, data center design include high speed interconnect with Spectrum/InfiniBand, Cluster Storage and Scheduling related design and/or management experience.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for software deployment and automation.
  • Background with RDMA-based fabrics (InfiniBand or RoCE) in HPC or AI environments.

title: EMT Class - Milwaukee, Wisconsin
description:
Overview

History of the Company: Superior Ambulance Service started in 1959 with one ambulance and today is the largest independent, locally owned, and operated emergency medical services provider in the Midwest. Superior employs more than 4,000 licensed EMT, Paramedics and Nurses, operating a fleet of more than 800 ambulances throughout Illinois, Indiana, Ohio, Michigan, and Wisconsin. Superior also provides Critical Care, helicopter, and fixed wing emergency medical transportation.

We are looking for highly motivated and self-driven candidates to join the EMS Industry. We are offering an on-site 4-month EMT Student Program that will educate students and prepare them to challenge the National Registry Exam and become a Wisconsin Licensed EMT. All materials are covered by Superior Ambulance Service (SAS). Upon receiving their Wisconsin EMT licensure, the student will be hired as a employee and be required to complete a 15-month commitment of continuous employment. There is NO cost for the selected students to attend the class unless they are unable to complete the 15-months of employment after licensure.

Our 280 hour class will provide hands on training that will assist prospective candidates with obtaining their National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT) and state licenses. Within this 4 month course you will learn skills related but not limited to Emergency Medical Services (EMS) vehicle operations, airway management, cardiac emergencies, pharmacology, pediatrics, trauma, and obstetrics.


Responsibilities

Excelerated EMT Program Accelerated EMT Certification Program (Approximately 4 months, 2 days per week) that will educate and prepare you to successfully complete the National Registry Exam to become a licensed EMT. Direct employment is provided by Superior Ambulance after successful completion of the class and passing the national exam.


Qualifications

  • Possess a valid driver's license, satisfactory driving record in accordance with Superiors Driving Policy and must be able to safely operate a vehicle in various conditions, including daytime, nighttime and inclement weather.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.
  • Ability to work cooperatively with other employees and medical agencies to provide the highest level of patient care.
  • Ability to pass a background check.
  • Ability to read and interpret all required documents and write required reports and correspondence.
  • Other qualifications/certifications specific to the local operation and/or contract requirements.
  • Satisfactorily meet company physical assessments/tests/drug screening. (Must be able to lift 137.5 lbs)
  • High School diploma or GED required, unless currently enrolled in High School.
  • Past training in healthcare related fields, or Military experience is welcomed but not necessary.
  • Must be 18 years or older to be considered.
  • Admission will be approved based on passing an entrance assessment.

title: Director, Manufacturing Engineering
description:
About The Role

The Director of Engineering is responsible for leading all Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Test Engineering, Test Automation, NPI Engineering, and Customer TPM activities for the Texas manufacturing campus. This role drives factory performance, operational excellence, manufacturing readiness, automation, test strategy, and successful product launches in support of data center rack and integrated infrastructure manufacturing.


The Director serves as the senior engineering leader for the Texas site and is accountable for achieving site-level objectives related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and customer satisfaction. This role reports directly to the General Manager and is responsible for ensuring full compliance with global engineering standards, processes, governance, and operating models established by the Global Director of Engineering based in New Jersey.

The successful candidate will combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution to build a high-performing engineering organization capable of supporting rapid growth, operational excellence, and world-class manufacturing performance.

What You’ll Do

Site Engineering Leadership

  • Lead Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Test Engineering, Test Automation, NPI Engineering, and Customer TPM teams for the Texas campus.
  • Develop organizational capability, technical expertise, and engineering leadership within the site.
  • Support factory growth, capacity expansion, and operational scalability.
  • Create a culture of accountability, urgency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Manufacturing Excellence & Operational Performance

  • Drive improvements in:
    • First Pass Yield (FPY)
    • Rolled Throughput Yield (RTPY)
    • DPPM
    • Productivity
    • Throughput
    • Cycle Time
    • Labor Efficiency
    • Cost Performance
  • Optimize manufacturing processes and factory flows to maximize operational effectiveness.
  • Lead engineering support for daily production execution and factory performance reviews.
  • Ensure achievement of all site engineering and operational KPIs.

Automation & Test Engineering

  • Deploy factory automation strategies aligned with global engineering roadmaps.
  • Lead implementation of:
    • Robotics
    • Automated assembly solutions
    • Vision systems
    • Digital manufacturing tools
    • Test automation systems
  • Own site-level test engineering performance and deployment of standardized test platforms.
  • Drive improvements in manufacturing diagnostics, traceability, test coverage, and operational efficiency.

New Product Introduction (NPI)

  • Lead manufacturing readiness activities for all product introductions within the Texas facility.
  • Execute NPI phase-gate requirements and readiness reviews.
  • Ensure readiness of:
    • Manufacturing processes
    • Tooling
    • Equipment
    • Automation
    • Test systems
    • Capacity
    • Staffing
  • Lead pilot builds, process validation, launch readiness reviews, and production ramp activities.

Customer Engagement

  • Lead customer-facing TPM resources supporting Texas-based programs.
  • Participate in customer reviews, readiness assessments, escalation management, and operational reviews.
  • Ensure customer requirements are successfully translated into manufacturing execution plans.

Continuous Improvement

  • Drive Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis, CAPA, and SPC methodologies.
  • Lead initiatives focused on:
    • Yield improvement
    • Cost reduction
    • Productivity gains
    • Waste elimination
    • Capacity improvements
  • Establish rigorous performance reviews and execution management systems.

Global Engineering Alignment

The Texas Director of Engineering is responsible for executing and sustaining the global engineering framework established by the New Jersey Global Director of Engineering, including:

  • Global engineering standards
  • Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
  • Manufacturing process standards
  • Test engineering standards
  • Automation architecture standards
  • NPI phase-gate processes
  • Engineering governance models
  • KPI review processes
  • Best-practice deployment
  • Continuous improvement methodologies

The Texas engineering organization is expected to drive local execution while maintaining global consistency and standardization across the manufacturing network.

Ownership & Interfaces

This Role Owns

  • Texas Manufacturing Engineering organization
  • Process Engineering
  • Industrial Engineering
  • Test Engineering
  • Test Automation
  • Manufacturing readiness
  • Factory readiness
  • Production launch execution
  • Site operational KPIs
  • Customer TPM resources
  • Continuous improvement execution

Global Director of Engineering (New Jersey) Owns

  • Global engineering strategy
  • Engineering governance
  • Global standards and SOPs
  • NPI framework
  • Global engineering best practices
  • Global automation strategy
  • Engineering operating model

Platform Engineering Owns

  • Product architecture
  • Product design ownership
  • Product specifications
  • DFM/DFA approval
  • Product validation and qualification
  • Reliability engineering
  • Design changes
  • Level 3 debugging and technical solution development

Key Metrics

  • FPY
  • RTPY
  • DPPM
  • OEE
  • Productivity
  • Labor efficiency
  • Manufacturing cycle time
  • On-Time Delivery (OTD)
  • Cost reduction
  • Automation deployment
  • NPI launch success
  • Customer satisfaction
  • Compliance to global engineering standards

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering required; Master's Degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of engineering leadership experience in manufacturing environments.
  • Experience leading Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Automation, and NPI organizations.
  • Proven success driving operational excellence, productivity, quality, and manufacturing scale.
  • Strong customer-facing experience.
  • Experience in data center infrastructure, server, electronics, rack integration, or related manufacturing environments preferred.
  • Lean Six Sigma certification preferred.

Ideal Candidate

A strong factory-focused engineering leader who can deliver exceptional operational performance while successfully implementing global engineering standards. This individual excels at execution, talent development, continuous improvement, automation deployment, and manufacturing readiness, serving as the engineering leader for the Texas campus while partnering closely with the Global Director of Engineering to ensure consistency across the worldwide manufacturing network.

This role provides the vision, strategy, functionality, and technology solutions for creating and maintaining network platforms for both public and private cloud infrastructure-based solutions. This entails the design and use of flexible platforms that deliver features, functionality, and services compatible with industry-leading providers while allowing legacy systems to interact safely when required. This position requires the necessary skills to provide technology research, evaluation, development, and delivery in support of infrastructure deployment solution lifecycles.


The candidate will work directly with the Information Technology teams to lead the organization toward the deployment of technologies that may include PaaS, SaaS, hosted, and on-premises subscriptions – which will allow for flexible, secure, on-demand cloud-like functionality and services while endeavoring to provide resiliency and achieve cost reduction, while maintaining a highly secure and flexible environment.


This role is intended for a hands-on network engineering professional with deep experience in traditional enterprise networking. Ideal candidates should have a strong background designing, implementing, and troubleshooting large-scale Cisco and/or Arista environments, including routing, switching, network segmentation, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, high availability, and data center networking. title: Career Development Specialist - Lake Correctional Institution, Clermont, FL
description:
Join Our Team at Tallahassee State College

Career Development Specialist - Lake Correctional Institution

Tallahassee State College (TSC), recently recognized as one of the Most Promising Places to Work in Community Colleges (2025), one of the Nation’s Best and Brightest Companies to Work For® (2025), and a Great Colleges to Work For® (2025), is excited to announce a full-time, grant-funded opening for the position of Career Development Specialist – P07828 with DOC – Lake Correctional Institution , Clermont, FL (Region III).

We are looking for someone who shares our commitment to fostering a vibrant workplace community.

The link to the Department of Corrections Region 3 map is included to assist you in identifying the location of each facility. Please ensure that the location you select is within the vicinity or the location you desire.

What You’ll Do
As a Career Development Specialist, you’ll play a key role in providing services related to Compass 100 Hybrid and supplemental in-cell assignments through cell-front instruction for eligible participants who are in restrictive housing as directed by the Lead Educator.

Day-to-day, you’ll be responsible for:

  • Administration and interpretation of assessments;
  • Delivery of the 100-Hour Transition Skills Program curriculum;
  • Delivery of other programs as determined by the Department;
  • Maintaining and providing documentation of services delivered;
  • Reporting monthly attendance, program enrollments, and completions on the Department’s approved form, DC5-149 “Correctional Daily Attendance Roster” (Attachment #2);
  • Providing information pertaining to pre-release connections of community providers and employers for inmate release planning services to facility release officer’s; and
  • Assisting the Pre-Release Employment Navigators with hiring events, mock interviews, pre-release job search, recruitment, and readiness portfolio development through face-to-face and technology-based interactions.

Who We’re Looking For
We’re seeking a candidate who brings not only technical expertise but also a passion for education and student success. Our ideal candidate will have:

  • An Associate’s Degree from an accredited college or university or a high school diploma, and Two (2) years of professional experience in the workforce development, social services or corrections field.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and data entry.

Bonus points if you have:

  • An Associate’s Degree and one year of experience in the social services or corrections field.

What We Offer
We offer more than just a competitive salary of $41,200.00 annually. When you join the team at TSC, you’ll also enjoy:

  • Comprehensive State of Florida benefits, including retirement through the Florida Retirement System.
  • Opportunities for professional development.
  • Federally paid holidays recognized by the State of Florida
  • Tuition waiver for continuous learning.
  • Free access to TSC athletics, fine arts, and performing arts events.

Please visit the College's Benefits site to see the full list of benefits and opportunities.

A Little About Us

Established in 1966, Tallahassee State College is dedicated to providing high-quality educational opportunities for students from Leon, Gadsden, and Wakulla counties, as well as from throughout the state, nation, and abroad. TSC offers a wide range of academic and workforce training programs, including associate degrees, bachelor’s degrees, and in-demand certifications. Consistently ranked as one of the top colleges in the nation, our vision is to be recognized as your College of Choice.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Nexperia is a world-class company in semiconductor development and in-house production. We form a global network of talent, with passion and performance, perseverance and professionalism. Join TeamNexperia and become part of a leading company that supports, rewards and challenges you equally, in a dynamic environment, working for world-class results. Talk to us today and learn your true capabilities in an energetic company where you will develop and thrive, the Efficiency Company – Nexperia.



About the team

Digital Enablement is Nexperia's fast-track enabler of AI & Digital use-cases and platform enablement. We operate as one global practice across Nijmegen, Hamburg, Kuala Lumpur, Seremban and Bangalore, covering digital strategy, cloud and infrastructure, digital factory and enterprise, data, AI and integration.

Bangalore is where we build and ship the agentic systems that put Nexperia's AI patterns in front of real users: copilots, IDE tooling and internal automation that engineers across the company touch every day.


About the role

This is the senior build role for Nexperia's agent engineering practice in Bangalore. You own the architecture of the agents themselves — reasoning, planning, tool-calling and memory — and you own the surfaces people actually use them through: chat UI, IDE extensions, CLI tools and the APIs behind them.

You work closely with the Integration Architect on how agents connect into IDEs and internal systems, and with the MLOps/eval function on the quality bar an agent has to clear before it ships.

This is a hands-on role. You are still writing and reviewing code, still debugging orchestration failures when something breaks in production, and still accountable for what ships — not a role that manages from a distance.


What you will do

Architect and orchestrate agents

  • Design agent architecture: reasoning loops, planning, tool-calling and memory/context management.
  • Build multi-step orchestration: task decomposition, tool selection and error recovery.
  • Partner with the Integration Architect on connecting agents to IDEs and internal systems.

Ship end-to-end agent products

  • Own the build of user-facing surfaces for Copilot-style products: chat UI, IDE extensions and CLI tools.
  • Build the backend APIs that connect those surfaces to agent and LLM services, including streaming responses, session state and context handling.
  • Ship integrations into developer tools (VS Code extension API, LSPs, browser extensions) and own deployment of both the frontend and backend components you build.

Set the bar and take releases live

  • Review code and agent designs from the two Junior AI Engineers, and mentor them toward independent ownership.
  • Define the agent quality bar with the MLOps/eval function before anything ships, and work with that function on the CI/CD, monitoring, versioning/rollback and observability an agent needs once it's live.


Enable the Spokes

  • Own the governance bar for citizen-built agents — what "safe to ship" means for security, data access, cost and quality — in partnership with security/compliance and the Integration Architect.
  • Publish and maintain the standards — prompting, evals, architecture patterns — that spoke teams build against.
  • Own the design of the self-service component catalog spokes build on top of, and the support model — office hours, an embedded rotation, or a ticket queue — for citizen developers using it

What you bring

We have kept this list to what the role truly requires. If this role excites you and you meet most, but not all, of these points, we encourage you to apply.


Core requirements

  • 1-6 years hands-on building LLM or agent systems.
  • Strong Python and/or TypeScript; comfortable owning a service end to end.
  • Hands-on with agent frameworks or SDKs (Claude Agent SDK/MCP, LangGraph, AutoGen) or custom orchestration.
  • Has shipped an agentic system to production, not just a prototype.
  • Solid grasp of traditional machine learning/AI (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, feature engineering) in addition to LLM/agent-based approaches..
  • Comfortable designing REST, GraphQL and streaming/WebSocket APIs, and familiar with LLM streaming APIs (SSE/WebSockets) and token-by-token rendering.
  • Familiarity with enterprise AI/copilot platforms and cloud-native model ecosystems — Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry (model catalog, deployments, and orchestration), and AWS model configuration (Bedrock model access, inference profiles/settings) is a plus.


Valuable extras

  • Strong in React/TypeScript for frontend work, and Node.js or Python for backend work.
  • Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins or similar), cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure or GCP) and containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Observability tooling — Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, or LLM-specific tools like LangSmith or Arize — and familiarity with LLMOps practices: prompt versioning, eval pipelines, cost tracking.
  • Working knowledge of auth and session management, and awareness of security and compliance considerations for AI systems.
  • Experience in the manufacturing industry, preferably semiconductor, is a plus.
  • Experience or interest in developer enablement or platform engineering — documentation, SDKs, or internal tooling built for non-specialist users, not just for your own team.


Why join us

  • Real ownership: you set the architecture and the quality bar for agents that ship to real users, not just a reference design others build from.
  • A mentoring role with teeth: two Junior AI Engineers are counting on your reviews, and Nexperia measures you on their growth as much as on your own output.
  • You're measured not only on what the Hub ships, but on how many spoke teams successfully ship agents using what you've published.
  • Global exposure from Bangalore: you work with the AI and Data Centers of Enablement, the Integration Architect, platform engineering, security and compliance, with visibility up to the CIO and IT Management Team.
  • A team that values structured thinking, intellectual honesty about trade-offs and good documentation over heroics.





.

D&I Statement

As an equal-opportunity employer, Nexperia values diversity not just because it is the right thing to do but because diverse teams perform better. We are dedicated to being inclusive, and a proof point of this dedication is that we were the main partner of the very first Dutch Paralympic Team NL House during the Paris 2024 Paralympic Games. Our recruitment process is inclusive and accessible to all, and we consider all applicants fairly, as well as providing a safe work environment and reasonable adjustments where requested.

In addition, we offer our colleagues the possibility to join employee resource groups such as the Pride Network Group or global and local Women's groups. Nexperia is committed to increasing women in management positions to 30% by 2030.
